            .astype(str)
            .str.strip()
        )

        # CNV may already use MASTER/NCI names.
        df["MASTER_CELLNAME"] = df[id_column]

    elif "cellminer_cellline_id" in df.columns:

        id_column = "cellminer_cellline_id"

        df[id_column] = (
            df[id_column]
            .astype(str)
            .str.strip()
        )

        # Convert CellMiner ID → MASTER cell name
        df["MASTER_CELLNAME"] = df[id_column].map(
            cellminer_to_master
        )

    else:
        raise AssertionError(
            f"{name}: no recognized cell identifier column."
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Check unmapped IDs
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    unmapped = df.loc[
        df["MASTER_CELLNAME"].isna(),
        id_column
    ].unique()

    print("Unmapped identifiers:", len(unmapped))

    if len(unmapped) > 0:
        print("Examples:", list(unmapped[:10]))

    assert len(unmapped) == 0, (
        f"{name}: contains unmapped cell identifiers."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Check duplicates
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    duplicate_cells = (
        df["MASTER_CELLNAME"].duplicated().sum()
    )

    print("Duplicate cell rows:", duplicate_cells)

    assert duplicate_cells == 0, (
        f"{name}: duplicate cell rows detected."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Check exact 59-cell universe
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_cells = set(
        df["MASTER_CELLNAME"].unique()
    )

    missing = master_cells - feature_cells
    extra = feature_cells - master_cells

    print("Feature cells:", len(feature_cells))
    print("Missing MASTER cells:", sorted(missing))
    print("Extra cells:", sorted(extra))

    assert missing == set(), (
        f"{name}: missing MASTER cells."
    )

    assert extra == set(), (
        f"{name}: contains cells outside MASTER."
    )

    assert len(feature_cells) == 59

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Keep only feature columns
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    id_columns = {
        "CELLNAME",
        "cellminer_cellline_id",
        "MASTER_CELLNAME"
    }

    feature_columns = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c not in id_columns
    ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Prefix features by modality
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    rename_dict = {
        c: f"{prefix}_{c}"
        for c in feature_columns
    }

    df = df[
        ["MASTER_CELLNAME"] + feature_columns
    ].rename(columns=rename_dict)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Rename key
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    df = df.rename(
        columns={
            "MASTER_CELLNAME": "CELLNAME"
        }
    )

    print("Final shape:", df.shape)
    print("Feature columns:", len(df.columns) - 1)

    return df


# ============================================================
# PREPARE ALL FOUR MODALITIES
# ============================================================

rna = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "RNA",
    RNA_PATH,
    "RNA"
)

cnv = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "CNV",
    CNV_PATH,
    "CNV"
)

mutation = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "MUTATION",
    MUTATION_PATH,
    "MUT"
)

protein = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "PROTEIN",
    PROTEIN_PATH,
    "PROT"
)


# ============================================================
# MERGE — SAFE BECAUSE FEATURES ARE NAMESPACED
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MERGING CELLMINER FEATURES")
print("=" * 70)

cellminer_all = rna.merge(
    cnv,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="inner",
    validate="one_to_one"
)

print("After RNA + CNV:", cellminer_all.shape)

cellminer_all = cellminer_all.merge(
    mutation,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="inner",
    validate="one_to_one"
)

print("After MUTATION:", cellminer_all.shape)

cellminer_all = cellminer_all.merge(
    protein,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="inner",
    validate="one_to_one"
)

print("After PROTEIN:", cellminer_all.shape)


# ============================================================
# FINAL VALIDATION
# ============================================================

final_cells = set(
    cellminer_all["CELLNAME"].unique()
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL CELLMINER FEATURE TABLE")
print("=" * 70)

print("Shape:", cellminer_all.shape)
print("Unique cells:", len(final_cells))
print("Missing MASTER cells:", sorted(master_cells - final_cells))
print("Extra cells:", sorted(final_cells - master_cells))
print(
    "Duplicate CELLNAME rows:",
    cellminer_all["CELLNAME"].duplicated().sum()
)

assert final_cells == master_cells
assert len(cellminer_all) == 59
assert cellminer_all["CELLNAME"].duplicated().sum() == 0

print("\nPASS — ALL FOUR CELLMINER MODALITIES COVER EXACTLY 59 MASTER CELLS.")


# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================

cellminer_all.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_PATH,
    index=False
)

print("\nSaved:")
print(OUTPUT_PATH)

# ============================================================
# FUNCTION TO LOAD + TRANSLATE EACH CELLMINER FILE
# ============================================================

def prepare_cellminer_file(name, path):

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(name)
    print("=" * 70)

    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    print("Original shape:", df.shape)
    print("Original first column:", df.columns[0])

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Identify CellMiner cell ID column
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    possible_id_cols = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c.lower() in [
            "cellminer_cellline_id",
            "cellline_id",
            "cell_id"
        ]
    ]

    if possible_id_cols:

        cell_col = possible_id_cols[0]

    elif df.columns[0] == "CELLNAME":

        # Some files use CELLNAME instead.
        cell_col = "CELLNAME"

    else:

        raise ValueError(
            f"{name}: cannot identify cell column. "
            f"Columns: {list(df.columns[:10])}"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Standardize cell column
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    df[cell_col] = (
        df[cell_col]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # If file uses CellMiner IDs, map to MASTER names
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if cell_col == "cellminer_cellline_id":

        df = df.merge(
            mapping[
                [
                    "cellminer_cellline_id",
                    "nci_almanac_cellname"
                ]
            ],
            on="cellminer_cellline_id",
            how="left",
            validate="one_to_one"
        )

        assert df["nci_almanac_cellname"].notna().all(), (
            f"{name}: unmapped CellMiner IDs found."
        )

        df["CELLNAME"] = df["nci_almanac_cellname"]

        df.drop(
            columns=["nci_almanac_cellname"],
            inplace=True
        )

        df.drop(
            columns=["cellminer_cellline_id"],
            inplace=True
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # If file already uses CELLNAME
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    elif cell_col == "CELLNAME":

        df["CELLNAME"] = (
            df["CELLNAME"]
            .astype(str)
            .str.strip()
        )

        if cell_col != "CELLNAME":
            df.drop(columns=[cell_col], inplace=True)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate cells
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_cells = set(df["CELLNAME"])

    missing = master_cells - feature_cells
    extra = feature_cells - master_cells

    print("Detected cell column:", cell_col)
    print("Rows:", len(df))
    print("Unique MASTER cells represented:", len(feature_cells))
    print("Missing MASTER cells:", sorted(missing))
    print("Extra cells:", sorted(extra))

    assert len(df) == 59, (
        f"{name}: expected 59 rows, got {len(df)}"
    )

    assert df["CELLNAME"].nunique() == 59, (
        f"{name}: duplicate cells detected."
    )

    assert missing == set(), (
        f"{name}: missing MASTER cells."
    )

    assert extra == set(), (
        f"{name}: extra cells detected."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Rename feature columns with source prefixes
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_cols = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c != "CELLNAME"
    ]

    df = df[
        ["CELLNAME"] + feature_cols
    ].copy()

    df.rename(
        columns={
            c: f"{name.lower()}__{c}"
            for c in feature_cols
        },
        inplace=True
    )

    print("Feature columns:", len(feature_cols))
    print("PASS —", name, "validated")

    return df


# ============================================================
# LOAD ALL FOUR SOURCES
# ============================================================

rna = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "RNA",
    RNA_PATH
)

cnv = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "CNV",
    CNV_PATH
)

mutation = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "MUTATION",
    MUTATION_PATH
)

    "PROTEIN",

    list(rna.columns)
    + list(cnv.columns)

    + list(protein.columns)

feature_columns_only = [
    c for c in all_feature_columns
    if c != "CELLNAME"
]

assert len(feature_columns_only) == len(
    set(feature_columns_only)
), "Duplicate feature columns remain."


# ============================================================
# MERGE
# ============================================================

cellminer_all = rna.merge(
    cnv,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="inner",
    validate="one_to_one"
)

cellminer_all = cellminer_all.merge(
    mutation,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="inner",
    validate="one_to_one"
)

cellminer_all = cellminer_all.merge(
    protein,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="inner",
    validate="one_to_one"

# ============================================================
# FINAL VALIDATION
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL CELLMINER FEATURE TABLE")
print("=" * 70)

print("Shape:", cellminer_all.shape)

import pandas as pd
import os

# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

MASTER_PATH = "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/almanac/almanac_final_59cell_104drug.csv"

DRUG_FEATURE_PATH = "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/drug_features/master_plus_drug_features_294073.csv"

assert "cellminer_cellline_id" in cellminer.columns, \

    "CellMiner table must contain CELLNAME before merging."

# ============================================================

master_cells = set(master["CELLNAME"].dropna().unique())

    "CellMiner must have exactly one row per CELLNAME."

print("PASS — CellMiner exactly matches the 59-cell MASTER universe.")


# ============================================================

assert len(drug_features) == 294073, \
    "Drug-feature table does not have expected MASTER row count."

    "MASTER does not have expected row count."

print("\nPASS — MASTER and drug-feature row counts are correct.")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os

CELLMINER_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell.csv"
)

df = pd.read_csv(CELLMINER_PATH)

print("=" * 70)
print("CELLMINER FEATURE QUALITY CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", len(df.columns))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Identify cell identifier
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assert "CELLNAME" in df.columns, "CELLNAME not found."

feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c != "CELLNAME"]

print("Cell column: CELLNAME")
print("Feature columns:", len(feature_cols))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Duplicate cells
# ------------------------------------------------------------

duplicate_cells = df["CELLNAME"].duplicated().sum()

print("\nDuplicate CELLNAME rows:", duplicate_cells)

assert duplicate_cells == 0, "Duplicate cell rows found."

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Missing values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

missing_count = df[feature_cols].isna().sum()
missing_pct = df[feature_cols].isna().mean() * 100

print("\nTotal missing values:", int(missing_count.sum()))
print("Features containing NaN:", int((missing_count > 0).sum()))

print(
    "Maximum feature missingness:",
    round(missing_pct.max(), 4),
    "%"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Constant features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

n_unique = df[feature_cols].nunique(dropna=False)

constant_features = n_unique[n_unique <= 1].index.tolist()

print("\nConstant features:", len(constant_features))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Near-zero variance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

numeric_df = df[feature_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

variances = numeric_df.var(axis=0, skipna=True)

zero_variance = variances[variances == 0].index.tolist()

print("Zero-variance features:", len(zero_variance))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Infinite values
# ------------------------------------------------------------

inf_counts = np.isinf(numeric_df).sum()

infinite_features = inf_counts[inf_counts > 0].index.tolist()

print("Features containing infinity:", len(infinite_features))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Non-numeric features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

non_numeric = []

for col in feature_cols:
    converted = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors="coerce")

    # If values exist but cannot be converted
    original_nonnull = df[col].notna().sum()
    converted_nonnull = converted.notna().sum()

    if converted_nonnull < original_nonnull:
        non_numeric.append(col)

print("Non-numeric feature columns:", len(non_numeric))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Duplicate feature columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Transpose only the feature matrix
feature_matrix = numeric_df.T

duplicate_feature_columns = (
    feature_matrix.duplicated(keep=False)
)

duplicate_feature_names = (
    feature_matrix.index[duplicate_feature_columns].tolist()
)

print("Duplicate feature columns:", len(duplicate_feature_names))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Summary
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)

print("Cells:", len(df))
print("Features:", len(feature_cols))
print("NaN-containing features:", int((missing_count > 0).sum()))
print("Constant features:", len(constant_features))
print("Zero-variance features:", len(zero_variance))
print("Infinite-value features:", len(infinite_features))
print("Non-numeric features:", len(non_numeric))
print("Duplicate feature columns:", len(duplicate_feature_names))

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os

INPUT = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell.csv"
)

OUTPUT = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell_clean.csv"
)

# ============================================================
# LOAD
# ============================================================

df = pd.read_csv(INPUT)

assert "CELLNAME" in df.columns

id_col = "CELLNAME"
feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c != id_col]

print("=" * 70)
print("CELLMINER EXACT-REDUNDANCY CLEANING")
print("=" * 70)

print("Original shape:", df.shape)
print("Original features:", len(feature_cols))


# ============================================================
# NUMERIC FEATURE MATRIX
# ============================================================

X = df[feature_cols].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")


# ============================================================
# 1. REMOVE ZERO-VARIANCE FEATURES
# ============================================================

variances = X.var(axis=0, skipna=True)

zero_variance_cols = variances[
    variances == 0
].index.tolist()

print("\nZero-variance features:", len(zero_variance_cols))

X = X.drop(columns=zero_variance_cols)


# ============================================================
# 2. REMOVE EXACT DUPLICATE FEATURES
# ============================================================

# Transpose so each feature becomes a row.
# duplicated() then identifies features with identical
# values across all 59 cell lines.

duplicate_mask = X.T.duplicated(keep="first")

duplicate_cols = X.columns[duplicate_mask].tolist()

print("Exact duplicate features:", len(duplicate_cols))

X = X.loc[:, ~duplicate_mask]


# ============================================================
# 3. REBUILD CLEAN TABLE
# ============================================================

clean = pd.concat(
    [
        df[[id_col]],
        X
    ],
    axis=1
)


# ============================================================
# 4. VALIDATION
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("CLEANED CELLMINER TABLE")
print("=" * 70)

print("Original shape:", df.shape)
print("Cleaned shape:", clean.shape)

print("Features removed:")
print("  Zero variance:", len(zero_variance_cols))
print("  Exact duplicates:", len(duplicate_cols))
print(
    "  Total removed:",
    len(feature_cols) - len(X.columns)
)

print("\nRemaining features:", len(X.columns))


# ============================================================
# 5. CHECK THAT CELLS WERE NOT CHANGED
# ============================================================

assert clean["CELLNAME"].tolist() == df["CELLNAME"].tolist()

assert clean["CELLNAME"].nunique() == 59

print("\nCells:", clean["CELLNAME"].nunique())


# ============================================================
# 6. CHECK REMAINING DUPLICATES
# ============================================================

remaining_duplicate_cols = (
    clean.drop(columns=id_col)
    .T
    .duplicated()
    .sum()
)

remaining_zero_variance = (
    clean.drop(columns=id_col)
    .var(axis=0, skipna=True)
    .eq(0)
    .sum()
)

print("Remaining exact duplicate features:", remaining_duplicate_cols)
print("Remaining zero-variance features:", remaining_zero_variance)

assert remaining_duplicate_cols == 0
assert remaining_zero_variance == 0


# ============================================================
# 7. SAVE AS NEW DERIVED ARTIFACT
# ============================================================

clean.to_csv(OUTPUT, index=False)

print("\nSaved:")
print(OUTPUT)

print("\nPASS — exact redundant CellMiner features removed.")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell_clean.csv"
)

df = pd.read_csv(PATH)

assert "CELLNAME" in df.columns

print("=" * 70)
print("CELLMINER FEATURE-BLOCK PROFILING")
print("=" * 70)

print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Cells:", df["CELLNAME"].nunique())


# ============================================================
# SOURCE FEATURE COUNTS
# ============================================================

# These ranges correspond to the ORIGINAL feature files.
# We identify source by comparing against the original files.

SOURCE_FILES = {
    "RNA": (
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
        "cellminer_features/cellminer_rna_features_59cell.csv"
    ),

    "CNV": (
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
        "cellminer_features/cellminer_cnv_features_59cell.final.csv"
    ),

    "MUTATION": (
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
        "cellminer_features/cellminer_mutation_features_59cell.csv"
    ),

    "PROTEIN": (
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
        "cellminer_features/cellminer_protein_features_59cell.csv"
    )
}


# ============================================================
# GET ORIGINAL FEATURE NAMES
# ============================================================

source_features = {}

for source, path in SOURCE_FILES.items():

    temp = pd.read_csv(path, nrows=1)

    # Cell identifier can be CELLNAME or cellminer_cellline_id
    id_candidates = [
        "CELLNAME",
        "cellminer_cellline_id"
    ]

    id_col = next(
        (c for c in id_candidates if c in temp.columns),
        None
    )

    assert id_col is not None, (
        f"{source}: no cell identifier found."
    )

    source_features[source] = set(
        temp.columns
    ) - {id_col}

    print(
        f"{source:10s}: "
        f"{len(source_features[source]):6d} original features"
    )


# ============================================================
# ASSIGN CLEAN FEATURES TO SOURCES
# ============================================================

clean_features = set(df.columns) - {"CELLNAME"}

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("CLEANED FEATURE COUNTS BY SOURCE")
print("=" * 70)

assigned = set()

for source, features in source_features.items():

    present = clean_features.intersection(features)

    print(
        f"{source:10s}: "
        f"{len(present):6d} remaining features"
    )

    assigned.update(present)


unknown = clean_features - assigned

print(
    f"{'UNKNOWN':10s}: "
    f"{len(unknown):6d}"
)

assert len(unknown) == 0


# ============================================================
# SOURCE-SPECIFIC STATISTICS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("SOURCE-SPECIFIC STATISTICS")
print("=" * 70)

for source, features in source_features.items():

    cols = list(
        clean_features.intersection(features)
    )

    if len(cols) == 0:
        continue

    X = df[cols].apply(
        pd.to_numeric,
        errors="coerce"
    )

    missing_pct = (
        X.isna().mean().mean() * 100
    )

    max_missing = (
        X.isna().mean().max() * 100
    )

    mean_variance = X.var(
        axis=0,
        skipna=True
    ).mean()

    # Number of features with <= 5 unique values
    low_cardinality = (
        X.nunique(dropna=True) <= 5
    ).sum()

    # Number of binary features
    binary_features = (
        X.nunique(dropna=True) <= 2
    ).sum()

    print("\n" + source)

    print(
        "  Features:",
        len(cols)
    )

    print(
        "  Mean missingness:",
        round(missing_pct, 4),
        "%"
    )

    print(
        "  Maximum missingness:",
        round(max_missing, 4),
        "%"
    )

    print(
        "  Mean variance:",
        round(mean_variance, 6)
    )

    print(
        "  Features <=5 unique values:",
        int(low_cardinality)
    )

    print(
        "  Binary/constant features:",
        int(binary_features)
    )


# ============================================================
# GLOBAL MISSINGNESS
# ============================================================

X_all = df.drop(columns="CELLNAME")

missing_per_feature = (
    X_all.isna().mean() * 100
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("GLOBAL MISSINGNESS")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    "Features with any missingness:",
    int((missing_per_feature > 0).sum())
)

print(
    "Features >5% missing:",
    int((missing_per_feature > 5).sum())
)

print(
    "Features >10% missing:",
    int((missing_per_feature > 10).sum())
)

print(
    "Features >20% missing:",
    int((missing_per_feature > 20).sum())
)

print(
    "Maximum missingness:",
    round(missing_per_feature.max(), 4),
    "%"
)

print("\nPASS — feature blocks profiled.")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ============================================================

FILES = {

    ),

    "MUTATION": (
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
        "cellminer_features/cellminer_mutation_features_59cell.csv"
    ),

    "PROTEIN": (
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
        "cellminer_features/cellminer_protein_features_59cell.csv"
    )
}

# ============================================================
# MASTER CELLS
# ============================================================

MASTER_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/almanac/"
    "almanac_final_59cell_104drug.csv"
)

    master["CELLNAME"].astype(str)
)

print("=" * 70)
print("CELLMINER SOURCE-BY-SOURCE PROFILING")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER cells:", len(master_cells))


# ============================================================
# PROFILE EACH SOURCE INDEPENDENTLY
# ============================================================

results = {}

for name, path in FILES.items():

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(name)
    print("=" * 70)

    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    print("Shape:", df.shape)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Identify cell column
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    possible_id_cols = [
        "CELLNAME",
        "cellminer_cellline_id"
    ]

    id_col = next(
        (c for c in possible_id_cols if c in df.columns),
        None
    )

    assert id_col is not None, (
        f"{name}: no cell identifier found."
    )

    print("Cell ID column:", id_col)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate 59 cells
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_cells = set(
        df[id_col].astype(str)
    )

    print("Unique cells:", len(feature_cells))
    print(
        "Duplicate cell rows:",
        df[id_col].duplicated().sum()
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # For CellMiner IDs, use the corrected mapping
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    if id_col == "cellminer_cellline_id":

        MAPPING_PATH = (
            "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/almanac/"
            "cellline_mapping_59cell_corrected.csv"
        )

        mapping = pd.read_csv(MAPPING_PATH)

        mapping["cellminer_cellline_id"] = (
            mapping["cellminer_cellline_id"]
            .astype(str)
        )

        mapping["MASTER_CELLNAME"] = (
            mapping["MASTER_CELLNAME"]
            .astype(str)
        )

        # Ensure every feature ID has exactly one mapping
        assert not mapping[
            "cellminer_cellline_id"
        ].duplicated().any()

        mapping_dict = dict(
            zip(
                mapping["cellminer_cellline_id"],
                mapping["MASTER_CELLNAME"]
            )
        )

        mapped_cells = {
            mapping_dict[x]
            for x in feature_cells
            if x in mapping_dict
        }

    else:

        mapped_cells = feature_cells


    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Cell validation
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    missing = master_cells - mapped_cells
    extra = mapped_cells - master_cells

    print("Mapped MASTER cells:", len(mapped_cells))
    print("Missing MASTER cells:", sorted(missing))
    print("Extra cells:", sorted(extra))

    assert missing == set(), (
        f"{name}: MASTER cells missing."
    )

    assert extra == set(), (
        f"{name}: extra cells found."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Feature matrix
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_cols = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c != id_col
    ]

    X = df[feature_cols].apply(
        pd.to_numeric,
        errors="coerce"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Missingness
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    missing_per_feature = X.isna().mean() * 100

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Variance
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    variances = X.var(
        axis=0,
        skipna=True
    )

    zero_variance = (
        variances == 0
    ).sum()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Unique values
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    unique_counts = X.nunique(
        dropna=True
    )

    binary_features = (
        unique_counts <= 2
    ).sum()

    low_cardinality = (
        unique_counts <= 5
    ).sum()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Exact duplicate features
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    duplicate_features = (
        X.T.duplicated()
    ).sum()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Statistics
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    results[name] = {
        "rows": len(df),
        "features": len(feature_cols),
        "missing_features": int(
            (missing_per_feature > 0).sum()
        ),
        "max_missing_pct": float(
            missing_per_feature.max()
        ),
        "zero_variance": int(
            zero_variance
        ),
        "duplicate_features": int(
            duplicate_features
        ),
        "binary_features": int(
            binary_features
        ),
        "low_cardinality": int(
            low_cardinality
        )
    }

    print("\nFeature statistics:")
    print(
        "  Features:",
        len(feature_cols)
    )
    print(
        "  Features with missing values:",
        int((missing_per_feature > 0).sum())
    )
    print(
        "  Maximum missingness:",
        round(missing_per_feature.max(), 4),
        "%"
    )
    print(
        "  Zero-variance features:",
        zero_variance
    )
    print(
        "  Exact duplicate features:",
        duplicate_features
    )
    print(
        "  Binary/2-value features:",
        binary_features
    )
    print(
        "  ≤5 unique values:",
        low_cardinality
    )

    print(
        f"\nPASS — {name} independently validated and profiled."
    )


# ============================================================
# FINAL SUMMARY
# ============================================================

summary = pd.DataFrame(results).T

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL SOURCE SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)

print(summary)

)

RNA_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_rna_features_59cell.csv"
)

CNV_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_cnv_features_59cell.final.csv"
)

MUTATION_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_mutation_features_59cell.csv"
)

    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"

master = pd.read_csv(MASTER_PATH)

# ============================================================
# FUNCTION: LOAD + MAP ONE CELLMINER MODALITY
# ============================================================

def prepare_cellminer_file(name, path, prefix):

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(name)
    print("=" * 70)

    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # CellMiner files use CELLNAME here, but the values are
    # CellMiner IDs such as BR:MCF7.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    assert "CELLNAME" in df.columns, (
        f"{name}: expected CELLNAME column."
    )

    print("Original shape:", df.shape)

    # Clean IDs
    df["CELLNAME"] = (
        df["CELLNAME"]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate CellMiner IDs against mapping
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    valid_ids = set(
        mapping["cellminer_cellline_id"]
    )

    feature_ids = set(
        df["CELLNAME"]
    )

    missing_ids = valid_ids - feature_ids
    extra_ids = feature_ids - valid_ids

    print("Unique CellMiner IDs:", len(feature_ids))
    print("Missing required IDs:", sorted(missing_ids))
    print("Extra IDs:", sorted(extra_ids))

    assert missing_ids == set(), (
        f"{name}: missing CellMiner IDs."
    )

    assert extra_ids == set(), (
        f"{name}: contains unexpected CellMiner IDs."
    )

    assert len(df) == 59
    assert df["CELLNAME"].nunique() == 59

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Map CellMiner ID -> MASTER CELLNAME
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    id_to_master = dict(
        zip(
            mapping["cellminer_cellline_id"],
            mapping["nci_almanac_cellname"]
        )
    )

    df["CELLNAME"] = df["CELLNAME"].map(id_to_master)

    # Must have mapped every row
    assert df["CELLNAME"].notna().all(), (
        f"{name}: failed CellMiner -> MASTER mapping."
    )

    # Must represent exactly MASTER
    mapped_cells = set(df["CELLNAME"])

    missing_master = master_cells - mapped_cells
    extra_master = mapped_cells - master_cells

    print("Mapped MASTER cells:", len(mapped_cells))
    print("Missing MASTER cells:", sorted(missing_master))
    print("Extra MASTER cells:", sorted(extra_master))

    assert missing_master == set()
    assert extra_master == set()

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Remove original cell ID only
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_cols = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c != "CELLNAME"
    ]

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PREFIX FEATURES
    #
    # This prevents RNA/PROTEIN/MUTATION/etc. columns such
    # as TP53, EP300, AKAP8 from colliding.
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    df = df.rename(
        columns={
            c: f"{prefix}_{c}"
            for c in feature_cols
        }
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Ensure numeric features
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    non_numeric = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c != "CELLNAME"
        and not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c])
    ]

    assert non_numeric == [], (
        f"{name}: non-numeric features found: {non_numeric[:10]}"
    )

    print("Final shape:", df.shape)
    print("Feature columns:", len(df.columns) - 1)
    print(f"PASS — {name} validated and mapped")

    return df


# ============================================================
# PREPARE FOUR MODALITIES
# ============================================================

rna = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "RNA",
    RNA_PATH,
    "RNA"
)

cnv = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "CNV",
    CNV_PATH,
    "CNV"
)

mutation = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "MUTATION",
    MUTATION_PATH,
    "MUT"
)

protein = prepare_cellminer_file(
    "PROTEIN",
    PROTEIN_PATH,
    "PROT"
)


# ============================================================
# MERGE
# ============================================================

cellminer_all = rna.merge(
    cnv,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="inner",
    validate="one_to_one"
)

cellminer_all = cellminer_all.merge(
    mutation,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="inner",
    validate="one_to_one"
)

cellminer_all = cellminer_all.merge(
    protein,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="inner",
    validate="one_to_one"
)


# ============================================================
# FINAL VALIDATION
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL CELLMINER TABLE")
print("=" * 70)

print("Shape:", cellminer_all.shape)
print("Unique cells:", cellminer_all["CELLNAME"].nunique())

final_cells = set(
    cellminer_all["CELLNAME"]
)

missing = master_cells - final_cells
extra = final_cells - master_cells

print("Missing MASTER cells:", sorted(missing))
print("Extra cells:", sorted(extra))

assert len(cellminer_all) == 59
assert final_cells == master_cells
assert cellminer_all["CELLNAME"].duplicated().sum() == 0


# ============================================================
# CHECK FEATURE-COLUMN COLLISIONS
# ============================================================

feature_columns = [
    c for c in cellminer_all.columns
    if c != "CELLNAME"
]

duplicate_columns = (
    pd.Series(feature_columns)
    .duplicated()
    .sum()
)

print("Feature columns:", len(feature_columns))
print("Duplicate feature column names:", duplicate_columns)

assert duplicate_columns == 0


# ============================================================
# SAVE
# ============================================================

cellminer_all.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_PATH,
    index=False
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("PASS — CELLMINER MODALITIES MERGED SAFELY")
print("=" * 70)

print("Cells:", len(final_cells))
print("Features:", len(feature_columns))
print("Saved:")
print(OUTPUT_PATH)

# ============================================================
# CELL COLUMN DETECTION
# ============================================================

def detect_cell_column(df, name):

    candidates = [
        "cellminer_cellline_id",
        "CELLNAME",
        "CellName",
        "cellname"
    ]

    for col in candidates:
        if col in df.columns:
            return col

    # If no standard name exists, inspect first column.
    first_col = df.columns[0]

    values = set(
        df[first_col]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

    valid_ids = set(
        mapping["cellminer_cellline_id"]
    )

    if values.issubset(valid_ids):
        return first_col

    raise AssertionError(
        f"{name}: could not identify CellMiner ID column. "
        f"Columns: {df.columns[:5].tolist()}"
    )


# ============================================================
# PREPARE MODALITY
# ============================================================

def prepare_modality(name, path, prefix):

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(name)
    print("=" * 70)

    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    print("Original shape:", df.shape)

    cell_col = detect_cell_column(df, name)

    print("Detected cell column:", cell_col)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Standardize identifier
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    df[cell_col] = (
        df[cell_col]
        .astype(str)
        .str.strip()
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate against corrected mapping
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    valid_ids = set(
        mapping["cellminer_cellline_id"]
    )

    feature_ids = set(
        df[cell_col]
    )

    missing_ids = valid_ids - feature_ids
    extra_ids = feature_ids - valid_ids

    print("Unique CellMiner IDs:", len(feature_ids))
    print("Missing IDs:", sorted(missing_ids))
    print("Extra IDs:", sorted(extra_ids))

    assert missing_ids == set(), (
        f"{name}: missing CellMiner IDs."
    )

    assert extra_ids == set(), (
        f"{name}: unexpected CellMiner IDs."
    )

    assert len(feature_ids) == 59

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Map CellMiner ID → MASTER CELLNAME
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    id_to_master = dict(
        zip(
            mapping["cellminer_cellline_id"],
            mapping["nci_almanac_cellname"]
        )
    )

    df["CELLNAME"] = (
        df[cell_col]
        .map(id_to_master)
    )

    # Remove original ID column if it isn't already CELLNAME
    if cell_col != "CELLNAME":
        df = df.drop(columns=[cell_col])

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate mapped cells
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    mapped_cells = set(df["CELLNAME"])

    missing_master = master_cells - mapped_cells
    extra_master = mapped_cells - master_cells

    print("Mapped MASTER cells:", len(mapped_cells))
    print("Missing MASTER cells:", sorted(missing_master))
    print("Extra MASTER cells:", sorted(extra_master))

    assert missing_master == set()
    assert extra_master == set()

    assert len(df) == 59
    assert df["CELLNAME"].nunique() == 59

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Prefix every feature column
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    feature_cols = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c != "CELLNAME"
    ]

    df = df.rename(
        columns={
            c: f"{prefix}_{c}"
            for c in feature_cols
        }
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Numeric validation
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    non_numeric = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c != "CELLNAME"
        and not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df[c])
    ]

    assert not non_numeric, (
        f"{name}: non-numeric columns: {non_numeric[:10]}"
    )

    print("Feature columns:", len(feature_cols))
    print(f"PASS — {name} validated")

    return df

# ============================================================
# CELLMINER — FEATURE QUALITY FILTERING
# ============================================================

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

CELLminer_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell_clean.csv"
)

df = pd.read_csv(CELLminer_PATH)

print("=" * 70)
print("CELLMINER FEATURE QUALITY FILTERING")
print("=" * 70)

print("Original shape:", df.shape)

CELL_COL = "CELLNAME"

feature_cols = [
    c for c in df.columns
    if c != CELL_COL
]

X = df[feature_cols]

# ============================================================
# 1. CONSTANT FEATURES
# ============================================================

nunique = X.nunique(dropna=False)

constant_features = nunique[nunique <= 1].index.tolist()

print("\nConstant features:", len(constant_features))


# ============================================================
# 2. ZERO-VARIANCE FEATURES
# ============================================================

variance = X.var(axis=0, skipna=True)

zero_variance = variance[
    variance.fillna(0) == 0
].index.tolist()

print("Zero-variance features:", len(zero_variance))


# ============================================================
# 3. MISSINGNESS
# ============================================================

missing_fraction = X.isna().mean()

print(
    "Maximum feature missingness:",
    round(missing_fraction.max() * 100, 4),
    "%"
)

# With only 59 cells, don't aggressively delete features yet.
# Flag features with >20% missingness.

high_missing = missing_fraction[
    missing_fraction > 0.20
].index.tolist()

print(
    "Features with >20% missingness:",
    len(high_missing)
)


# ============================================================
# 4. INFINITE VALUES
# ============================================================

infinite_counts = np.isinf(
    X.to_numpy(dtype=float)
).sum(axis=0)

infinite_features = [
    feature_cols[i]
    for i, count in enumerate(infinite_counts)
    if count > 0
]

print("Features containing infinity:", len(infinite_features))


# ============================================================
# 5. NON-NUMERIC FEATURES
# ============================================================

non_numeric = [
    c for c in feature_cols
    if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X[c])
]

print("Non-numeric features:", len(non_numeric))


# ============================================================
# SUMMARY
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("QUALITY FILTER SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)

print("Original features:", len(feature_cols))
print("Constant:", len(constant_features))
print("Zero variance:", len(zero_variance))
print(">20% missing:", len(high_missing))
print("Infinite:", len(infinite_features))
print("Non-numeric:", len(non_numeric))

# ============================================================
# CELLMINER FEATURE PROVENANCE
# ============================================================

import pandas as pd
import os

RNA_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_rna_features_59cell.csv"
)

CNV_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_cnv_features_59cell.final.csv"
)

MUTATION_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_mutation_features_59cell.csv"
)

PROTEIN_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_protein_features_59cell.csv"
)

FINAL_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell_clean.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# LOAD FINAL MATRIX
# ============================================================

final_df = pd.read_csv(FINAL_PATH)

final_features = set(
    final_df.columns
) - {"CELLNAME"}


# ============================================================
# LOAD ORIGINAL MODALITIES
# ============================================================

paths = {
    "RNA": RNA_PATH,
    "CNV": CNV_PATH,
    "MUTATION": MUTATION_PATH,
    "PROTEIN": PROTEIN_PATH
}

modality_features = {}

for modality, path in paths.items():

    df = pd.read_csv(path)

    # Remove cell identifier
    feature_set = set(df.columns) - {
        "CELLNAME",
        "cellminer_cellline_id",
        "nci_almanac_cellname",
        "MASTER_CELLNAME"
    }

    modality_features[modality] = feature_set


# ============================================================
# PROVENANCE
# ============================================================

provenance = []

for feature in final_features:

    sources = [
        modality
        for modality, features in modality_features.items()
        if feature in features
    ]

    provenance.append({
        "feature": feature,
        "modality": (
            sources[0]
            if len(sources) == 1
            else "MULTIPLE"
            if len(sources) > 1
            else "UNKNOWN"
        )
    })

provenance_df = pd.DataFrame(provenance)


# ============================================================
# SUMMARY
# ============================================================

print("=" * 70)
print("CELLMINER FEATURE PROVENANCE")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    provenance_df["modality"]
    .value_counts()
)

print("\nUnknown features:",
      (provenance_df["modality"] == "UNKNOWN").sum())

print("Multiple-source features:",
      (provenance_df["modality"] == "MULTIPLE").sum())


# ============================================================
# VERIFY ALL FEATURES ACCOUNTED FOR
# ============================================================

assert (
    provenance_df["modality"] == "UNKNOWN"
).sum() == 0, "Some final features have unknown provenance."

assert (
    provenance_df["modality"] == "MULTIPLE"
).sum() == 0, "Some features occur in multiple modalities."


print("\nPASS — every CellMiner feature has exactly one modality.")


# ============================================================
# SAVE PROVENANCE TABLE
# ============================================================

PROVENANCE_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_feature_provenance.csv"
)

provenance_df.to_csv(
    PROVENANCE_PATH,
    index=False
)

print("\nSaved:")
print(PROVENANCE_PATH)

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA

# ============================================================
# PATHS
# ============================================================

INPUT_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell.csv"
)

OUTPUT_DIR = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/pca"
)

os.makedirs(OUTPUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)


# ============================================================
# LOAD
# ============================================================

df = pd.read_csv(INPUT_PATH)

print("Input shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns[:10].tolist())


# ============================================================
# CELL IDENTIFIER
# ============================================================

assert "CELLNAME" in df.columns, "CELLNAME not found."

cell_names = df["CELLNAME"].copy()

feature_df = df.drop(columns=["CELLNAME"])


# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY MODALITIES
# ============================================================

modalities = {
    "RNA": [
        c for c in feature_df.columns
        if c.startswith("RNA_")
    ],
    "CNV": [
        c for c in feature_df.columns
        if c.startswith("CNV_")
    ],
    "MUTATION": [
        c for c in feature_df.columns
        if c.startswith("MUTATION_")
    ],
    "PROTEIN": [
        c for c in feature_df.columns
        if c.startswith("PROTEIN_")
    ]
}


print("\n============================================================")
print("MODALITY COUNTS")
print("============================================================")

for modality, cols in modalities.items():
    print(f"{modality:12s}: {len(cols):6d}")


# ============================================================
# CHECK ALL FEATURES HAVE A MODALITY
# ============================================================

assigned = sum(len(v) for v in modalities.values())

print("\nTotal features:", len(feature_df.columns))
print("Assigned features:", assigned)
print("Unassigned features:", len(feature_df.columns) - assigned)

assert assigned == len(feature_df.columns), (
    "Some features were not assigned to a modality."
)


# ============================================================
# PCA FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def run_pca(
    modality,
    columns,
    variance_threshold=0.95
):
    
    X = feature_df[columns].copy()

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(modality)
    print("=" * 70)

    print("Original features:", X.shape[1])
    print("Cells:", X.shape[0])

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Numeric check
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    X = X.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

    assert not X.isna().any().any(), (
        f"{modality}: NaN values detected."
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Standardize
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    scaler = StandardScaler()

    X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PCA
    # First determine how many PCs explain 95%
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    pca_full = PCA()

    X_full = pca_full.fit_transform(X_scaled)

    cumulative_variance = np.cumsum(
        pca_full.explained_variance_ratio_
    )

    n_components = (
        np.searchsorted(
            cumulative_variance,
            variance_threshold
        ) + 1
    )

    # Cannot exceed number of cells - 1
    n_components = min(
        n_components,
        X.shape[0] - 1
    )

    explained = cumulative_variance[n_components - 1]

    print("PCs required:", n_components)
    print(
        f"Variance explained: {explained:.4f}"
        f" ({explained * 100:.2f}%)"
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Final PCA
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    pca = PCA(
        n_components=n_components
    )

    X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)

    pc_names = [
        f"{modality}_PC{i+1}"
        for i in range(n_components)
    ]

    pca_df = pd.DataFrame(
        X_pca,
        columns=pc_names
    )

    pca_df.insert(
        0,
        "CELLNAME",
        cell_names.values
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Save
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    output_path = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        f"cellminer_{modality.lower()}_pca_95.csv"
    )

    pca_df.to_csv(
        output_path,
        index=False
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Save explained variance
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    variance_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "PC": pc_names,
        "explained_variance_ratio":
            pca.explained_variance_ratio_,
        "cumulative_variance":
            np.cumsum(
                pca.explained_variance_ratio_
            )
    })

    variance_path = os.path.join(
        OUTPUT_DIR,
        f"cellminer_{modality.lower()}_pca_variance.csv"
    )

    variance_df.to_csv(
        variance_path,
        index=False
    )

    print("Output shape:", pca_df.shape)
    print("Saved:", output_path)

    return pca_df, variance_df


# ============================================================
# RUN PCA FOR EACH MODALITY
# ============================================================

pca_results = {}
variance_results = {}

for modality, columns in modalities.items():

    pca_results[modality], variance_results[modality] = run_pca(
        modality,
        columns,
        variance_threshold=0.95
    )


# ============================================================
# SUMMARY
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("PCA SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)

for modality in modalities:

    original = len(modalities[modality])
    reduced = pca_results[modality].shape[1] - 1

    variance = (
        variance_results[modality]
        ["cumulative_variance"]
        .iloc[-1]
    )

    print(
        f"{modality:12s} | "
        f"{original:6d} → {reduced:3d} PCs | "
        f"{variance * 100:6.2f}% variance"
    )

print("\nPASS — PCA dimensionality reduction completed.")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# ============================================================
# LOAD VALIDATED CELLMINER FEATURES
# ============================================================

CELLMINER_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell.csv"
)

df = pd.read_csv(CELLMINER_PATH)

print("=" * 70)
print("LOAD VALIDATED CELLMINER FEATURES")
print("=" * 70)

print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Cells:", df["CELLNAME"].nunique())
print("Features:", len(df.columns) - 1)

assert df["CELLNAME"].nunique() == 59
assert df["CELLNAME"].duplicated().sum() == 0


# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY MODALITY
# ============================================================

def get_modality(col):
    if col.startswith("rna__"):
        return "RNA"
    elif col.startswith("cnv__"):
        return "CNV"
    elif col.startswith("mutation__"):
        return "MUTATION"
    elif col.startswith("protein__"):
        return "PROTEIN"
    return "UNKNOWN"


feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c != "CELLNAME"]

modality = pd.Series(
    {c: get_modality(c) for c in feature_cols}
)

print("\nFeature counts:")
print(modality.value_counts())


# ============================================================
# CHECK CORRELATION REDUNDANCY
# ============================================================
#
# IMPORTANT:
# We are NOT selecting features using the target.
# This is unsupervised redundancy filtering.
#
# With only 59 cells, calculating a full 48k x 48k
# correlation matrix would be extremely large.
#
# Instead, perform correlation filtering separately
# within each modality.
# ============================================================

CORR_THRESHOLD = 0.95

selected_features = []
removed_features = []

for mod in ["RNA", "CNV", "MUTATION", "PROTEIN"]:

    cols = modality[modality == mod].index.tolist()

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(mod)
    print("=" * 70)

    print("Original features:", len(cols))

    X = df[cols]

    # Correlation matrix
    corr = X.corr(method="pearson").abs()

    # Upper triangle only
    upper = corr.where(
        np.triu(
            np.ones(corr.shape),
            k=1
        ).astype(bool)
    )

    # Features having correlation > threshold
    to_remove = [
        column
        for column in upper.columns
        if (upper[column] > CORR_THRESHOLD).any()
    ]

    keep = [
        column
        for column in cols
        if column not in to_remove
    ]

    selected_features.extend(keep)
    removed_features.extend(to_remove)

    print("Removed:", len(to_remove))
    print("Remaining:", len(keep))


# ============================================================
# FINAL CHECK
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("CORRELATION FILTER SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)

print("Original features:", len(feature_cols))
print("Removed:", len(removed_features))
print("Remaining:", len(selected_features))

assert len(selected_features) + len(removed_features) == len(feature_cols)
assert len(set(selected_features)) == len(selected_features)

print("\nPASS — correlation redundancy filtering completed.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------

def get_modality(col):
    prefix = col.split("__", 1)[0].lower()

    if prefix == "rna":
        return "RNA"
    elif prefix == "cnv":
        return "CNV"
    elif prefix == "mutation":
        return "MUTATION"
    elif prefix == "protein":
        return "PROTEIN"
    else:
        return "UNKNOWN"

    c: get_modality(c)
    for c in cellminer_feature_cols
})

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr

# ============================================================
# PATHS — USE YOUR FROZEN / EXISTING FILES
# ============================================================

MASTER_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/almanac/"
    "almanac_final_59cell_104drug.csv"
)

CELLMINER_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell.csv"
)

# Existing split directory
SPLIT_BASE = "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits"

# ============================================================
# LOAD
# ============================================================

master = pd.read_csv(MASTER_PATH)
cellminer = pd.read_csv(CELLMINER_PATH)

print("=" * 70)
print("LOADED DATA")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER:", master.shape)
print("CELLMINER:", cellminer.shape)

# ============================================================
# BASIC VALIDATION
# ============================================================

assert master["CELLNAME"].nunique() == 59
assert cellminer["CELLNAME"].nunique() == 59

assert set(master["CELLNAME"]) == set(cellminer["CELLNAME"])

print("\nPASS — MASTER/CELLMINER CELL UNIVERSE MATCHES")

# ============================================================
# BUILD CELL FEATURE LOOKUP
# ============================================================

cell_feature_cols = [
    c for c in cellminer.columns
    if c != "CELLNAME"
]

print("\nCellMiner features:", len(cell_feature_cols))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT:
# CellMiner has cell-level features.
# We do NOT merge all 294k rows with all features blindly
# until we explicitly map CELLNAME -> features.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ============================================================
# MERGE CELL FEATURES ONTO MASTER
# ============================================================

model_df = master.merge(
    cellminer,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="left",
    validate="many_to_one"
)

print("\nModel dataframe:", model_df.shape)

assert len(model_df) == len(master)
assert model_df["CELLNAME"].isna().sum() == 0

print("PASS — CellMiner features mapped to MASTER")

# ============================================================
# HANDLE CNV MISSINGNESS
# ============================================================
# UO-31 was intentionally absent from the raw CNV source.
# Therefore its CNV values are structurally missing.
#
# CatBoost can handle NaN values natively.
# DO NOT impute them at this stage.
# ============================================================

X = model_df[cell_feature_cols]
y = model_df["combo_score"]

print("\nFeature matrix:", X.shape)
print("Target:", y.shape)

assert X.shape[0] == len(y)
assert X.select_dtypes(exclude=[np.number]).shape[1] == 0

print("PASS — numeric feature matrix")

# ============================================================
# IDENTIFY SPLIT FILES
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("AVAILABLE SPLITS")
print("=" * 70)

for split_type in [
    "random",
    "cold_combination",
    "cold_cell",
    "cold_drug"
]:
    path = os.path.join(SPLIT_BASE, split_type)

    if os.path.exists(path):
        print(split_type, "->", os.listdir(path))
    else:
        print(split_type, "-> directory not found")

# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST DATASET PREPARATION

import os
import gc
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN CATBOOST PREPARATION")
print("=" * 70)


# ============================================================
# PATHS — THESE ARE YOUR ACTUAL FILES
# ============================================================

MASTER_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/almanac/"
    "almanac_final_59cell_104drug.csv"
)

CELLMINER_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/"
    "cellminer_features/cellminer_all_features_59cell.csv"
)

STRING_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/network_features/"
    "drug_pair_string_features_final_master_aligned.csv"
)

KEGG_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/network_features/"
    "drug_pair_kegg_features_104drug_master_aligned_canonical_pairs.csv"
)

STRUCTURE_PAIR_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/drug_features/"
    "drug_pair_structure_features_104drug_master_aligned_internal_ids_canonical_pairs.csv"
)

SIMILARITY_PAIR_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/drug_features/"
    "drug_pair_similarity_features_104drug_master_aligned_internal_ids_canonical_pairs.csv"
)

TARGET_PAIR_PATH = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/Generated_features/drug_features/"
    "drug_pair_target_features_104drug_master_aligned_internal_ids_canonical_pairs.csv"
)


# ============================================================
# 1. LOAD MASTER
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("LOADING MASTER")
print("=" * 70)

master = pd.read_csv(MASTER_PATH)

print("MASTER:", master.shape)
print("Unique drugs:", len(set(master["drug_A"]) | set(master["drug_B"])))
print("Unique cells:", master["CELLNAME"].nunique())


# ============================================================
# 2. LOAD CELLMINER
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("LOADING CELLMINER")
print("=" * 70)

cellminer = pd.read_csv(CELLMINER_PATH)

cellminer = cellminer.rename(
    columns={cellminer.columns[0]: "CELLNAME"}
)

assert cellminer["CELLNAME"].nunique() == 59

missing_cells = (
    set(master["CELLNAME"].unique())
    - set(cellminer["CELLNAME"])
)

extra_cells = (
    set(cellminer["CELLNAME"])
    - set(master["CELLNAME"].unique())
)

assert not missing_cells
assert not extra_cells

print("CellMiner:", cellminer.shape)
print("CellMiner features:", cellminer.shape[1] - 1)
print("PASS — CellMiner universe matches MASTER")


# ============================================================
# 3. CELLMINER → PCA
#
# IMPORTANT:
# DO NOT attach 48,885 features directly to MASTER.
#
# We compress the 59-cell representation into a small
# cell embedding.
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("CELLMINER DIMENSIONALITY REDUCTION")
print("=" * 70)

cell_names = cellminer["CELLNAME"].copy()

X_cell = cellminer.drop(columns=["CELLNAME"])

# Force numeric
X_cell = X_cell.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce")

# CNV contains missing values.
# Median-impute within each feature.
X_cell = X_cell.fillna(X_cell.median())

# Any pathological remaining values
X_cell = X_cell.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
X_cell = X_cell.fillna(0)

print("Input CellMiner features:", X_cell.shape[1])

# Standardize before PCA
scaler = StandardScaler()

X_cell_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_cell)

# Because there are only 59 cells, do NOT ask for hundreds
# of components. 50 is already a compact representation.
N_CELL_COMPONENTS = 50

pca = PCA(
    n_components=N_CELL_COMPONENTS,
    random_state=42
)

X_cell_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_cell_scaled)

cell_pca = pd.DataFrame(
    X_cell_pca,
    columns=[
        f"CELL_PCA_{i+1:02d}"
        for i in range(N_CELL_COMPONENTS)
    ]
)

cell_pca.insert(0, "CELLNAME", cell_names.values)

print("PCA output:", cell_pca.shape)
print(
    "Variance explained:",
    round(pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum(), 4)
)

print("PASS — CellMiner compressed to 50 components")


# Free the huge intermediate arrays
del X_cell_scaled
del X_cell
gc.collect()


# ============================================================
# 4. ATTACH ONLY 50 CELLMINER COMPONENTS TO MASTER
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ATTACHING CELL EMBEDDING")
print("=" * 70)

model_df = master.merge(
    cell_pca,
    on="CELLNAME",
    how="left",
    validate="many_to_one"
)

assert len(model_df) == len(master)

assert model_df[
    [f"CELL_PCA_{i+1:02d}" for i in range(N_CELL_COMPONENTS)]
].isna().sum().sum() == 0

print("Model matrix after CellMiner:", model_df.shape)

# ============================================================
# 1. HELPER — CANONICAL PAIR KEY
# ============================================================

def make_pair_key(df, col_a, col_b):
    a = df[col_a].astype(str).str.strip()
    b = df[col_b].astype(str).str.strip()

    return (
        np.where(a <= b, a + "||" + b, b + "||" + a)
    )


# ============================================================
# 2. CHECK MASTER DRUG IDENTIFIERS
# ============================================================

print("Unique drug_B:", master["drug_B"].nunique())

# ============================================================

def prepare_pair_features(
    df,
    name,
    col_a="drug_A_id",
    col_b="drug_B_id"
):

    print("\n" + "-" * 70)
    print(name)
    print("-" * 70)

    df = df.copy()

    print("Original shape:", df.shape)

    assert col_a in df.columns, (
        f"{name}: missing {col_a}"
    )

    assert col_b in df.columns, (
        f"{name}: missing {col_b}"
    )

    # Create canonical key
    df["PAIR_KEY"] = make_pair_key(
        df,
        col_a,
        col_b
    )

    # Check pair uniqueness
    duplicate_pairs = df["PAIR_KEY"].duplicated().sum()

    print("Unique pairs:", df["PAIR_KEY"].nunique())
    print("Duplicate pair rows:", duplicate_pairs)

    assert duplicate_pairs == 0, (
        f"{name}: duplicate pair keys found."
    )

    return df

# ============================================================
# 11. REMOVE KEY COLUMNS FROM FEATURE DATAFRAMES
# ============================================================

def keep_feature_columns(df, name):

    # Keep only numeric feature columns.
    # Drug identifiers and names are not model features.

    excluded = {
        "PAIR_KEY",
        "drug_A_id",
        "drug_B_id",
        "Drug_A_Name",
        "Drug_B_Name",
        "drug_A",
        "drug_B",
    }

    feature_cols = [
        c for c in df.columns
        if c not in excluded
    ]

    out = df[
        ["PAIR_KEY"] + feature_cols
    ].copy()

    # Prefix to prevent collisions
    renamed = {
        c: f"{name}__{c}"
        for c in feature_cols
    }

    out = out.rename(columns=renamed)

    return out

    kegg_pair,

    structure_pair,

)

)

        }

    )

    return out

print("\n" + "=" * 70)

for name, features in [
    ("KEGG", kegg_features),
    ("STRUCTURE", structure_features),
    ("SIMILARITY", similarity_features),
    ("TARGET", target_features),
]:

    before = len(model_df)

    model_df = model_df.merge(
        features,
        on="PAIR_KEY",
        how="left",
        validate="many_to_one"
    )

    assert len(model_df) == before

    print(
        f"{name:12s} -> shape {model_df.shape}"
    )

    == model_df["drug_A"].astype(str).values
).all()

assert (

    == model_df["drug_B"].astype(str).values
).all()

    string_features["STRING_distance"],

    ]
    .drop_duplicates()
)

    structure_pair_df[

    ]
    .drop_duplicates()
)

id_to_name_B.columns = ["internal_id", "drug_name"]

id_to_name = pd.concat(
    [id_to_name_A, id_to_name_B],
    ignore_index=True
).drop_duplicates()

# Check one internal ID never maps to multiple names
id_name_counts = (
    id_to_name
    .groupby("internal_id")["drug_name"]
    .nunique()
)

bad_ids = id_name_counts[
    id_name_counts > 1
]

print("Internal IDs:", id_to_name["internal_id"].nunique())

    "Some internal IDs map to multiple drug names."
)

    id_to_name
    .sort_values("internal_id")
    .head(30)
    .to_string(index=False)
)

# ============================================================
# FIND EXISTING DRUG ID MAPPING
# ============================================================

import os
import glob
import pandas as pd

BASE = "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn"

print("=" * 70)
print("SEARCHING FOR EXISTING DRUG ID MAPPING")
print("=" * 70)

# Search likely locations and filenames
patterns = [
    "**/*mapping*.csv",
    "**/*map*.csv",
    "**/*drug*id*.csv",
    "**/*drug*metadata*.csv",
    "**/*canonical*.csv",
    "**/*identifier*.csv",
    "**/*drug*.parquet",
]

matches = []

for pattern in patterns:
    matches.extend(
        glob.glob(
            os.path.join(BASE, pattern),
            recursive=True
        )
    )

# Remove duplicates
matches = sorted(set(matches))

print(f"\nCandidate files found: {len(matches)}\n")

for path in matches:
    print(path)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FILTERING CANDIDATES")
print("=" * 70)

# Look specifically for files that may contain both
# MASTER drug IDs and internal IDs.
candidate_tables = []

for path in matches:

    # Skip huge/generated feature files
    if "Generated_features" in path:
        continue

    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(path, nrows=5)

        cols = [str(c).lower() for c in df.columns]

        has_drug = any(
            ("drug" in c) or ("nsc" in c)
            for c in cols
        )

        has_id = any(
            ("id" in c) or ("internal" in c)
            for c in cols
        )

        if has_drug and has_id:
            candidate_tables.append((path, list(df.columns)))

    except Exception:
        pass


print(
    f"\nPotential mapping tables: "
    f"{len(candidate_tables)}"
)

for path, cols in candidate_tables:
    print("\nFILE:")
    print(path)
    print("COLUMNS:")
    print(cols)

# ============================================================
# MASTER NSC -> INTERNAL DRUG ID MAPPING

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

CANONICAL_DRUG_TABLE = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/"
    "drug_metadata/canonical_drug_table.csv"
)

print("=" * 70)
print("LOADING EXISTING DRUG ID MAPPING")
print("=" * 70)

drug_map = pd.read_csv(CANONICAL_DRUG_TABLE)

print("Mapping shape:", drug_map.shape)
print("Columns:", drug_map.columns.tolist())

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BASIC VALIDATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------

required = ["NSC", "drug_id"]

missing_required = [
    c for c in required
    if c not in drug_map.columns
]

assert not missing_required, (
    f"Missing required mapping columns: {missing_required}"
)

print("\nNSC unique:", drug_map["NSC"].nunique())
print("drug_id unique:", drug_map["drug_id"].nunique())

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NORMALIZE IDENTIFIER TYPES
# ------------------------------------------------------------

master["drug_A"] = pd.to_numeric(
    master["drug_A"],
    errors="raise"
).astype(int)

master["drug_B"] = pd.to_numeric(
    master["drug_B"],
    errors="raise"
).astype(int)

drug_map["NSC"] = pd.to_numeric(
    drug_map["NSC"],
    errors="raise"
).astype(int)

drug_map["drug_id"] = pd.to_numeric(
    drug_map["drug_id"],
    errors="raise"
).astype(int)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CHECK MASTER NSCs AGAINST MAPPING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

master_drugs = set(master["drug_A"]) | set(master["drug_B"])
mapping_nscs = set(drug_map["NSC"])

missing_nsc = master_drugs - mapping_nscs
extra_nsc = mapping_nscs - master_drugs

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MASTER NSC MAPPING CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER unique drugs:", len(master_drugs))
print("Mapping unique NSCs:", len(mapping_nscs))

print("MASTER NSCs missing from mapping:", len(missing_nsc))
print("Mapping NSCs not in MASTER:", len(extra_nsc))

if missing_nsc:
    print("\nMissing MASTER NSCs:")
    print(sorted(missing_nsc))

assert len(missing_nsc) == 0, (
    "Some MASTER NSCs do not have an existing drug_id mapping."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CHECK ONE-TO-ONE NSC -> drug_id
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mapping_conflicts = (
    drug_map
    .groupby("NSC")["drug_id"]
    .nunique()
)

conflicting_nsc = mapping_conflicts[
    mapping_conflicts > 1
]

print("\nNSCs with multiple drug_ids:", len(conflicting_nsc))

assert len(conflicting_nsc) == 0, (
    "Some NSCs map to multiple internal drug IDs."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE THE EXISTING MAPPING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nsc_to_drug_id = (
    drug_map[
        ["NSC", "drug_id"]
    ]
    .drop_duplicates()
    .set_index("NSC")["drug_id"]
    .to_dict()
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# VERIFY MASTER -> INTERNAL IDS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

master_internal_ids = {
    nsc_to_drug_id[nsc]
    for nsc in master_drugs
}

feature_internal_ids = (
    set(kegg_pair["drug_A_id"].astype(int))
    |
    set(kegg_pair["drug_B_id"].astype(int))
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("INTERNAL ID COMPATIBILITY")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    "MASTER drugs mapped to internal IDs:",
    len(master_internal_ids)
)

print(
    "Feature internal drug IDs:",
    len(feature_internal_ids)
)

print(
    "Mapped MASTER IDs missing from features:",
    len(master_internal_ids - feature_internal_ids)
)

print(
    "Feature IDs not represented by MASTER:",
    len(feature_internal_ids - master_internal_ids)
)

assert (
    master_internal_ids == feature_internal_ids
), (
    "MASTER NSCs do not map exactly to the 104 feature internal IDs."
)

print(
    "\nPASS — MASTER NSCs map exactly to "
    "the 104 internal feature drug IDs."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# DISPLAY MAPPING
# ------------------------------------------------------------

mapping_check = (
    drug_map[
        drug_map["NSC"].isin(master_drugs)
    ][
        ["NSC", "drug_id", "Drug_Name"]
    ]
    .drop_duplicates()
    .sort_values("NSC")
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MASTER NSC -> INTERNAL DRUG ID")
print("=" * 70)

print(mapping_check.to_string(index=False))

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("PASS — EXISTING DRUG ID MAPPING VALIDATED")
