# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("VALIDATING MODEL INPUTS")
print("=" * 70)

assert X.shape == (294073, 64)
assert len(y) == 294073

ROW_COLS = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",

    "cellminer_cellline_id",

master_keys = pd.util.hash_pandas_object(
    MASTER_MODEL[ROW_COLS].astype(str),
    index=False
).to_numpy(dtype=np.uint64)

assert len(master_keys) == 294073
assert len(np.unique(master_keys)) == 294073

master_key_to_index = {
    key: i
    for i, key in enumerate(master_keys)
}

print("\nPASS — MASTER rows have unique identifiers")


# ============================================================
# 7. MAP SPLIT ROWS TO X/y
# ============================================================

def get_indices(df, split_name, subset_name):

    keys = pd.util.hash_pandas_object(
        df[ROW_COLS].astype(str),
        index=False
    ).to_numpy(dtype=np.uint64)

    missing = [
        key
        for key in keys
        if key not in master_key_to_index
    ]

    assert len(missing) == 0, (
        f"{split_name} {subset_name}: "
        f"{len(missing)} rows are not in MASTER."
    )

    indices = np.array(
        [
            master_key_to_index[key]
            for key in keys
        ],
        dtype=np.int64
    )

    assert len(indices) == len(df)

    return indices


split_indices = {}

for split_name, data in split_data.items():

    train_idx = get_indices(
        data["train"],
        split_name,
        "TRAIN"
    )

    val_idx = get_indices(
        data["val"],
        split_name,
        "VAL"
    )

    test_idx = get_indices(
        data["test"],
        split_name,
        "TEST"
    )

    # No row leakage
    assert len(
        set(train_idx) & set(val_idx)
    ) == 0

    assert len(
        set(train_idx) & set(test_idx)
    ) == 0

    assert len(
        set(val_idx) & set(test_idx)
    ) == 0

    # Exact partition for all except Cold Drug
    combined = np.concatenate([
        train_idx,
        val_idx,
        test_idx
    ])

    assert len(np.unique(combined)) == len(combined)

    if split_name != "COLD_DRUG":

        assert len(combined) == 294073

    split_indices[split_name] = {
        "train": train_idx,
        "val": val_idx,
        "test": test_idx
    }

    print(
        f"{split_name}: "
        f"{len(train_idx)} / "
        f"{len(val_idx)} / "
        f"{len(test_idx)}"
    )


print("\nPASS — ALL SPLIT ROW INDICES VALID")


# ============================================================
# 8. VERIFY COLD-SPLIT REQUIREMENTS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("VERIFYING SPLIT-SPECIFIC LEAKAGE RULES")
print("=" * 70)


def get_drugs(df):

    return set(
        pd.concat([
            df["drug_A"],
            df["drug_B"]
        ])
        .astype(int)
        .unique()
    )


def get_cells(df):

    return set(
        df["CELLNAME"]
        .astype(str)
        .unique()
    )


def get_pairs(df):

    pairs = set()

    for a, b in zip(
        df["drug_A"],
        df["drug_B"]
    ):

        a = int(float(a))
        b = int(float(b))

        pairs.add(
            (min(a, b), max(a, b))
        )

    return pairs

    len(
        get_pairs(data["train"])
        & get_pairs(data["val"])
    )
    >= 0
)

print("RANDOM: PASS")


# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------

data = split_data["COLD_COMBINATION"]

    get_pairs(data["train"])
    & get_pairs(data["val"])

    get_pairs(data["train"])
    & get_pairs(data["test"])

print("COLD_COMBINATION: PASS")

assert not val_cells & test_cells

assert not val_drugs & test_drugs

# ============================================================
# 9. CATBOOST PARAMETERS
# ============================================================

CATBOOST_PARAMS = {
    "loss_function": "RMSE",
    "eval_metric": "RMSE",

    "iterations": 500,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "depth": 8,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 3,

    "random_seed": 42,

    "verbose": 100,

    "allow_writing_files": False
}


# ============================================================
# 10. METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        )
    )

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    r2 = r2_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    if (
        np.std(y_true) == 0
        or np.std(y_pred) == 0
    ):

        pearson = np.nan

    else:

        pearson = pearsonr(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        )[0]

    return {
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "R2": r2,
        "Pearson": pearson
    }


# ============================================================
# 11. TRAIN CATBOOST ON ALL FOUR SPLITS
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("TRAINING CATBOOST BASELINES")
print("=" * 70)

baseline_models = {}
baseline_results = {}

for split_name in [
    "RANDOM",
    "COLD_COMBINATION",
    "COLD_CELL",
    "COLD_DRUG"
]:

    print("\n")
    print("#" * 70)
    print(f"TRAINING: {split_name}")
    print("#" * 70)

    idx = split_indices[split_name]

    train_idx = idx["train"]
    val_idx = idx["val"]
    test_idx = idx["test"]

    X_train = X_np[train_idx]
    y_train = y_np[train_idx]

    X_val = X_np[val_idx]
    y_val = y_np[val_idx]

    X_test = X_np[test_idx]
    y_test = y_np[test_idx]

    print("\nTraining matrix:", X_train.shape)
    print("Validation matrix:", X_val.shape)
    print("Test matrix:", X_test.shape)

    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        **CATBOOST_PARAMS
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train,
        eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
        use_best_model=True
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PREDICTIONS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    train_pred = model.predict(X_train)
    val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
    test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # METRICS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    train_metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_train,
        train_pred
    )

    val_metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_val,
        val_pred
    )

    test_metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_test,
        test_pred
    )

    baseline_models[split_name] = model

    baseline_results[split_name] = {
        "train": train_metrics,
        "val": val_metrics,
        "test": test_metrics,
        "best_iteration":
            model.get_best_iteration()
    }

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # PRINT RESULTS
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    print("\n" + "-" * 70)
    print(f"{split_name} RESULTS")
    print("-" * 70)

    print(
        "Best iteration:",
        model.get_best_iteration()
    )

    for subset, metrics in [
        ("TRAIN", train_metrics),
        ("VAL", val_metrics),
        ("TEST", test_metrics)
    ]:

        print(
            f"{subset:6s} | "
            f"RMSE={metrics['RMSE']:.4f} | "
            f"MAE={metrics['MAE']:.4f} | "
            f"R2={metrics['R2']:.4f} | "
            f"Pearson={metrics['Pearson']:.4f}"
        )

    gc.collect()


# ============================================================

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)
    )

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_true,

    r2 = r2_score(
        y_true,

        pearson = np.nan
    else:
        pearson = pearsonr(
            y_true,

        )[0]

    return {

        "MAE": mae,
        "R2": r2,
        "Pearson": pearson
    }

        train_idx = split_data["train_idx"]
        val_idx = split_data["val_idx"]

        X_train = X.iloc[train_idx][feature_list]
        X_val = X.iloc[val_idx][feature_list]
        X_test = X.iloc[test_idx][feature_list]

        y_train = y.iloc[train_idx]
        y_val = y.iloc[val_idx]
        y_test = y.iloc[test_idx]

        print("Train:", X_train.shape)
        print("Val  :", X_val.shape)
        print("Test :", X_test.shape)

        # ----------------------------------------------------

        # ----------------------------------------------------

        model = CatBoostRegressor(
            **catboost_params
        )

        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
            eval_set=(X_val, y_val),

        train_pred = model.predict(X_train)
        val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
        test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Metrics
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        for subset, y_true, pred in [
            ("TRAIN", y_train, train_pred),
            ("VAL", y_val, val_pred),
            ("TEST", y_test, test_pred)
        ]:

            metrics = calculate_metrics(
                y_true,
                pred
            )

            row = {
                "Experiment": experiment_name,
                "Split": split_name,
                "Subset": subset,
                "Features": len(feature_list),
                "RMSE": metrics["RMSE"],
                "MAE": metrics["MAE"],
                "R2": metrics["R2"],
                "Pearson": metrics["Pearson"],
                "Best_Iteration": model.get_best_iteration()
            }

            ablation_results.append(row)

        # Store model
        ablation_models[
            f"{experiment_name}_{split_name}"
        ] = model

        # Print test result
        test_metrics = calculate_metrics(
            y_test,
            test_pred
        )

        print(
            f"TEST | "
            f"RMSE={test_metrics['RMSE']:.4f} | "
            f"MAE={test_metrics['MAE']:.4f} | "
            f"R2={test_metrics['R2']:.4f} | "
            f"Pearson={test_metrics['Pearson']:.4f}"
        )


# ============================================================
# 8. RESULTS DATAFRAME
# ============================================================

ablation_results_df = pd.DataFrame(
    ablation_results
)


# ============================================================
# 9. TEST-SET SUMMARY
# ============================================================

ablation_test_results = (
    ablation_results_df[
        ablation_results_df["Subset"] == "TEST"
    ]
    .sort_values(
        ["Split", "RMSE"],
        ascending=[True, True]
    )
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)


print("\n")
print("=" * 70)
print("FEATURE ABLATION — TEST RESULTS")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    ablation_test_results[
        [
            "Experiment",
            "Split",
            "Features",
            "RMSE",
            "MAE",
            "R2",
            "Pearson",
            "Best_Iteration"
        ]
    ].to_string(index=False)
)


# ============================================================
# 10. SAVE OBJECTS IN MEMORY
# ============================================================

print("\n")
print("=" * 70)
print("ABLATION STUDY COMPLETE")
print("=" * 70)

print("Models:", len(ablation_models))
print("Result rows:", len(ablation_results_df))

print("\nObjects now available:")
print("ablation_models")
print("ablation_results")
print("ablation_results_df")
print("ablation_test_results")

print("\nPASS — FEATURE ABLATION COMPLETE")

assert "MASTER_MODEL" in globals(), (

)

    "X is not in memory."

assert X.shape == (294073, 64)
assert len(y) == 294073

print("\nMASTER_MODEL:", MASTER_MODEL.shape)
print("X:", X.shape)
print("y:", y.shape)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE MASTER ROW IDENTIFIER

master_key_cols = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id",
    "nci_almanac_cellname"
]

assert all(
    c in MASTER_MODEL.columns
    for c in master_key_cols
)

master_keys = MASTER_MODEL[
    master_key_cols
].astype(str).agg(
    "||".join,
    axis=1
)

assert not master_keys.duplicated().any()

master_key_to_idx = pd.Series(
    np.arange(len(MASTER_MODEL)),
    index=master_keys
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

splits = {}

for split_name, path in split_paths.items():

    print("\n" + "-" * 70)
    print(split_name)
    print(path)
    print("-" * 70)

    assert os.path.isdir(path), (
        f"Existing split directory not found: {path}"
    )

    train_path = os.path.join(path, "train.csv")
    val_path = os.path.join(path, "val.csv")
    test_path = os.path.join(path, "test.csv")

    assert os.path.isfile(train_path), train_path
    assert os.path.isfile(val_path), val_path
    assert os.path.isfile(test_path), test_path

    train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    val = pd.read_csv(val_path)
    test = pd.read_csv(test_path)

    print("Train:", train.shape)
    print("Val  :", val.shape)
    print("Test :", test.shape)

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Validate required columns
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    for df_name, df in [
        ("train", train),
        ("val", val),
        ("test", test)
    ]:

        missing = [
            c for c in master_key_cols
            if c not in df.columns
        ]

        assert len(missing) == 0, (
            f"{split_name} {df_name}: missing {missing}"
        )

        assert not df.duplicated().any(), (
            f"{split_name} {df_name}: duplicate rows found"
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Convert each split to MASTER indices
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    def get_indices(df, name):

        keys = df[
            master_key_cols
        ].astype(str).agg(
            "||".join,
            axis=1
        )

        missing = ~keys.isin(master_key_to_idx.index)

        assert not missing.any(), (
            f"{split_name} {name}: "
            f"{missing.sum()} rows not found in MASTER"
        )

        indices = (
            master_key_to_idx
            .loc[keys]
            .to_numpy()
        )

        assert len(indices) == len(df)

        return indices

    train_idx = get_indices(train, "TRAIN")
    val_idx = get_indices(val, "VAL")
    test_idx = get_indices(test, "TEST")

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Check cross-split leakage
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    train_set = set(train_idx)
    val_set = set(val_idx)
    test_set = set(test_idx)

    assert len(train_set & val_set) == 0
    assert len(train_set & test_set) == 0
    assert len(val_set & test_set) == 0

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Store
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    splits[split_name] = {
        "train": train,
        "val": val,
        "test": test,
        "train_idx": train_idx,
        "val_idx": val_idx,
        "test_idx": test_idx,
    }

    print(
        "Indices:",
        len(train_idx),
        len(val_idx),
        len(test_idx)
    )

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("PASS — ALL 4 EXISTING SPLITS RELOADED")
print("=" * 70)

for name, s in splits.items():

    print(
        f"{name}: "
        f"{len(s['train_idx'])} / "
        f"{len(s['val_idx'])} / "
        f"{len(s['test_idx'])}"
    )

import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

split_paths = {

    "COLD_COMBINATION": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_combination",
    "COLD_CELL": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_cell_line",
    "COLD_DRUG": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug",
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# CHECK MODEL OBJECTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assert "MASTER_MODEL" in globals()
assert "X" in globals()
assert "y" in globals()

assert MASTER_MODEL.shape == (294073, 73)
assert X.shape == (294073, 64)
assert len(y) == 294073

print("MASTER_MODEL:", MASTER_MODEL.shape)
print("X:", X.shape)
print("y:", y.shape)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# MASTER IDENTIFIER COLUMNS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

master_key_cols = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id",
    "nci_almanac_cellname"
]

assert all(
    c in MASTER_MODEL.columns
    for c in master_key_cols
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# NORMALIZE IDENTIFIER VALUES
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def normalize_key_dataframe(df):

    out = df[master_key_cols].copy()

    # Numeric columns
    numeric_cols = [
        "drug_A",
        "drug_B",
        "combo_score",
        "CONC1",
        "CONC2"
    ]

    for col in numeric_cols:
        out[col] = pd.to_numeric(
            out[col],
            errors="coerce"
        )

    # String columns
    string_cols = [
        "CELLNAME",
        "tissue",
        "cellminer_cellline_id",
        "nci_almanac_cellname"
    ]

    for col in string_cols:
        out[col] = out[col].fillna("<NA>").astype(str)

    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BUILD MASTER MULTIINDEX
# ------------------------------------------------------------

master_norm = normalize_key_dataframe(
    MASTER_MODEL
)

master_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_frame(
    master_norm
)

assert not master_index.duplicated().any()

print("\nPASS — MASTER rows have unique identifiers")


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FUNCTION TO MATCH SPLIT ROWS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def get_master_indices(df, split_name, subset_name):

    normalized = normalize_key_dataframe(df)

    split_index = pd.MultiIndex.from_frame(
        normalized
    )

    # Find rows that do not exist in MASTER
    missing_mask = ~split_index.isin(master_index)

    assert not missing_mask.any(), (
        f"{split_name} {subset_name}: "
        f"{missing_mask.sum()} rows not found in MASTER"
    )

    # Map MultiIndex positions
    master_positions = pd.Series(
        np.arange(len(master_index)),
        index=master_index
    )

    indices = master_positions.loc[
        split_index
    ].to_numpy()

    assert len(indices) == len(df)

    return indices


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD ALL EXISTING SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ============================================================
# TRUSTSYN — FEATURE ABLATION STUDY

import numpy as np

from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    mean_squared_error,
    mean_absolute_error,
    r2_score
)
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — FEATURE ABLATION STUDY")
print("=" * 70)


# ============================================================
# 1. SANITY CHECK CURRENT NOTEBOOK STATE
# ============================================================

assert "MASTER_MODEL" in globals()
assert "X" in globals()
assert "y" in globals()
assert "splits" in globals()

# ============================================================
# 2. DEFINE FEATURE GROUPS

cellminer_features = [

    if f not in X.columns
]

    f"Missing features: {missing_features}"
)

# ============================================================

ablation_experiments = {

    "CELLMINER_ONLY":
        cellminer_features,

    "DRUG_ONLY":
        drug_features,

    "CELLMINER_STRING":
        cellminer_features + string_features,

    "CELLMINER_KEGG":
        cellminer_features + kegg_features,

    "CELLMINER_STRUCTURE":

    "ALL_FEATURES":
        all_features
}

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ABLATION EXPERIMENTS")
print("=" * 70)

for name, features in ablation_experiments.items():
    print(f"{name:25s}: {len(features)} features")


# ============================================================
# 5. EXISTING VALIDATED SPLITS
# ============================================================

split_objects = {
    "RANDOM": splits["RANDOM"],
    "COLD_COMBINATION": splits["COLD_COMBINATION"],
    "COLD_CELL": splits["COLD_CELL"],
    "COLD_DRUG": splits["COLD_DRUG"]
}

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("SPLIT SIZES")
print("=" * 70)

for split_name, split_data in split_objects.items():

    print(
        f"{split_name:20s} | "
        f"Train={len(split_data['train_idx'])} | "
        f"Val={len(split_data['val_idx'])} | "
        f"Test={len(split_data['test_idx'])}"
    )


# ============================================================
# 6. METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)
    )

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    r2 = r2_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    if (
        np.std(y_true) == 0
        or np.std(y_pred) == 0
    ):
        pearson = np.nan
    else:
        pearson = pearsonr(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        )[0]

    return {
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "R2": r2,
        "Pearson": pearson
    }


# ============================================================
# 7. FIXED CATBOOST BASELINE
# ============================================================

catboost_params = {
    "iterations": 500,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "depth": 8,
    "loss_function": "RMSE",
    "random_seed": 42,
    "verbose": False,
    "allow_writing_files": False
}


# ============================================================
# 8. RUN ABLATION
# ============================================================

ablation_results = []
ablation_models = {}

total_models = (
    len(ablation_experiments)
    * len(split_objects)
)

model_counter = 0

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print(f"STARTING ABLATION — {total_models} MODELS")
print("=" * 70)


for experiment_name, feature_list in ablation_experiments.items():

    print("\n")
    print("#" * 70)
    print(f"EXPERIMENT: {experiment_name}")
    print(f"FEATURES: {len(feature_list)}")
    print("#" * 70)

    for split_name, split_data in split_objects.items():

        model_counter += 1

        print("\n" + "-" * 70)
        print(
            f"MODEL {model_counter}/{total_models} | "
            f"{experiment_name} | {split_name}"
        )
        print("-" * 70)

        train_idx = split_data["train_idx"]
        val_idx = split_data["val_idx"]
        test_idx = split_data["test_idx"]

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Extract features using MASTER indices
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        X_train = X.iloc[train_idx][feature_list]
        X_val = X.iloc[val_idx][feature_list]
        X_test = X.iloc[test_idx][feature_list]

        y_train = y.iloc[train_idx]
        y_val = y.iloc[val_idx]
        y_test = y.iloc[test_idx]

        print(
            "Train:", X_train.shape,
            "| Val:", X_val.shape,
            "| Test:", X_test.shape
        )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Train CatBoost
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        model = CatBoostRegressor(
            **catboost_params
        )

        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
            eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
            early_stopping_rounds=50,
            verbose=False
        )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Predictions
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        train_pred = model.predict(X_train)
        val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
        test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Calculate metrics
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        for subset, y_true, predictions in [

            ("TRAIN", y_train, train_pred),
            ("VAL", y_val, val_pred),
            ("TEST", y_test, test_pred)

        ]:

            metrics = calculate_metrics(
                y_true,
                predictions
            )

            ablation_results.append({

                "Experiment":
                    experiment_name,

                "Split":
                    split_name,

                "Subset":
                    subset,

                "Features":
                    len(feature_list),

                "RMSE":
                    metrics["RMSE"],

                "MAE":
                    metrics["MAE"],

                "R2":
                    metrics["R2"],

                "Pearson":
                    metrics["Pearson"],

                "Best_Iteration":
                    model.get_best_iteration()
            })

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Keep model in memory
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        ablation_models[
            f"{experiment_name}_{split_name}"
        ] = model

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # Print TEST performance
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        test_metrics = calculate_metrics(
            y_test,
            test_pred
        )

        print(
            f"TEST | "
            f"RMSE={test_metrics['RMSE']:.4f} | "
            f"MAE={test_metrics['MAE']:.4f} | "
            f"R2={test_metrics['R2']:.4f} | "
            f"Pearson={test_metrics['Pearson']:.4f}"
        )


# ============================================================
# 9. CREATE RESULTS DATAFRAME
# ============================================================

ablation_results_df = pd.DataFrame(
    ablation_results
)


# ============================================================
# 10. TEST-SET RESULTS ONLY
# ============================================================

ablation_test_results = (
    ablation_results_df[
        ablation_results_df["Subset"] == "TEST"
    ]
    .sort_values(
        ["Split", "RMSE"],
        ascending=[True, True]
    )
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)


# ============================================================
# 11. DISPLAY TEST RESULTS
# ============================================================

print("\n")
print("=" * 70)
print("FEATURE ABLATION — TEST RESULTS")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    ablation_test_results[
        [
            "Experiment",
            "Split",
            "Features",
            "RMSE",
            "MAE",
            "R2",
            "Pearson",
            "Best_Iteration"
        ]
    ].to_string(index=False)
)


# ============================================================
# 12. CREATE SUMMARY TABLE
# ============================================================

ablation_summary = (
    ablation_test_results
    .groupby("Experiment")
    .agg(
        Mean_RMSE=("RMSE", "mean"),
        Mean_MAE=("MAE", "mean"),

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — LEAVE-ONE-GROUP-OUT ABLATION")
print("=" * 70)


# ============================================================
# 1. FEATURE GROUPS ALREADY DEFINED
# ============================================================

# These should already exist from the previous cell.
assert "cellminer_features" in globals()
assert "string_features" in globals()
assert "kegg_features" in globals()
assert "structure_features" in globals()
assert "target_features" in globals()
assert "all_features" in globals()

assert len(all_features) == 64


# ============================================================
# 2. DEFINE LEAVE-ONE-GROUP-OUT EXPERIMENTS
# ============================================================

loo_experiments = {

    "ALL_FEATURES":
        all_features,

    "ALL_MINUS_CELLMINER":
        [
            f for f in all_features
            if f not in cellminer_features
        ],

    "ALL_MINUS_STRING":
        [
            f for f in all_features
            if f not in string_features
        ],

    "ALL_MINUS_KEGG":
        [
            f for f in all_features
            if f not in kegg_features
        ],

    "ALL_MINUS_STRUCTURE":
        [
            f for f in all_features
            if f not in structure_features
        ],

    "ALL_MINUS_TARGET":
        [
            f for f in all_features
            if f not in target_features
        ]
}


# ============================================================
# 3. VERIFY FEATURE COUNTS
# ============================================================

print("\nFEATURE COUNTS")
print("-" * 70)

for name, features in loo_experiments.items():
    print(f"{name:25s}: {len(features)}")

assert len(loo_experiments["ALL_FEATURES"]) == 64
assert len(loo_experiments["ALL_MINUS_CELLMINER"]) == 14
assert len(loo_experiments["ALL_MINUS_STRING"]) == 62
assert len(loo_experiments["ALL_MINUS_KEGG"]) == 63
assert len(loo_experiments["ALL_MINUS_STRUCTURE"]) == 61
assert len(loo_experiments["ALL_MINUS_TARGET"]) == 56

print("\nPASS — leave-one-group-out feature sets verified")


# ============================================================
# 4. USE SAME FOUR EXISTING SPLITS
# ============================================================

split_objects = {
    "RANDOM": splits["RANDOM"],
    "COLD_COMBINATION": splits["COLD_COMBINATION"],
    "COLD_CELL": splits["COLD_CELL"],
    "COLD_DRUG": splits["COLD_DRUG"]
}


# ============================================================
# 5. SAME CATBOOST CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

catboost_params = {
    "iterations": 500,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "depth": 8,
    "loss_function": "RMSE",
    "random_seed": 42,
    "verbose": False,
    "allow_writing_files": False
}


# ============================================================
# 6. METRIC FUNCTION
# ============================================================

def calculate_loo_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        np.mean(
            (np.asarray(y_true) - np.asarray(y_pred)) ** 2
        )
    )

    mae = np.mean(
        np.abs(
            np.asarray(y_true) - np.asarray(y_pred)
        )
    )

    ss_res = np.sum(
        (np.asarray(y_true) - np.asarray(y_pred)) ** 2
    )

    ss_tot = np.sum(
        (np.asarray(y_true) - np.mean(y_true)) ** 2
    )

    r2 = (
        1 - ss_res / ss_tot
        if ss_tot != 0
        else np.nan
    )

    if (
        np.std(y_true) == 0
        or np.std(y_pred) == 0
    ):
        pearson = np.nan
    else:
        pearson = np.corrcoef(
            np.asarray(y_true),
            np.asarray(y_pred)
        )[0, 1]

    return rmse, mae, r2, pearson


# ============================================================
# 7. RUN LEAVE-ONE-GROUP-OUT ABLATION
# ============================================================

loo_results = []
loo_models = {}

total_models = (
    len(loo_experiments)
    * len(split_objects)
)

counter = 0

for experiment_name, feature_list in loo_experiments.items():

    print("\n")
    print("#" * 70)
    print(
        f"EXPERIMENT: {experiment_name} "
        f"({len(feature_list)} FEATURES)"
    )
    print("#" * 70)

    for split_name, split_data in split_objects.items():

        counter += 1

        print("\n" + "-" * 70)
        print(
            f"MODEL {counter}/{total_models} | "
            f"{experiment_name} | {split_name}"
        )
        print("-" * 70)

        train_idx = split_data["train_idx"]
        val_idx = split_data["val_idx"]
        test_idx = split_data["test_idx"]

        X_train = X.iloc[
            train_idx
        ][feature_list]

        X_val = X.iloc[
            val_idx
        ][feature_list]

        X_test = X.iloc[
            test_idx
        ][feature_list]

        y_train = y.iloc[train_idx]
        y_val = y.iloc[val_idx]
        y_test = y.iloc[test_idx]

        model = CatBoostRegressor(
            **catboost_params
        )

        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
            eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
            early_stopping_rounds=50,
            verbose=False
        )

        test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

        rmse, mae, r2, pearson = calculate_loo_metrics(
            y_test,
            test_pred
        )

        loo_results.append({

            "Experiment":
                experiment_name,

            "Split":
                split_name,

            "Features":
                len(feature_list),

            "RMSE":
                rmse,

            "MAE":
                mae,

            "R2":
                r2,

            "Pearson":
                pearson,

            "Best_Iteration":
                model.get_best_iteration()
        })

        loo_models[
            f"{experiment_name}_{split_name}"
        ] = model

        print(
            f"TEST | "
            f"RMSE={rmse:.4f} | "
            f"MAE={mae:.4f} | "
            f"R2={r2:.4f} | "
            f"Pearson={pearson:.4f}"
        )


# ============================================================

# ============================================================

loo_results_df = pd.DataFrame(
    loo_results
)

print("\n")
print("=" * 70)
print("LEAVE-ONE-GROUP-OUT RESULTS")
print("=" * 70)

    loo_results_df
    .sort_values(
        ["Split", "RMSE"]
    )
    .to_string(index=False)
)

loo_summary = (

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — FEATURE REDUNDANCY AUDIT")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Use the final 64-feature set
# ------------------------------------------------------------

feature_matrix = X[all_features].copy()

print("\nFeature matrix:", feature_matrix.shape)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Correlation matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

corr_matrix = feature_matrix.corr()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract upper triangle only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

upper = corr_matrix.where(
    np.triu(
        np.ones(corr_matrix.shape),
        k=1
    ).astype(bool)
)

high_corr_pairs = (
    upper
    .stack()
    .reset_index()
)

high_corr_pairs.columns = [
    "Feature_1",
    "Feature_2",
    "Correlation"
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Absolute correlation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

high_corr_pairs["Abs_Correlation"] = (
    high_corr_pairs["Correlation"]
    .abs()
)

high_corr_pairs = (
    high_corr_pairs
    .sort_values(
        "Abs_Correlation",
        ascending=False
    )
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Report thresholds
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("HIGHLY CORRELATED FEATURE PAIRS")
print("=" * 70)

for threshold in [0.95, 0.90, 0.80]:

    pairs = high_corr_pairs[
        high_corr_pairs["Abs_Correlation"] >= threshold
    ]

    print(
        f"\n|r| >= {threshold}: "
        f"{len(pairs)} pairs"
    )

    if len(pairs) > 0:

        print(
            pairs[
                [
                    "Feature_1",
                    "Feature_2",
                    "Correlation"
                ]
            ]
            .head(30)
            .to_string(index=False)
        )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Feature variance
# ------------------------------------------------------------

feature_variances = (
    feature_matrix
    .var()
    .sort_values()
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("LOW-VARIANCE FEATURES")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    feature_variances
    .head(20)
    .to_string()
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Constant features
# ------------------------------------------------------------

constant_features = [
    col
    for col in feature_matrix.columns
    if feature_matrix[col].nunique(dropna=False) <= 1
]

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("CONSTANT FEATURES")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    "Count:",
    len(constant_features)
)

if constant_features:
    print(constant_features)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Final status
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("REDUNDANCY AUDIT COMPLETE")
print("=" * 70)

import numpy as np

print("=" * 70)
print("VERIFYING TANIMOTO FEATURE RELATIONSHIPS")
print("=" * 70)

sim = X["Tanimoto_similarity"]
dist = X["Tanimoto_distance"]
sim_lower = X["tanimoto_similarity"]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check exact equality
# ------------------------------------------------------------

same_similarity = np.array_equal(
    sim.to_numpy(),
    sim_lower.to_numpy()
)

print("\nTanimoto_similarity == tanimoto_similarity:")
print(same_similarity)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Check distance = 1 - similarity
# ------------------------------------------------------------

distance_relationship = np.allclose(
    dist.to_numpy(),
    1.0 - sim.to_numpy(),
    equal_nan=True
)

print("\nTanimoto_distance == 1 - Tanimoto_similarity:")
print(distance_relationship)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Maximum numerical differences
# ------------------------------------------------------------

similarity_difference = np.max(
    np.abs(
        sim.to_numpy()
        -
        sim_lower.to_numpy()
    )
)

distance_difference = np.max(
    np.abs(
        dist.to_numpy()
        -
        (1.0 - sim.to_numpy())
    )
)

print("\nMaximum similarity difference:")
print(similarity_difference)

print("\nMaximum distance relationship difference:")
print(distance_difference)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Unique counts
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\nUnique values:")
print(
    "Tanimoto_similarity :",
    X["Tanimoto_similarity"].nunique()
)

print(
    "tanimoto_similarity :",
    X["tanimoto_similarity"].nunique()
)

print(
    "Tanimoto_distance   :",
    X["Tanimoto_distance"].nunique()
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("TANIMOTO VERIFICATION COMPLETE")
print("=" * 70)

# ============================================================
# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST HYPERPARAMETER OPTIMIZATION
# RANDOM SPLIT — TRAIN/VALIDATION ONLY
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import optuna

from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    mean_squared_error,
    mean_absolute_error,
    r2_score
)
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST HYPERPARAMETER OPTIMIZATION")
print("=" * 70)

# ============================================================
# 1. VERIFY REQUIRED OBJECTS
# ============================================================

required_objects = [
    "X_clean",
    "y",
    "splits",
    "MASTER_MODEL"
]

missing_objects = [
    obj for obj in required_objects
    if obj not in globals()
]

assert len(missing_objects) == 0, (
    f"Missing objects: {missing_objects}"
)

assert X_clean.shape == (294073, 62)
assert len(y) == 294073

print("\nPASS — required objects are in memory")

# ============================================================
# 2. USE EXISTING RANDOM SPLIT
# ============================================================

random_split = splits["RANDOM"]

train_idx = random_split["train_idx"]
val_idx = random_split["val_idx"]

X_train_opt = X_clean.iloc[train_idx]
X_val_opt = X_clean.iloc[val_idx]

y_train_opt = y.iloc[train_idx]
y_val_opt = y.iloc[val_idx]

print("\nRANDOM SPLIT")
print("-" * 70)

print(
    "Train:",
    X_train_opt.shape,
    "|",
    y_train_opt.shape
)

print(
    "Val  :",
    X_val_opt.shape,
    "|",
    y_val_opt.shape
)

# ============================================================
# 3. OPTUNA OBJECTIVE
# ============================================================

def objective(trial):

    params = {
        "iterations": trial.suggest_int(
            "iterations",
            300,
            1200,
            step=100
        ),

        "learning_rate": trial.suggest_float(
            "learning_rate",
            0.01,
            0.15,
            log=True
        ),

        "depth": trial.suggest_int(
            "depth",
            4,
            10
        ),

        "l2_leaf_reg": trial.suggest_float(
            "l2_leaf_reg",
            1.0,
            20.0,
            log=True
        ),

        "random_strength": trial.suggest_float(
            "random_strength",
            0.0,
            5.0
        ),

        "bagging_temperature": trial.suggest_float(
            "bagging_temperature",
            0.0,
            5.0
        ),

        "border_count": trial.suggest_int(
            "border_count",
            32,
            255
        ),

        "loss_function": "RMSE",

        "random_seed": 42,

        "verbose": False,

        "allow_writing_files": False
    }

    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        **params
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train_opt,
        y_train_opt,

        eval_set=(
            X_val_opt,
            y_val_opt
        ),

        early_stopping_rounds=100,

        verbose=False
    )

    val_pred = model.predict(
        X_val_opt
    )

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(
            y_val_opt,
            val_pred
        )
    )

    return rmse


# ============================================================
# 4. CREATE OPTUNA STUDY
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("STARTING OPTUNA SEARCH")
print("=" * 70)

study = optuna.create_study(
    direction="minimize",
    study_name="TrustSyn_CatBoost_RandomSplit"
)

# ============================================================
# 5. RUN SEARCH
# ============================================================

N_TRIALS = 40

print(
    f"\nRunning {N_TRIALS} trials..."
)

study.optimize(
    objective,
    n_trials=N_TRIALS,
    show_progress_bar=True
)

# ============================================================
# 6. BEST RESULT
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("OPTUNA SEARCH COMPLETE")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    "\nBest validation RMSE:",
    study.best_value
)

print("\nBest parameters:")

for parameter, value in study.best_params.items():
    print(
        f"{parameter}: {value}"
    )

# ============================================================
# 7. OPTUNA RESULTS TABLE
# ============================================================

optuna_results = (
    study.trials_dataframe()
    .sort_values(
        "value",
        ascending=True
    )
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

print("\nTOP 10 TRIALS")
print("-" * 70)

print(
    optuna_results[
        [
            "number",
            "value",
            "params_iterations",
            "params_learning_rate",
            "params_depth",
            "params_l2_leaf_reg",
            "params_random_strength",
            "params_bagging_temperature",
            "params_border_count"
        ]
    ]
    .head(10)
    .to_string(index=False)
)

print("\nObjects now available:")
print("study")
print("optuna_results")

print("\nPASS — CATBOOST HYPERPARAMETER SEARCH COMPLETE")

# ============================================================
# TRUSTSYN — FINAL OPTIMIZED CATBOOST EVALUATION
# 62 FEATURES | EXISTING SPLITS
# ============================================================

from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, r2_score
from scipy.stats import pearsonr
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# BEST PARAMETERS FROM OPTUNA
# ------------------------------------------------------------

best_params = {
    "iterations": 1200,
    "learning_rate": 0.12174430806786882,
    "depth": 8,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 1.5896012250744225,
    "random_strength": 2.1068965384543503,
    "bagging_temperature": 0.9222943417627867,
    "border_count": 86,
    "loss_function": "RMSE",
    "verbose": False,
    "random_seed": 42
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# EVALUATION FUNCTION
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def evaluate_optimized_catboost(X_train, y_train, X_test, y_test, split_name):

    model = CatBoostRegressor(**best_params)

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train
    )

    pred = model.predict(X_test)

    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, pred))
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, pred)
    r2 = r2_score(y_test, pred)
    pearson = pearsonr(y_test, pred)[0]

    print(f"\n{'='*70}")
    print(f"OPTIMIZED CATBOOST | {split_name}")
    print(f"{'='*70}")
    print(f"Test shape : {X_test.shape}")
    print(f"RMSE       : {rmse:.4f}")
    print(f"MAE        : {mae:.4f}")
    print(f"R2         : {r2:.4f}")
    print(f"Pearson    : {pearson:.4f}")

    return {
        "Model": "Optimized_CatBoost",
        "Split": split_name,
        "Features": X_train.shape[1],
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "R2": r2,
        "Pearson": pearson,
        "Model_Object": model
    }


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# RUN ON THE EXISTING FOUR SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

optimized_results = []

optimized_results.append(
    evaluate_optimized_catboost(
        X_train_random,
        y_train_random,
        X_test_random,
        y_test_random,
        "RANDOM"
    )
)

optimized_results.append(
    evaluate_optimized_catboost(
        X_train_cold_combination,
        y_train_cold_combination,
        X_test_cold_combination,
        y_test_cold_combination,
        "COLD_COMBINATION"
    )
)

optimized_results.append(
    evaluate_optimized_catboost(
        X_train_cold_cell,
        y_train_cold_cell,
        X_test_cold_cell,
        y_test_cold_cell,
        "COLD_CELL"
    )
)

optimized_results.append(
    evaluate_optimized_catboost(
        X_train_cold_drug,
        y_train_cold_drug,
        X_test_cold_drug,
        y_test_cold_drug,
        "COLD_DRUG"
    )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

optimized_results_df = pd.DataFrame(optimized_results)

optimized_results_df = optimized_results_df[
    ["Model", "Split", "Features", "RMSE", "MAE", "R2", "Pearson"]
]

print("\n")
print("=" * 90)
print("TRUSTSYN — OPTIMIZED CATBOOST TEST RESULTS")
print("=" * 90)

display(
    optimized_results_df.sort_values("RMSE")
)

# TRUSTSYN — OPTIMIZED CATBOOST EVALUATION

# ================================================================

import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, r2_score
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. CHECK REQUIRED OBJECTS
# ------------------------------------------------

assert "X_clean" in globals(), "X_clean not found"
assert "clean_features" in globals(), "clean_features not found"

print("PASS — X_clean and clean_features are available")
print(f"Feature matrix: {X_clean.shape}")
print(f"Number of features: {len(clean_features)}")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. OPTUNA-BEST PARAMETERS
# ------------------------------------------------

best_params = {
    "iterations": 1200,
    "learning_rate": 0.12174430806786882,
    "depth": 8,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 1.5896012250744225,
    "random_strength": 2.1068965384543503,
    "bagging_temperature": 0.9222943417627867,
    "border_count": 86
}

print("\nOPTUNA-BEST PARAMETERS")
print("-" * 60)

for k, v in best_params.items():
    print(f"{k}: {v}")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. FROZEN SPLIT PATHS
# ------------------------------------------------

BASE_SPLITS = "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits"

split_paths = {
    "RANDOM": os.path.join(BASE_SPLITS, "random"),
    "COLD_COMBINATION": os.path.join(BASE_SPLITS, "cold_combination"),
    "COLD_CELL": os.path.join(BASE_SPLITS, "cold_cell_line"),
    "COLD_DRUG": os.path.join(BASE_SPLITS, "cold_drug")
}


# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. HELPER — CREATE FEATURE MATRIX FROM SPLIT
# ------------------------------------------------

def prepare_split(split_df):
    """
    Align a frozen split dataframe to the already-created
    62-feature X_clean matrix.

    Uses the original MASTER row index to preserve exact
    train/validation/test membership.
    """

    required_cols = [
        "drug_A",
        "drug_B",
        "CELLNAME",
        "tissue",
        "combo_score",
        "CONC1",
        "CONC2",
        "cellminer_cellline_id"
    ]

    missing = [c for c in required_cols if c not in split_df.columns]

    if missing:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Split is missing required columns: {missing}"
        )

    return split_df


# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. HELPER — MATCH SPLIT ROWS TO MASTER_MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------

# We need the same row identity used when X_clean was constructed.
# The split CSVs contain the original MASTER columns.
#
# Create a deterministic row key from the identifying columns.

KEY_COLS = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id"
]

print("\nCreating MASTER row lookup...")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. BUILD MASTER KEY
# ------------------------------------------------

# MASTER_MODEL should already exist from the feature-engineering/
# modeling workflow. We use it only as an in-memory reference.

assert "MASTER_MODEL" in globals(), (
    "MASTER_MODEL not found. "
    "Run the cell that creates MASTER_MODEL before this one."
)

assert len(MASTER_MODEL) == len(X_clean), (
    f"MASTER_MODEL rows ({len(MASTER_MODEL)}) do not match "
    f"X_clean rows ({len(X_clean)})."
)

print(f"MASTER_MODEL: {MASTER_MODEL.shape}")
print(f"X_clean      : {X_clean.shape}")


def make_key(df):
    return (
        df[KEY_COLS]
        .astype(str)
        .agg("|".join, axis=1)
    )


master_keys = make_key(MASTER_MODEL)

if master_keys.duplicated().any():
    raise ValueError(
        "MASTER_MODEL contains duplicate row keys. "
        "Cannot safely align frozen splits."
    )

master_lookup = pd.Series(
    np.arange(len(MASTER_MODEL)),
    index=master_keys
)


# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. METRIC FUNCTION
# ------------------------------------------------

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)
    )

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    r2 = r2_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    pearson = pearsonr(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )[0]

    return {
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "R2": r2,
        "Pearson": pearson
    }


# ------------------------------------------------
# 8. TRAIN + EVALUATE ALL FOUR SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------

optimized_results = []
optimized_models = {}

for split_name, split_dir in split_paths.items():

    print("\n")
    print("=" * 70)
    print(f"OPTIMIZED CATBOOST | {split_name}")
    print("=" * 70)

    train_path = os.path.join(split_dir, "train.csv")
    val_path   = os.path.join(split_dir, "val.csv")
    test_path  = os.path.join(split_dir, "test.csv")

    # -----------------------------
    # Load frozen split files
    # -----------------------------

    train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
    val_df   = pd.read_csv(val_path)
    test_df  = pd.read_csv(test_path)

    print(
        f"Train: {train_df.shape} | "
        f"Val: {val_df.shape} | "
        f"Test: {test_df.shape}"
    )

    # -----------------------------
    # Convert split rows to
    # MASTER_MODEL row indices
    # -----------------------------

    train_keys = make_key(train_df)
    val_keys   = make_key(val_df)
    test_keys  = make_key(test_df)

    train_idx = master_lookup.reindex(train_keys).values
    val_idx   = master_lookup.reindex(val_keys).values
    test_idx  = master_lookup.reindex(test_keys).values

    # -----------------------------
    # Alignment checks
    # -----------------------------

    if np.isnan(train_idx).any():
        raise ValueError(
            f"{split_name}: some train rows could not be matched "
            "to MASTER_MODEL."
        )

    if np.isnan(val_idx).any():
        raise ValueError(
            f"{split_name}: some validation rows could not be matched "
            "to MASTER_MODEL."
        )

    if np.isnan(test_idx).any():
        raise ValueError(
            f"{split_name}: some test rows could not be matched "
            "to MASTER_MODEL."
        )

    train_idx = train_idx.astype(int)
    val_idx   = val_idx.astype(int)
    test_idx  = test_idx.astype(int)

    # -----------------------------
    # Extract 62-feature matrices
    # -----------------------------

    X_train = X_clean.iloc[train_idx]
    X_val   = X_clean.iloc[val_idx]
    X_test  = X_clean.iloc[test_idx]

    y_train = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[train_idx]["combo_score"].values
    y_val   = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[val_idx]["combo_score"].values
    y_test  = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[test_idx]["combo_score"].values

    # -----------------------------
    # Verify target consistency
    # -----------------------------

    if not np.allclose(
        y_train,
        train_df["combo_score"].values
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{split_name}: train target alignment failed."
        )

    if not np.allclose(
        y_val,
        val_df["combo_score"].values
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{split_name}: validation target alignment failed."
        )

    if not np.allclose(
        y_test,
        test_df["combo_score"].values
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            f"{split_name}: test target alignment failed."
        )

    print(
        f"Aligned features: "
        f"{X_train.shape} | "
        f"{X_val.shape} | "
        f"{X_test.shape}"
    )

    # -----------------------------
    # Train optimized CatBoost
    # -----------------------------

    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        **best_params,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        eval_metric="RMSE",
        random_seed=42,
        verbose=False,
        allow_writing_files=False
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train,
        eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
        use_best_model=True,
        verbose=False
    )

    # -----------------------------
    # Test prediction
    # -----------------------------

    y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

    metrics = calculate_metrics(
        y_test,
        y_pred
    )

    best_iteration = model.get_best_iteration()

    print(
        f"\nTEST | "
        f"RMSE={metrics['RMSE']:.4f} | "
        f"MAE={metrics['MAE']:.4f} | "
        f"R2={metrics['R2']:.4f} | "
        f"Pearson={metrics['Pearson']:.4f}"
    )

    print(f"Best iteration: {best_iteration}")

    # -----------------------------
    # Save results in memory only
    # -----------------------------

    optimized_results.append({
        "Model": "CatBoost_Optimized",
        "Split": split_name,
        "Features": len(clean_features),
        "RMSE": metrics["RMSE"],
        "MAE": metrics["MAE"],
        "R2": metrics["R2"],
        "Pearson": metrics["Pearson"],
        "Best_Iteration": best_iteration
    })

    optimized_models[split_name] = model


# ------------------------------------------------
# 9. RESULTS TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------

optimized_results_df = pd.DataFrame(
    optimized_results
)

print("\n")
print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — OPTIMIZED CATBOOST RESULTS")
print("=" * 70)

display(
    optimized_results_df
)


# ------------------------------------------------
# 10. COMPARISON WITH ORIGINAL 62-FEATURE RESULTS
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n")
print("=" * 70)
print("OPTIMIZED vs PREVIOUS CATBOOST")
print("=" * 70)

display(
    optimized_results_df[
        [
            "Model",
            "Split",
            "Features",
            "RMSE",
            "MAE",
            "R2",
            "Pearson",
            "Best_Iteration"
        ]
    ]
)

print("\nPASS — optimized CatBoost evaluation complete")

#    using the SAME random split already used

# IMPORTANT:

if 'X_train_random' in globals():

    y_train_imp = y_train_random

    )

    **best_params,
    loss_function="RMSE",
    eval_metric="RMSE",

    random_seed=42,
    allow_writing_files=False
)

    X_train_imp,
    y_train_imp
)

feature_importance_df = pd.DataFrame({
    "Feature": clean_features,
    "Importance": importance_values
})

feature_importance_df = (
    feature_importance_df
    .sort_values("Importance", ascending=False)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# Percentage contribution
feature_importance_df["Importance_%"] = (
    feature_importance_df["Importance"]

)

    feature_importance_df["Importance_%"].cumsum()
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("CUMULATIVE IMPORTANCE")
print("=" * 70)

for threshold in [50, 75, 90, 95, 99]:
    n = np.argmax(

    print(
        f"{threshold}% importance reached by "
        f"{n} / {len(clean_features)} features"
    )

# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V1 FINALIZATION

from pathlib import Path
import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# CatBoost
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. VERIFY REQUIRED OBJECTS
# ------------------------------------------------

required = ["X_clean", "clean_features"]

for obj in required:
    if obj not in globals():
        raise NameError(f"Required object '{obj}' is not available.")

print("PASS — X_clean and clean_features are available")
print("X_clean shape:", X_clean.shape)
print("Number of features:", len(clean_features))


# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. LOCATE THE OPTIMIZED CATBOOST MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------

candidate_names = [
    "optimized_model",
    "catboost_model",
    "final_model",
    "model",
    "cb_model",
    "optimized_catboost"
]

model_candidates = []

for name in candidate_names:
    if name in globals():
        obj = globals()[name]
        if isinstance(obj, CatBoostRegressor):
            model_candidates.append((name, obj))

# Also search all notebook objects if necessary
if len(model_candidates) == 0:
    for name, obj in globals().items():
        try:
            if isinstance(obj, CatBoostRegressor):
                model_candidates.append((name, obj))
        except Exception:
            pass

if len(model_candidates) == 0:
    raise NameError(
        "No CatBoostRegressor object found in memory. "
        "The optimized CatBoost model must be trained before saving V1."
    )

print("\nCatBoost objects found:")
for name, obj in model_candidates:
    print(
        f"  {name}: "
        f"trees={obj.tree_count_}, "
        f"features={obj.feature_count_}"
    )


# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. SELECT THE OPTIMIZED 62-FEATURE MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------

# Expected optimized configuration
EXPECTED_FEATURES = 62
EXPECTED_ITERATIONS = 1200

matching = []

for name, obj in model_candidates:
    if obj.feature_count_ == EXPECTED_FEATURES:
        matching.append((name, obj))

if len(matching) == 0:
    raise ValueError(
        "Could not identify a 62-feature CatBoost model."
    )

# Prefer explicitly named optimized models
preferred = [
    item for item in matching
    if any(key in item[0].lower()
           for key in ["optimized", "final", "catboost"])
]

if len(preferred) >= 1:
    model_name, catboost_v1 = preferred[-1]
else:
    model_name, catboost_v1 = matching[-1]

print("\nSelected model:")
print("Variable:", model_name)
print("Features:", catboost_v1.feature_count_)
print("Trees:", catboost_v1.tree_count_)


# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. VERIFY FEATURE ORDER
# ------------------------------------------------

model_features = list(catboost_v1.feature_names_)

if model_features != list(clean_features):
    raise ValueError(
        "CRITICAL: CatBoost feature order does not match clean_features."
    )

print("PASS — model feature order matches clean_features")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. CREATE V1 METRICS TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------

v1_metrics = pd.DataFrame([
    {
        "Model": "CatBoost_V1",
        "Split": "RANDOM",
        "Features": 62,
        "RMSE": 5.656670,

        "R2": 0.348758,

    },
    {

# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V1

from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import json
import pandas as pd
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor

# ================================================================
# 1. PATHS
# ================================================================

TRUSTSYN_DIR = Path.home() / "TrustSyn"

MODELS_DIR = TRUSTSYN_DIR / "models"
RELATED_DIR = TRUSTSYN_DIR / "model_related_files"

V1_MODEL_DIR = MODELS_DIR / "CatBoost_V1"
V1_MODEL_PATH = V1_MODEL_DIR / "catboost_v1.cbm"

MODELS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
RELATED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V1 SAVE")
print("=" * 70)

print("\nTrustSyn folder:")
print(TRUSTSYN_DIR)


# ================================================================
# 2. FIND TRAINED CATBOOST MODEL
# ================================================================

model_candidates = []

for name, obj in globals().items():
    if isinstance(obj, CatBoostRegressor):
        model_candidates.append((name, obj))

print("\nCatBoost models currently in memory:")

for name, obj in model_candidates:
    print(
        f"  {name}: "
        f"trees={obj.tree_count_}, "
        f"features={len(obj.feature_names_)}"
    )

if not model_candidates:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "No CatBoostRegressor found in memory. "
        "Nothing was deleted or saved."
    )


# Prefer the optimized model if its variable exists
preferred_names = [
    "optimized_model",
    "catboost_optimized",
    "final_model",
    "model",
    "cb_model"
]

selected_model = None
selected_name = None

for preferred in preferred_names:
    for name, obj in model_candidates:
        if name == preferred:
            selected_name = name
            selected_model = obj
            break

    if selected_model is not None:
        break


# Fallback: last CatBoost object found
if selected_model is None:
    selected_name, selected_model = model_candidates[-1]

print("\nSelected model:")
print("Variable:", selected_name)
print("Trees:", selected_model.tree_count_)
print("Features:", len(selected_model.feature_names_))


# ================================================================
# 3. SAFETY CHECK — MUST BE THE 62-FEATURE MODEL
# ================================================================

if "clean_features" not in globals():
    raise RuntimeError(
        "clean_features is not available. "
        "Nothing was deleted or saved."
    )

if len(clean_features) != 62:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Expected 62 clean features, found {len(clean_features)}. "
        "Nothing was deleted or saved."
    )

if len(selected_model.feature_names_) != 62:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Selected model has {len(selected_model.feature_names_)} "
        "features instead of 62. Nothing was deleted or saved."
    )

if list(selected_model.feature_names_) != list(clean_features):
    raise RuntimeError(
        "Feature order mismatch between CatBoost model and "
        "clean_features. Nothing was deleted or saved."
    )

print("\nPASS — 62-feature model confirmed")
print("PASS — feature order confirmed")


# ================================================================
# 4. GET THE CORRECT OPTUNA PARAMETERS
# ================================================================

optuna_params = {
    "iterations": 1200,
    "learning_rate": 0.12174430806786882,
    "depth": 8,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 1.5896012250744225,
    "random_strength": 2.1068965384543503,
    "bagging_temperature": 0.9222943417627867,
    "border_count": 86
}


# ================================================================

# ================================================================

if "optimized_results" in globals():
    v1_metrics = optimized_results.copy()

elif "optimized_results_df" in globals():
    v1_metrics = optimized_results_df.copy()

else:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "Could not find optimized CatBoost evaluation results "

    )

    "Model",

    "RMSE",
    "MAE",
    "R2",

    if c not in v1_metrics.columns

if missing_columns:

        f"Metrics table is missing columns: {missing_columns}. "
        "Nothing was deleted or saved."
    )

print(v1_metrics.to_string(index=False))

from pathlib import Path
import os
import shutil
import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — SAVING CATBOOST V1")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. PATHS
# ------------------------------------------------

TRUSTSYN_DIR = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn")

MODELS_DIR = TRUSTSYN_DIR / "models"
RELATED_DIR = TRUSTSYN_DIR / "model_related_files"

MODELS_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
RELATED_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. DELETE OLD V1 ARTIFACTS ONLY
# ------------------------------------------------

old_v1_files = [
    MODELS_DIR / "CatBoost_v1.cbm",

    RELATED_DIR / "CatBoost_v1_metrics.csv",
    RELATED_DIR / "CatBoost_v1_metrics.xlsx",
    RELATED_DIR / "CatBoost_v1_feature_importance.csv",
    RELATED_DIR / "CatBoost_v1_parameters.json",
    RELATED_DIR / "CatBoost_v1_summary.txt",
]

for path in old_v1_files:
    if path.exists():
        if path.is_file():
            path.unlink()
            print("Deleted:", path)
        elif path.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(path)
            print("Deleted directory:", path)

print("\nPASS — old V1 artifacts cleared")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. IDENTIFY THE TRAINED OPTIMIZED CATBOOST MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------

model_candidates = []

for name, obj in globals().items():
    try:
        if obj.__class__.__name__ == "CatBoostRegressor":
            model_candidates.append((name, obj))
    except Exception:
        pass

print("\nCatBoost objects found:")
for name, obj in model_candidates:
    print(
        f"  {name}: "
        f"trees={getattr(obj, 'tree_count_', 'N/A')}"
    )

if not model_candidates:
    raise RuntimeError(
        "No CatBoostRegressor found in memory. "
        "Do not retrain here; load the existing optimized model first."
    )

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import optuna

from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 TPE OPTIMIZATION")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. VERIFY EXISTING OBJECTS
# ------------------------------------------------

required_objects = [
    "X_train_opt",
    "X_val_opt",
    "y_train_opt",
    "y_val_opt",
    "X_clean",
    "clean_features"
]

missing = [
    obj for obj in required_objects
    if obj not in globals()
]

if missing:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Missing required objects: {missing}"
    )

print("PASS — required objects available")

print("\nTraining matrix :", X_train_opt.shape)
print("Validation matrix:", X_val_opt.shape)
print("Features        :", len(clean_features))


# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. SAFETY CHECKS
# ------------------------------------------------

if X_train_opt.shape[1] != 62:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Expected 62 features, found {X_train_opt.shape[1]}"
    )

if X_val_opt.shape[1] != 62:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Expected 62 validation features, found {X_val_opt.shape[1]}"
    )

if list(X_train_opt.columns) != list(X_val_opt.columns):
    raise RuntimeError(
        "Training and validation feature columns are not aligned."
    )

if len(X_train_opt) != len(y_train_opt):
    raise RuntimeError("Training X/y length mismatch.")

if len(X_val_opt) != len(y_val_opt):
    raise RuntimeError("Validation X/y length mismatch.")

print("PASS — matrices aligned")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. TPE SAMPLER
# ------------------------------------------------

sampler = optuna.samplers.TPESampler(
    seed=42,
    n_startup_trials=15,
    multivariate=True,
    group=True
)

# New study — does NOT overwrite previous study
study_v2 = optuna.create_study(
    direction="minimize",
    sampler=sampler,
    study_name="TrustSyn_CatBoost_V2_TPE"
)

print("\nPASS — new TPE study created")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. OBJECTIVE
# ------------------------------------------------

def objective(trial):

    params = {
        # Core tree parameters
        "iterations": trial.suggest_int(
            "iterations",
            500,
            1800,
            step=100
        ),

        "learning_rate": trial.suggest_float(
            "learning_rate",
            0.02,
            0.20,
            log=True
        ),

        "depth": trial.suggest_int(
            "depth",
            5,
            10
        ),

        # Regularization
        "l2_leaf_reg": trial.suggest_float(
            "l2_leaf_reg",
            0.5,
            15.0,
            log=True
        ),

        "random_strength": trial.suggest_float(
            "random_strength",
            0.0,
            5.0
        ),

        "bagging_temperature": trial.suggest_float(
            "bagging_temperature",
            0.0,
            5.0
        ),

        # Feature binning
        "border_count": trial.suggest_int(
            "border_count",
            32,
            255
        ),

        # Random feature subsampling
        "rsm": trial.suggest_float(
            "rsm",
            0.65,
            1.0
        ),

        # Fixed settings
        "loss_function": "RMSE",
        "eval_metric": "RMSE",
        "bootstrap_type": "Bayesian",
        "random_seed": 42,
        "verbose": False,
        "allow_writing_files": False,
        "thread_count": -1
    }

    model = CatBoostRegressor(**params)

    model.fit(
        X_train_opt,
        y_train_opt,
        eval_set=(X_val_opt, y_val_opt),
        use_best_model=True,
        early_stopping_rounds=100,
        verbose=False
    )

    pred = model.predict(X_val_opt)

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(
            y_val_opt,
            pred
        )
    )

    # Store useful information
    trial.set_user_attr(
        "best_iteration",
        int(model.get_best_iteration())
    )

    trial.set_user_attr(
        "tree_count",
        int(model.tree_count_)
    )

    return rmse


# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. RUN OPTIMIZATION
# ------------------------------------------------

N_TRIALS_V2 = 100

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print(f"STARTING TPE SEARCH — {N_TRIALS_V2} TRIALS")
print("=" * 70)

study_v2.optimize(
    objective,
    n_trials=N_TRIALS_V2,
    show_progress_bar=True
)


# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. BEST RESULT
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("CATBOOST V2 — BEST RESULT")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    f"\nBest validation RMSE: "
    f"{study_v2.best_value:.6f}"
)

print("\nBest parameters:")

for key, value in study_v2.best_params.items():
    print(f"{key}: {value}")

print(
    "\nBest iteration:",
    study_v2.best_trial.user_attrs.get(
        "best_iteration",
        "N/A"
    )
)

print(
    "Tree count:",
    study_v2.best_trial.user_attrs.get(
        "tree_count",
        "N/A"
    )
)


# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. TOP 15 TRIALS
# ------------------------------------------------

v2_trials = study_v2.trials_dataframe()

v2_top15 = (
    v2_trials[
        [
            "number",

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, r2_score
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 FULL SPLIT EVALUATION")
print("=" * 70)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CHECK REQUIRED OBJECTS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

required_objects = [
    "X_clean",
    "clean_features",
    "y",
    "MASTER_MODEL",
    "random_split",
    "cold_test",
    "cold_train",
    "cold_val",
    "cold_cell_test",
    "cold_cell_train",
    "cold_cell_val",
]

missing = [obj for obj in required_objects if obj not in globals()]

if missing:
    raise NameError(
        f"Missing required objects: {missing}\n"
        "Do NOT create new splits. Use the existing split objects."
    )

print("PASS — required objects are available")
print(f"Full feature matrix: {X_clean.shape}")
print(f"Number of features : {len(clean_features)}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. V2 BEST PARAMETERS — FROZEN
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

V2_PARAMS = {
    "iterations": 1800,
    "learning_rate": 0.18602592172985663,
    "depth": 8,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 7.733169542565907,
    "random_strength": 0.8982903332352377,
    "bagging_temperature": 0.14927177677218426,
    "border_count": 202,
    "rsm": 0.9158767411286465,
}

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("V2 PARAMETERS")
print("=" * 70)

for k, v in V2_PARAMS.items():
    print(f"{k}: {v}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. HELPER FUNCTION
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

def evaluate_v2_split(split_name, train_df, val_df, test_df):

    print("\n" + "-" * 70)
    print(f"{split_name}")
    print("-" * 70)

    # Existing split indices
    train_idx = train_df.index.to_numpy()
    val_idx = val_df.index.to_numpy()
    test_idx = test_df.index.to_numpy()

    # -----------------------------------------------------------
    # Align features directly from frozen X_clean
    # -----------------------------------------------------------

    X_tr = X_clean.iloc[train_idx]
    X_va = X_clean.iloc[val_idx]
    X_te = X_clean.iloc[test_idx]

    y_tr = y.iloc[train_idx]
    y_va = y.iloc[val_idx]
    y_te = y.iloc[test_idx]

    print(
        f"Train: {X_tr.shape} | "
        f"Val: {X_va.shape} | "
        f"Test: {X_te.shape}"
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------
    # Build V2 model
    # -----------------------------------------------------------

    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        loss_function="RMSE",
        eval_metric="RMSE",
        random_seed=42,
        verbose=False,
        allow_writing_files=False,
        **V2_PARAMS
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------
    # Train with existing validation split
    # -----------------------------------------------------------

    model.fit(
        X_tr,
        y_tr,
        eval_set=(X_va, y_va),
        use_best_model=True,
        early_stopping_rounds=100,
        verbose=False
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------
    # Test predictions
    # -----------------------------------------------------------

    y_pred = model.predict(X_te)

    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_te, y_pred))
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_te, y_pred)
    r2 = r2_score(y_te, y_pred)

    pearson = pearsonr(y_te, y_pred)[0]
    spearman = spearmanr(y_te, y_pred).statistic

    # NRMSE using test target range
    target_range = np.max(y_te) - np.min(y_te)

    if target_range != 0:
        nrmse = rmse / target_range
    else:
        nrmse = np.nan

    best_iteration = model.get_best_iteration()

    print(
        f"TEST | "
        f"RMSE={rmse:.4f} | "
        f"MAE={mae:.4f} | "
        f"R2={r2:.4f} | "
        f"Pearson={pearson:.4f} | "
        f"Spearman={spearman:.4f}"
    )

    print(f"NRMSE={nrmse:.4f}")
    print(f"Best iteration: {best_iteration}")
    print(f"Tree count: {model.tree_count_}")

    return {
        "Model": "CatBoost_V2",
        "Split": split_name,
        "Features": len(clean_features),
        "Train_Rows": len(train_df),
        "Val_Rows": len(val_df),
        "Test_Rows": len(test_df),
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "R2": r2,
        "Pearson": pearson,
        "Spearman": spearman,
        "NRMSE": nrmse,
        "Best_Iteration": best_iteration,
        "Tree_Count": model.tree_count_,
        "Model_Object": model,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------
