# ================================================================
# TRUSTSYN — V2 SPLIT INTEGRITY + EVALUATION SANITY CHECK
# ================================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — V2 SPLIT INTEGRITY CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. Confirm required split structures exist
# ------------------------------------------------

required = ["splits", "X_clean", "y"]

for obj in required:
    if obj not in globals():
        raise NameError(f"Required object missing: {obj}")

print("\nPASS — required objects available")
print(f"X_clean: {X_clean.shape}")
print(f"y     : {y.shape}")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract the FROZEN split indices
# ------------------------------------------------

split_names = [
    "RANDOM",
    "COLD_COMBINATION",
    "COLD_CELL",
    "COLD_DRUG"
]

idx = {}

for split_name in split_names:

    s = splits[split_name]

    idx[split_name] = {
        "train": np.asarray(s["train_idx"]),
        "val":   np.asarray(s["val_idx"]),
        "test":  np.asarray(s["test_idx"])
    }

    print(f"\n{split_name}")
    print(f"  Train: {len(idx[split_name]['train'])}")
    print(f"  Val  : {len(idx[split_name]['val'])}")
    print(f"  Test : {len(idx[split_name]['test'])}")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. Check whether COLD_COMBINATION and COLD_DRUG
#    are actually the same splits
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("COLD_COMBINATION vs COLD_DRUG")
print("=" * 70)

for subset in ["train", "val", "test"]:

    a = np.sort(idx["COLD_COMBINATION"][subset])
    b = np.sort(idx["COLD_DRUG"][subset])

    identical = np.array_equal(a, b)

    print(
        f"{subset.upper():5s} | "
        f"identical={identical} | "
        f"overlap={len(np.intersect1d(a, b))}"
    )


# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. Check train/val/test leakage within EACH split
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("INTERNAL SPLIT LEAKAGE CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

for split_name in split_names:

    train_idx = idx[split_name]["train"]
    val_idx   = idx[split_name]["val"]
    test_idx  = idx[split_name]["test"]

    train_val = len(np.intersect1d(train_idx, val_idx))
    train_test = len(np.intersect1d(train_idx, test_idx))
    val_test = len(np.intersect1d(val_idx, test_idx))

    passed = (
        train_val == 0 and
        train_test == 0 and
        val_test == 0
    )

    print(
        f"{split_name:18s} | "
        f"Train-Val={train_val:5d} | "
        f"Train-Test={train_test:5d} | "
        f"Val-Test={val_test:5d} | "
        f"{'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL'}"
    )


# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. Check that each split covers the expected
#    number of MASTER rows
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ROW COVERAGE CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

N = len(X_clean)

for split_name in split_names:

    total = (
        len(idx[split_name]["train"]) +
        len(idx[split_name]["val"]) +
        len(idx[split_name]["test"])
    )

    unique_total = len(np.unique(np.concatenate([
        idx[split_name]["train"],
        idx[split_name]["val"],
        idx[split_name]["test"]
    ])))

    print(
        f"{split_name:18s} | "
        f"rows={total} | "
        f"unique={unique_total} | "
        f"expected={N} | "
        f"{'PASS' if total == N and unique_total == N else 'CHECK'}"
    )


# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. Compare the actual row identities
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ACTUAL SPLIT DIFFERENCE")
print("=" * 70)

cc_test = set(idx["COLD_COMBINATION"]["test"])
cd_test = set(idx["COLD_DRUG"]["test"])

print(
    "COLD_COMBINATION test rows NOT in COLD_DRUG:",
    len(cc_test - cd_test)
)

print(
    "COLD_DRUG test rows NOT in COLD_COMBINATION:",

# ================================================================
# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 RESIDUAL / ERROR ANALYSIS
# ================================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 RESIDUAL ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. Locate V2 model
# ------------------------------------------------

model_candidates = [
    ("catboost_v2", globals().get("catboost_v2")),
    ("model_v2", globals().get("model_v2")),
    ("catboost_model_v2", globals().get("catboost_model_v2")),
]

v2_model = None

for name, obj in model_candidates:
    if obj is not None:
        v2_model = obj
        print(f"PASS — using model object: {name}")
        break

if v2_model is None:
    raise NameError(
        "V2 CatBoost model object not found in memory. "
        "Do not retrain. Tell me the variable name of the V2 model."
    )


# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. Verify MASTER_MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------

if "MASTER_MODEL" not in globals():
    raise NameError("MASTER_MODEL is not available.")

print(f"MASTER_MODEL: {MASTER_MODEL.shape}")
print(f"X_clean     : {X_clean.shape}")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build residual table for each frozen split
# ------------------------------------------------

split_results = {}

for split_name in [
    "RANDOM",
    "COLD_COMBINATION",
    "COLD_CELL",
    "COLD_DRUG"
]:

    print("\n" + "-" * 70)
    print(split_name)

    test_idx = np.asarray(
        splits[split_name]["test_idx"]
    )

    X_test_split = X_clean.iloc[test_idx]
    y_test_split = np.asarray(y.iloc[test_idx])

    pred = v2_model.predict(X_test_split)

    residual = y_test_split - pred
    abs_error = np.abs(residual)

    result = pd.DataFrame({
        "row_idx": test_idx,
        "actual": y_test_split,
        "predicted": pred,
        "residual": residual,
        "absolute_error": abs_error
    })

    # Add useful MASTER identifiers
    master_test = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[test_idx].copy()

    for col in [
        "drug_A",
        "drug_B",
        "CELLNAME",
        "tissue",
        "combo_score"
    ]:
        if col in master_test.columns:
            result[col] = master_test[col].values

    split_results[split_name] = result

    rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean(residual ** 2))
    mae = np.mean(abs_error)

    print(f"Rows       : {len(result)}")
    print(f"RMSE       : {rmse:.6f}")
    print(f"MAE        : {mae:.6f}")
    print(f"Mean resid : {np.mean(residual):.6f}")
    print(f"Median abs : {np.median(abs_error):.6f}")
    print(f"Max abs    : {np.max(abs_error):.6f}")


# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. Error by actual synergy range
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ERROR BY ACTUAL SYNERGY RANGE")
print("=" * 70)

for split_name, df in split_results.items():

    print(f"\n### {split_name}")

    df["synergy_bin"] = pd.cut(
        df["actual"],
        bins=[
            -np.inf,
            -20,
            -10,
            0,
            10,
            20,
            30,
            40,
            50,
            60,
            np.inf
        ]
    )

    grouped = (
        df.groupby("synergy_bin", observed=True)
          .agg(
              N=("actual", "size"),
              Mean_Actual=("actual", "mean"),
              Mean_Predicted=("predicted", "mean"),
              RMSE=("residual", lambda x: np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2))),
              MAE=("absolute_error", "mean")
          )
          .reset_index()
    )

    display(grouped)


# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. Worst individual predictions
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("WORST PREDICTIONS")
print("=" * 70)

for split_name, df in split_results.items():

    print(f"\n### {split_name}")

    cols = [
        c for c in [
            "drug_A",
            "drug_B",
            "CELLNAME",
            "actual",
            "predicted",
            "residual",
            "absolute_error"
        ]
        if c in df.columns
    ]

    display(
        df.nlargest(20, "absolute_error")[cols]
    )


# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. Bias analysis
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("SYSTEMATIC BIAS")
print("=" * 70)

bias_rows = []

for split_name, df in split_results.items():

    bias_rows.append({
        "Split": split_name,
        "Mean_Actual": df["actual"].mean(),
        "Mean_Predicted": df["predicted"].mean(),
        "Mean_Residual": df["residual"].mean(),
        "Median_Residual": df["residual"].median(),
        "RMSE": np.sqrt(np.mean(df["residual"] ** 2)),
        "MAE": df["absolute_error"].mean()
    })

bias_df = pd.DataFrame(bias_rows)

display(bias_df)


# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. Error quantiles
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ABSOLUTE ERROR DISTRIBUTION")
print("=" * 70)

error_rows = []

for split_name, df in split_results.items():

    q = df["absolute_error"].quantile(
        [0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95, 0.99]
    )

    error_rows.append({
        "Split": split_name,
        "Median": q.loc[0.50],
        "75th_percentile": q.loc[0.75],
        "90th_percentile": q.loc[0.90],
        "95th_percentile": q.loc[0.95],
        "99th_percentile": q.loc[0.99]
    })

error_quantiles = pd.DataFrame(error_rows)

display(error_quantiles)


print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("PASS — V2 RESIDUAL ANALYSIS COMPLETE")
print("=" * 70)

# ============================================================
# TRUSTSYN — FINAL CATBOOST V2 BENCHMARK RECONSTRUCTION
# Uses ONLY the frozen existing splits
# Does NOT create, modify, or overwrite splits
# ============================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    mean_squared_error,
    mean_absolute_error,
    r2_score
)
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 FINAL BENCHMARK")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load the exact saved V2 model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

V2_PATH = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/models/CatBoost_v2.cbm")

if not V2_PATH.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"Missing V2 model:\n{V2_PATH}")

v2_model = CatBoostRegressor()
v2_model.load_model(str(V2_PATH))

print("PASS — V2 model loaded")
print("Tree count:", v2_model.tree_count_)
print("Feature count:", len(v2_model.feature_names_))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Verify feature matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if "X_clean" not in globals():
    raise NameError("X_clean is not available.")

if "y" not in globals():
    raise NameError("y is not available.")

print("\nFeature matrix:", X_clean.shape)
print("Target:", y.shape)

if len(X_clean) != len(y):
    raise ValueError("X_clean and y have different row counts.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Frozen split objects
# ------------------------------------------------------------

required_split_objects = {
    "RANDOM": ["random_split"],
    "COLD_COMBINATION": ["splits"],
    "COLD_CELL": ["splits"],
    "COLD_DRUG": ["splits"]
}

if "random_split" not in globals():
    raise NameError("random_split is missing.")

if "splits" not in globals():
    raise NameError("splits is missing.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract frozen indices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

frozen_splits = {
    "RANDOM": {
        "train_idx": np.asarray(random_split["train_idx"]),
        "val_idx": np.asarray(random_split["val_idx"]),
        "test_idx": np.asarray(random_split["test_idx"]),
    },

    "COLD_COMBINATION": {
        "train_idx": np.asarray(splits["COLD_COMBINATION"]["train_idx"]),
        "val_idx": np.asarray(splits["COLD_COMBINATION"]["val_idx"]),
        "test_idx": np.asarray(splits["COLD_COMBINATION"]["test_idx"]),
    },

    "COLD_CELL": {
        "train_idx": np.asarray(splits["COLD_CELL"]["train_idx"]),
        "val_idx": np.asarray(splits["COLD_CELL"]["val_idx"]),
        "test_idx": np.asarray(splits["COLD_CELL"]["test_idx"]),
    },

    "COLD_DRUG": {
        "train_idx": np.asarray(splits["COLD_DRUG"]["train_idx"]),
        "val_idx": np.asarray(splits["COLD_DRUG"]["val_idx"]),
        "test_idx": np.asarray(splits["COLD_DRUG"]["test_idx"]),
    }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Integrity check before evaluation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FROZEN SPLIT CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

for split_name, idxs in frozen_splits.items():

    train_idx = idxs["train_idx"]
    val_idx = idxs["val_idx"]
    test_idx = idxs["test_idx"]

    train_val = len(np.intersect1d(train_idx, val_idx))
    train_test = len(np.intersect1d(train_idx, test_idx))
    val_test = len(np.intersect1d(val_idx, test_idx))

    print(
        f"{split_name:18s} | "
        f"Train={len(train_idx):6d} | "
        f"Val={len(val_idx):6d} | "
        f"Test={len(test_idx):6d} | "
        f"Leakage={train_val + train_test + val_test}"
    )

    if train_val or train_test or val_test:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Split leakage detected in {split_name}."
        )

print("PASS — no internal split leakage")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Evaluate V2 on all four frozen test sets
# ------------------------------------------------------------

results = []

for split_name, idxs in frozen_splits.items():

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"EVALUATING: {split_name}")
    print("=" * 70)

    train_idx = idxs["train_idx"]
    val_idx = idxs["val_idx"]
    test_idx = idxs["test_idx"]

    X_test_split = X_clean.iloc[test_idx]
    y_test_split = y.iloc[test_idx]

    print("Train:", len(train_idx))
    print("Val  :", len(val_idx))
    print("Test :", len(test_idx))

    # Prediction
    y_pred = v2_model.predict(X_test_split)

    # Metrics
    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(y_test_split, y_pred)
    )

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_test_split, y_pred
    )

    r2 = r2_score(
        y_test_split, y_pred
    )

    pearson = pearsonr(
        y_test_split, y_pred
    )[0]

    spearman = spearmanr(
        y_test_split, y_pred
    ).statistic

    # Normalized RMSE
    target_range = (
        np.max(y_test_split) -
        np.min(y_test_split)
    )

    nrmse = rmse / target_range if target_range != 0 else np.nan

    result = {
        "Model": "CatBoost_V2",
        "Split": split_name,
        "Features": X_clean.shape[1],

        "Train_Rows": len(train_idx),
        "Val_Rows": len(val_idx),
        "Test_Rows": len(test_idx),

        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "R2": r2,
        "Pearson": pearson,
        "Spearman": spearman,
        "NRMSE": nrmse,

        "Best_Iteration": v2_model.tree_count_ - 1,
        "Tree_Count": v2_model.tree_count_
    }

    results.append(result)

    print(
        f"TEST | "
        f"RMSE={rmse:.4f} | "
        f"MAE={mae:.4f} | "
        f"R2={r2:.4f} | "
        f"Pearson={pearson:.4f} | "
        f"Spearman={spearman:.4f} | "
        f"NRMSE={nrmse:.4f}"
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Final results DataFrame
# ------------------------------------------------------------

v2_final_results = pd.DataFrame(results)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("CATBOOST V2 — FINAL METRICS")
print("=" * 70)

display(v2_final_results)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Sanity checks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

expected_splits = {
    "RANDOM",
    "COLD_COMBINATION",
    "COLD_CELL",
    "COLD_DRUG"
}

actual_splits = set(v2_final_results["Split"])

if actual_splits != expected_splits:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Missing or unexpected splits.\n"
        f"Expected: {expected_splits}\n"
        f"Found: {actual_splits}"
    )

if len(v2_final_results) != 4:
    raise ValueError(
        "Expected exactly 4 benchmark rows."
    )

print("\nPASS — all four frozen splits evaluated")
print("PASS — no new splits created")
print("PASS — V2 model unchanged")
print("PASS — final benchmark reconstructed")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save final V2 benchmark
# ------------------------------------------------------------

MODEL_RELATED_DIR = Path(
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/model_related_files"
)

MODEL_RELATED_DIR.mkdir(
    parents=True,
    exist_ok=True
)

csv_path = MODEL_RELATED_DIR / "CatBoost_v2_metrics.csv"
xlsx_path = MODEL_RELATED_DIR / "CatBoost_v2_metrics.xlsx"

v2_final_results.to_csv(
    csv_path,
    index=False
)

v2_final_results.to_excel(
    xlsx_path,
    index=False
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("SAVED")
print("=" * 70)

print(csv_path)
print(xlsx_path)

print("\nPASS — CATBOOST V2 FINAL BENCHMARK SAVED")

# 4. Check index validity
# ------------------------------------------------------------

n_master = len(X_clean)

for name, idx in [
    ("TRAIN", train_idx),
    ("VAL", val_idx),
    ("TEST", test_idx)
]:

    invalid = np.sum(
        (idx < 0) | (idx >= n_master)
    )

    duplicates = len(idx) - len(np.unique(idx))

    print(
        f"{name:5s} | "
        f"invalid={invalid} | "
        f"duplicates={duplicates}"
    )

    if invalid > 0:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{name} contains invalid master indices."
        )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Internal leakage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

train_val = len(
    np.intersect1d(train_idx, val_idx)
)

train_test = len(
    np.intersect1d(train_idx, test_idx)
)

val_test = len(
    np.intersect1d(val_idx, test_idx)
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("INTERNAL LEAKAGE")
print("=" * 70)

print("Train ∩ Val :", train_val)
print("Train ∩ Test:", train_test)
print("Val ∩ Test  :", val_test)

if train_val or train_test or val_test:
    raise ValueError(
        "COLD_DRUG contains internal leakage."
    )

print("PASS — no internal leakage")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Coverage
# ------------------------------------------------------------

all_idx = np.concatenate([
    train_idx,
    val_idx,
    test_idx
])

unique_idx = np.unique(all_idx)

missing_idx_from_master = np.setdiff1d(
    np.arange(n_master),
    unique_idx
)

extra_idx = np.setdiff1d(
    unique_idx,
    np.arange(n_master)
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ROW COVERAGE")
print("=" * 70)

print("Total assigned rows :", len(all_idx))
print("Unique assigned rows:", len(unique_idx))
print("Master rows         :", n_master)
print("Missing master rows  :", len(missing_idx_from_master))
print("Extra indices        :", len(extra_idx))

if len(missing_idx_from_master) == 0:
    print("PASS — complete master coverage")
else:
    print(
        "WARNING — COLD_DRUG does NOT cover "
        "the complete master dataset."
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Identify exactly which rows are missing
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if len(missing_idx_from_master) > 0:

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("MISSING ROW ANALYSIS")
    print("=" * 70)

    # Try to identify the corresponding MASTER dataframe
    master_candidates = [
        "MASTER",
        "MASTER_MODEL",
        "master",
        "master_df"
    ]

    master_obj = None

    for name in master_candidates:
        if name in globals():
            obj = globals()[name]

            if hasattr(obj, "iloc") and len(obj) == n_master:
                master_obj = obj
                print(
                    f"PASS — using MASTER object: {name}"
                )
                break

    if master_obj is not None:

        missing_rows = master_obj.iloc[
            missing_idx_from_master
        ].copy()

        print(
            "Missing rows dataframe:",
            missing_rows.shape
        )

        display(
            missing_rows.head(20)
        )

        # ----------------------------------------------------
        # 8. Examine missing rows by drug
        # ----------------------------------------------------

        if "drug_A" in missing_rows.columns:
            print("\nMissing rows — drug_A:")
            print(
                missing_rows["drug_A"]
                .value_counts()
                .head(20)
            )

        if "drug_B" in missing_rows.columns:
            print("\nMissing rows — drug_B:")
            print(
                missing_rows["drug_B"]
                .value_counts()
                .head(20)
            )

        if "CELLNAME" in missing_rows.columns:
            print("\nMissing rows — CELLNAME:")
            print(
                missing_rows["CELLNAME"]
                .value_counts()
                .head(20)
            )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Compare against explicit dataframe if available
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if "cold_drug_train" in globals():
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("EXPLICIT COLD_DRUG DATAFRAME CHECK")
    print("=" * 70)

    print(
        "cold_drug_train:",
        cold_drug_train.shape
    )

if "cold_drug_val" in globals():
    print(
        "cold_drug_val  :",
        cold_drug_val.shape
    )

if "cold_drug_test" in globals():
    print(
        "cold_drug_test :",
        cold_drug_test.shape
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Final verdict
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL VERDICT")
print("=" * 70)

if (
    len(missing_idx_from_master) == 0
    and
    train_val == 0
    and
    train_test == 0
    and
    val_test == 0
):
    print(
        "PASS — COLD_DRUG is complete and leakage-free."
    )

else:
    print(
        "CHECK REQUIRED — COLD_DRUG is leakage-free "
        "but does not cover the complete MASTER."
    )

print("\nNo files were modified.")

# ============================================================
# TRUSTSYN — COLD_DRUG MISSING-DRUG FORENSIC ANALYSIS

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — COLD_DRUG MISSING-DRUG FORENSIC ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Locate MASTER dataframe
# ------------------------------------------------------------

master_candidates = [
    "MASTER_MODEL",
    "MASTER",
    "master",
    "master_df"
]

master_obj = None
master_name = None

for name in master_candidates:
    if name in globals():
        obj = globals()[name]

        if hasattr(obj, "columns") and len(obj) == len(X_clean):
            if "drug_A" in obj.columns and "drug_B" in obj.columns:
                master_obj = obj
                master_name = name
                break

if master_obj is None:
    raise NameError(
        "Could not find the MASTER dataframe containing "
        "drug_A and drug_B."
    )

print(f"PASS — using MASTER object: {master_name}")
print("MASTER rows:", len(master_obj))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Get COLD_DRUG assigned indices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cd = splits["COLD_DRUG"]

train_idx = np.asarray(cd["train_idx"])
val_idx   = np.asarray(cd["val_idx"])
test_idx  = np.asarray(cd["test_idx"])

assigned_idx = np.unique(
    np.concatenate([
        train_idx,
        val_idx,
        test_idx
    ])
)

missing_idx = np.setdiff1d(
    np.arange(len(master_obj)),
    assigned_idx
)

print("\nAssigned rows:", len(assigned_idx))
print("Missing rows :", len(missing_idx))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build assigned + missing dataframes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assigned_df = master_obj.iloc[assigned_idx].copy()
missing_df  = master_obj.iloc[missing_idx].copy()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Drug universe comparison
# ------------------------------------------------------------

master_drugs = set(
    pd.concat([
        master_obj["drug_A"],
        master_obj["drug_B"]
    ]).dropna().unique()
)

assigned_drugs = set(
    pd.concat([
        assigned_df["drug_A"],
        assigned_df["drug_B"]
    ]).dropna().unique()
)

missing_drugs = sorted(
    master_drugs - assigned_drugs
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DRUG UNIVERSE COMPARISON")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER unique drugs  :", len(master_drugs))
print("Assigned unique drugs:", len(assigned_drugs))
print("Missing drugs        :", len(missing_drugs))

print("\nMissing drug IDs:")
print(missing_drugs)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Count missing rows by drug
# ------------------------------------------------------------

missing_A = (
    missing_df
    .groupby("drug_A")
    .size()
    .rename("missing_as_drug_A")
)

missing_B = (
    missing_df
    .groupby("drug_B")
    .size()
    .rename("missing_as_drug_B")
)

missing_drug_table = (
    pd.concat([missing_A, missing_B], axis=1)
    .fillna(0)
)

missing_drug_table["total_missing"] = (
    missing_drug_table["missing_as_drug_A"] +
    missing_drug_table["missing_as_drug_B"]
)

missing_drug_table = (
    missing_drug_table
    .sort_values("total_missing", ascending=False)
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("TOP MISSING DRUGS")
print("=" * 70)

display(missing_drug_table.head(40))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Check whether missing rows involve missing drugs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

missing_drug_set = set(missing_drugs)

missing_rows_with_missing_drug = missing_df[
    missing_df["drug_A"].isin(missing_drug_set) |
    missing_df["drug_B"].isin(missing_drug_set)
]

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MISSING-ROW / MISSING-DRUG RELATIONSHIP")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    "Missing rows involving at least one "
    "completely absent drug:",
    len(missing_rows_with_missing_drug)
)

print(
    "Total missing rows:",
    len(missing_df)
)

coverage_pct = (
    len(missing_rows_with_missing_drug) /
    len(missing_df) *
    100
)

print(
    f"Percentage explained by absent drugs: "
    f"{coverage_pct:.2f}%"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Check drug-level representation
# ------------------------------------------------------------

drug_presence = pd.DataFrame({
    "drug_id": sorted(master_drugs)
})

drug_presence["in_assigned_split"] = (
    drug_presence["drug_id"]
    .isin(assigned_drugs)
)

drug_presence["in_missing_rows"] = (
    drug_presence["drug_id"]
    .isin(
        set(
            pd.concat([
                missing_df["drug_A"],
                missing_df["drug_B"]
            ]).dropna().unique()
        )
    )
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DRUG COVERAGE SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)

display(
    drug_presence[
        ~drug_presence["in_assigned_split"]
    ]
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Check whether missing rows form complete
#    drug-pair/cell blocks
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if "CELLNAME" in master_obj.columns:

    missing_by_drug_cell = (
        missing_df
        .groupby(["drug_A", "drug_B"])
        .size()
        .reset_index(name="missing_rows")
        .sort_values("missing_rows", ascending=False)
    )

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("MISSING DRUG-PAIR BLOCKS")
    print("=" * 70)

    display(
        missing_by_drug_cell.head(30)
    )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Final diagnostic conclusion
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DIAGNOSTIC CONCLUSION")
print("=" * 70)

if len(missing_drugs) > 0:
    print(
        "WARNING — COLD_DRUG is missing entire drug IDs "
        "from its assigned universe."
    )
    print(
        "This indicates the existing COLD_DRUG split was "
        "constructed from an incomplete drug universe."
    )
else:
    print(
        "No completely absent drugs detected."
    )
    print(
        "The missing rows must therefore arise from "
        "another split-construction/filtering issue."
    )

print("\nNo files modified.")
print("No splits created.")
print("No model retrained.")

import numpy as np

]

for name in master_candidates:
    if name in globals():
        obj = globals()[name]

        if hasattr(obj, "columns") and len(obj) == len(X_clean):
            required_cols = [
                "drug_A",
                "drug_B",
                "CELLNAME",
                "combo_score"
            ]

            if all(c in obj.columns for c in required_cols):
                master_obj = obj
                master_name = name
                break

if master_obj is None:
    raise NameError(
        "Could not locate MASTER dataframe."
    )

print(f"PASS — MASTER: {master_name}")
print("MASTER shape:", master_obj.shape)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract COLD_DRUG indices
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cd = splits["COLD_DRUG"]

train_idx = np.asarray(cd["train_idx"])
val_idx   = np.asarray(cd["val_idx"])
test_idx  = np.asarray(cd["test_idx"])

assigned_idx = np.unique(
    np.concatenate([
        train_idx,
        val_idx,
        test_idx
    ])
)

missing_idx = np.setdiff1d(
    np.arange(len(master_obj)),
    assigned_idx
)

print("\nAssigned:", len(assigned_idx))
print("Missing :", len(missing_idx))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create row keys
# ------------------------------------------------------------

key_cols = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2"
]

    c for c in key_cols
    if c not in master_obj.columns
]

if missing_cols:
    print(
        "WARNING — missing key columns:",
        missing_cols
    )

key_cols = [
    c for c in key_cols
    if c in master_obj.columns
]

master_keys = (
    master_obj[key_cols]
    .astype(str)
    .agg("|".join, axis=1)
)

assigned_keys = set(
    master_keys.iloc[assigned_idx]
)

missing_keys = master_keys.iloc[missing_idx]

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ROW-KEY CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    "Master unique keys:",
    master_keys.nunique()
)

print(
    "Assigned unique keys:",
    len(assigned_keys)
)

print(
    "Missing unique keys:",
    missing_keys.nunique()
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Check whether missing rows are duplicates of
#    assigned rows
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assigned_key_series = master_keys.iloc[assigned_idx]

missing_key_set = set(missing_keys)

duplicate_of_assigned = missing_keys.isin(
    set(assigned_key_series)
)

print(
    "\nMissing rows whose exact key "
    "already exists in assigned rows:",
    int(duplicate_of_assigned.sum())
)

missing_df = master_obj.iloc[
    missing_idx
].copy()

print("\nTop missing cells:")

    cell_counts.head(30)

block_counts = (

    )

print("\nTop missing pair-cell blocks:")

display(

# ------------------------------------------------------------

if "cold_drug_train" in globals():
    cold_train_keys = set(
        cold_drug_train[key_cols]
        .astype(str)
        .agg("|".join, axis=1)
    )
else:
    cold_train_keys = set()

if "cold_drug_val" in globals():
    cold_val_keys = set(
        cold_drug_val[key_cols]
        .astype(str)
        .agg("|".join, axis=1)
    )
else:
    cold_val_keys = set()

if "cold_drug_test" in globals():
    cold_test_keys = set(
        cold_drug_test[key_cols]
        .astype(str)
        .agg("|".join, axis=1)
    )
else:
    cold_test_keys = set()

explicit_keys = (
    cold_train_keys |
    cold_val_keys |
    cold_test_keys
)

print(

        explicit_keys

print(

        explicit_keys -
        assigned_keys
    )

print("INTERPRETATION")

if len(assigned_keys & explicit_keys) == len(assigned_keys):

else:

else:

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. MASTER
# ------------------------------------------------

master = MASTER_MODEL.copy()

print("\nMASTER")
print("Rows:", len(master))
print("Columns:", master.shape[1])

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. EXISTING COLD_DRUG
# ------------------------------------------------

cd_train = cold_drug_train.copy()
cd_val   = cold_drug_val.copy()
cd_test  = cold_drug_test.copy()

cold_drug_assigned = pd.concat(
    [cd_train, cd_val, cd_test],
    ignore_index=True
)

print("\nEXISTING COLD_DRUG")
print("Train:", len(cd_train))
print("Val  :", len(cd_val))
print("Test :", len(cd_test))
print("Total:", len(cold_drug_assigned))

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. CREATE ROBUST ROW IDs
# ------------------------------------------------
# Use all MASTER columns that identify an observation.
# This avoids relying on dataframe index alignment.

key_cols = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id",
    "nci_almanac_cellname"
]

print("\nKEY COLUMNS")
print(key_cols)

def make_key(df):
    return (
        df[key_cols]
        .astype(str)
        .fillna("<NA>")
        .agg("||".join, axis=1)
    )

master_keys = make_key(master)
assigned_keys = make_key(cold_drug_assigned)

print("\nKEY COUNTS")
print("MASTER unique keys :", master_keys.nunique())
print("Assigned unique    :", assigned_keys.nunique())

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. FIND MISSING MASTER ROWS
# ------------------------------------------------

assigned_key_set = set(assigned_keys)

missing_mask = ~master_keys.isin(assigned_key_set)

missing = master.loc[missing_mask].copy()

print("\nROW COVERAGE")
print("MASTER rows :", len(master))
print("Assigned    :", len(cold_drug_assigned))
print("Missing     :", len(missing))

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. ARE MISSING ROWS CONCENTRATED IN CERTAIN DRUGS?
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MISSING ROWS BY DRUG_A")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    missing["drug_A"]
    .value_counts()
    .head(30)
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MISSING ROWS BY DRUG_B")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    missing["drug_B"]
    .value_counts()
    .head(30)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. UNIQUE DRUG COVERAGE
# ------------------------------------------------

master_drugs = set(
    pd.concat(
        [master["drug_A"], master["drug_B"]]
    ).dropna().unique()
)

assigned_drugs = set(
    pd.concat(
        [
            cold_drug_assigned["drug_A"],
            cold_drug_assigned["drug_B"]
        ]
    ).dropna().unique()
)

missing_drugs = master_drugs - assigned_drugs

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DRUG UNIVERSE")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER unique drugs  :", len(master_drugs))
print("Assigned unique drugs:", len(assigned_drugs))
print("Absent drugs         :", len(missing_drugs))

if missing_drugs:
    print("\nABSENT DRUG IDs:")
    print(sorted(missing_drugs))

# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. TEST WHETHER MISSING ROWS USE DRUGS THAT
#    ACTUALLY EXIST IN THE ASSIGNED UNIVERSE
# ------------------------------------------------

missing_drugA_not_assigned = (
    ~missing["drug_A"].isin(assigned_drugs)
)

missing_drugB_not_assigned = (
    ~missing["drug_B"].isin(assigned_drugs)
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MISSING-ROW DRUG DIAGNOSTIC")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    "Rows where drug_A is outside assigned drug universe:",
    missing_drugA_not_assigned.sum()
)

print(
    "Rows where drug_B is outside assigned drug universe:",
    missing_drugB_not_assigned.sum()
)

print(
    "Rows where BOTH drugs are outside assigned universe:",
    (
        missing_drugA_not_assigned
        & missing_drugB_not_assigned
    ).sum()
)

# 8. CELL COVERAGE OF MISSING ROWS
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MISSING ROWS BY CELL")

    .value_counts()
    .head(30)
)

# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MISSING ROW NULL CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

null_counts = missing[key_cols].isna().sum()

print(
    null_counts[null_counts > 0]
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 10. COMPARE EXISTING COLD_DRUG AGAINST MASTER
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL DIAGNOSTIC SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER rows        :", len(master))
print("Assigned rows      :", len(cold_drug_assigned))
print("Missing rows       :", len(missing))

    ignore_index=True
)

print("\nEXISTING COLD_DRUG")
print("Train:", len(cd_train))

    "drug_A",

    "cellminer_cellline_id",

    c for c in key_cols

    raise KeyError(

        df[key_cols]
        .astype(str)
        .fillna("<NA>")

# ================================================================
# TRUSTSYN — COLD_DRUG PAIR COVERAGE FORENSIC CHECK
# NO FILES MODIFIED
# NO SPLITS CREATED
# ================================================================

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — COLD_DRUG PAIR COVERAGE FORENSIC CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. COPY EXISTING DATA
# ------------------------------------------------

master = MASTER_MODEL.copy()

cold_drug_assigned = pd.concat(
    [
        cold_train.copy(),
        cold_val.copy(),
        cold_test.copy()
    ],
    ignore_index=True
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. CANONICAL DRUG-PAIR KEY
# ------------------------------------------------

def canonical_pair(df):
    a = df["drug_A"].astype(str)
    b = df["drug_B"].astype(str)

    return np.where(
        a <= b,
        a + "||" + b,
        b + "||" + a
    )

master["PAIR_KEY"] = canonical_pair(master)
cold_drug_assigned["PAIR_KEY"] = canonical_pair(
    cold_drug_assigned
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. PAIR UNIVERSE
# ------------------------------------------------

master_pairs = set(master["PAIR_KEY"])
assigned_pairs = set(cold_drug_assigned["PAIR_KEY"])

missing_pairs = master_pairs - assigned_pairs

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DRUG-PAIR UNIVERSE")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER unique pairs   :", len(master_pairs))
print("Assigned unique pairs :", len(assigned_pairs))
print("Missing pairs         :", len(missing_pairs))

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. ROWS ASSOCIATED WITH MISSING PAIRS
# ------------------------------------------------

missing_pair_mask = master["PAIR_KEY"].isin(missing_pairs)

missing_pair_rows = master.loc[
    missing_pair_mask
].copy()

print("\nRows belonging to completely missing pairs:",
      len(missing_pair_rows))

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. PARTIAL PAIR COVERAGE
# ------------------------------------------------

master_pair_counts = (
    master
    .groupby("PAIR_KEY")
    .size()
    .rename("MASTER_ROWS")
)

assigned_pair_counts = (
    cold_drug_assigned
    .groupby("PAIR_KEY")
    .size()
    .rename("ASSIGNED_ROWS")
)

pair_compare = pd.concat(
    [
        master_pair_counts,
        assigned_pair_counts
    ],
    axis=1
).fillna(0)

pair_compare["MISSING_ROWS"] = (
    pair_compare["MASTER_ROWS"]
    - pair_compare["ASSIGNED_ROWS"]
)

partial_pairs = pair_compare[
    (pair_compare["MISSING_ROWS"] > 0)
    & (pair_compare["ASSIGNED_ROWS"] > 0)
].sort_values(
    "MISSING_ROWS",
    ascending=False
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("PARTIALLY COVERED PAIRS")
print("=" * 70)

print("Number of partially covered pairs:",
      len(partial_pairs))

print(
    partial_pairs.head(30)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. COMPLETELY MISSING PAIRS
# ------------------------------------------------

complete_missing_pairs = pair_compare[
    pair_compare["ASSIGNED_ROWS"] == 0
].sort_values(
    "MASTER_ROWS",
    ascending=False
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("COMPLETELY MISSING PAIRS")
print("=" * 70)

print("Number of completely missing pairs:",
      len(complete_missing_pairs))

print(
    complete_missing_pairs.head(30)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. ORIENTATION CHECK
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("PAIR ORIENTATION CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

master_directed = (
    master["drug_A"].astype(str)
    + "||"
    + master["drug_B"].astype(str)
)

assigned_directed = (
    cold_drug_assigned["drug_A"].astype(str)
    + "||"
    + cold_drug_assigned["drug_B"].astype(str)
)

master_directed_set = set(master_directed)
assigned_directed_set = set(assigned_directed)

missing_directed_pairs = (
    master_directed_set
    - assigned_directed_set
)

reverse_only = []

for pair in missing_directed_pairs:
    a, b = pair.split("||")

    reverse = b + "||" + a

    if reverse in assigned_directed_set:
        reverse_only.append(pair)

print(
    "Directed pairs missing from assigned:",
    len(missing_directed_pairs)
)

print(
    "Missing only because reverse orientation exists:",
    len(reverse_only)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 8. MISSING ROWS BY PAIR
# ------------------------------------------------

missing_row_counts = (
    master.loc[
        master["PAIR_KEY"].isin(
            pair_compare.index[
                pair_compare["MISSING_ROWS"] > 0
            ]
        )
    ]
    .groupby("PAIR_KEY")
    .size()
    .sort_values(ascending=False)
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("TOP PAIRS CONTRIBUTING TO MISSING ROWS")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    missing_row_counts.head(30)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 9. CELL DISTRIBUTION OF MISSING ROWS
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MISSING ROWS — CELL DISTRIBUTION")
print("=" * 70)

missing_rows = master[
    master["PAIR_KEY"].isin(
        pair_compare.index[
            pair_compare["MISSING_ROWS"] > 0
        ]
    )
]

print(
    missing_rows["CELLNAME"]
    .value_counts()
    .head(20)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 10. FINAL RECONCILIATION
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL RECONCILIATION")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER rows       :", len(master))
print("Assigned rows     :", len(cold_drug_assigned))
print("Missing rows      :", len(master) - len(cold_drug_assigned))

print(
    "Rows from complete missing pairs:",
    int(complete_missing_pairs["MASTER_ROWS"].sum())
)

print(
    "Rows from partial pairs:",
    int(partial_pairs["MISSING_ROWS"].sum())
)

print("\nNo files modified.")
print("No splits created.")
print("No model retrained.")

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — COLD_DRUG ORIGINAL FILE FORENSIC CHECK")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Find the actual COLD_DRUG files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cold_drug_candidates = []

for root in [
    Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits"),
    Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data"),
]:
    if root.exists():
        for p in root.rglob("*"):
            if p.is_file() and "cold_drug" in p.name.lower():
                cold_drug_candidates.append(p)

print("\nCOLD_DRUG FILES FOUND:")
for p in cold_drug_candidates:
    print(" ", p)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Inspect SPLITS path information
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("SPLIT PATH OBJECTS")
print("=" * 70)

for obj_name in ["SPLITS", "SPLIT_PATHS", "split_paths", "BASE_SPLITS", "COLD_DRUG_DIR"]:
    if obj_name in globals():
        obj = globals()[obj_name]
        print(f"\n{obj_name}:")
        print(obj)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Inspect all candidate files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FILE CONTENT SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)

for p in cold_drug_candidates:

    print(f"\nFILE: {p}")
    print(f"SIZE: {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes")

    try:
        if p.suffix.lower() == ".csv":
            tmp = pd.read_csv(p)
        elif p.suffix.lower() in [".parquet", ".pq"]:
            tmp = pd.read_parquet(p)
        elif p.suffix.lower() in [".xlsx", ".xls"]:
            tmp = pd.read_excel(p)
        else:
            print("  Skipping unsupported format")
            continue

        print("SHAPE:", tmp.shape)
        print("COLUMNS:", list(tmp.columns))

        if {"drug_A", "drug_B"}.issubset(tmp.columns):
            pairs = (
                tmp["drug_A"].astype(str)
                + "||"
                + tmp["drug_B"].astype(str)
            )

            print("UNIQUE PAIRS:", pairs.nunique())

        if "CELLNAME" in tmp.columns:
            print("UNIQUE CELLS:", tmp["CELLNAME"].nunique())

    except Exception as e:
        print("  Could not read:", repr(e))

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DIAGNOSTIC COMPLETE")
print("=" * 70)

print("""
IMPORTANT:
No files were modified.
No splits were created.
No model was retrained.

We are only determining whether the 1,809 missing
drug pairs were intentionally excluded or accidentally
lost during COLD_DRUG construction.
""")

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — COLD_DRUG SAVED SPLIT FORENSIC ANALYSIS")
print("=" * 70)

MASTER = MASTER_MODEL.copy()

COLD_DRUG_DIR = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load the SAVED files — read only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cd_train_file = COLD_DRUG_DIR / "train.csv"
cd_val_file   = COLD_DRUG_DIR / "val.csv"
cd_test_file  = COLD_DRUG_DIR / "test.csv"

cd_train_saved = pd.read_csv(cd_train_file)
cd_val_saved   = pd.read_csv(cd_val_file)
cd_test_saved  = pd.read_csv(cd_test_file)

print("\nSAVED FILE SHAPES")
print("Train:", cd_train_saved.shape)
print("Val  :", cd_val_saved.shape)
print("Test :", cd_test_saved.shape)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Check columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\nCOLUMNS")
print("MASTER:", list(MASTER.columns))
print("TRAIN :", list(cd_train_saved.columns))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Drug universes in each split
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def get_drugs(df):
    return set(df["drug_A"].dropna().unique()) | set(df["drug_B"].dropna().unique())

master_drugs = get_drugs(MASTER)
train_drugs  = get_drugs(cd_train_saved)
val_drugs    = get_drugs(cd_val_saved)
test_drugs   = get_drugs(cd_test_saved)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DRUG UNIVERSES")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER:", len(master_drugs))
print("TRAIN :", len(train_drugs))
print("VAL   :", len(val_drugs))
print("TEST  :", len(test_drugs))

print("\nTRAIN-only drugs:", sorted(train_drugs - (val_drugs | test_drugs)))
print("VAL-only drugs  :", sorted(val_drugs - (train_drugs | test_drugs)))
print("TEST-only drugs :", sorted(test_drugs - (train_drugs | val_drugs)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Drug frequency by split
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DRUG FREQUENCY BY SPLIT")
print("=" * 70)

def drug_counts(df):
    a = df["drug_A"].value_counts()
    b = df["drug_B"].value_counts()
    return a.add(b, fill_value=0).sort_index()

master_drug_counts = drug_counts(MASTER)
train_drug_counts  = drug_counts(cd_train_saved)
val_drug_counts    = drug_counts(cd_val_saved)
test_drug_counts   = drug_counts(cd_test_saved)

drug_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    "MASTER": master_drug_counts,
    "TRAIN": train_drug_counts,
    "VAL": val_drug_counts,
    "TEST": test_drug_counts
}).fillna(0)

drug_summary["ASSIGNED"] = (
    drug_summary["TRAIN"]
    + drug_summary["VAL"]
    + drug_summary["TEST"]
)

drug_summary["MISSING"] = (
    drug_summary["MASTER"]
    - drug_summary["ASSIGNED"]
)

print(drug_summary.sort_values("MISSING", ascending=False).head(30))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Pair counts by split
# ------------------------------------------------------------

def pair_key(df):
    return (
        df["drug_A"].astype(str)
        + "||"
        + df["drug_B"].astype(str)
    )

master_pairs = pair_key(MASTER)
train_pairs  = pair_key(cd_train_saved)
val_pairs    = pair_key(cd_val_saved)
test_pairs   = pair_key(cd_test_saved)

master_pair_set = set(master_pairs)
train_pair_set  = set(train_pairs)
val_pair_set    = set(val_pairs)
test_pair_set   = set(test_pairs)

assigned_pair_set = train_pair_set | val_pair_set | test_pair_set

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("PAIR COUNTS")
print("=" * 70)

print("MASTER pairs  :", len(master_pair_set))
print("TRAIN pairs   :", len(train_pair_set))
print("VAL pairs     :", len(val_pair_set))
print("TEST pairs    :", len(test_pair_set))
print("ASSIGNED pairs:", len(assigned_pair_set))
print("MISSING pairs :", len(master_pair_set - assigned_pair_set))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Determine whether pair assignment follows a drug-level rule
# ------------------------------------------------------------

pair_drugs = (
    MASTER[["drug_A", "drug_B"]]
    .drop_duplicates()
    .copy()
)

pair_drugs["PAIR_KEY"] = (
    pair_drugs["drug_A"].astype(str)
    + "||"
    + pair_drugs["drug_B"].astype(str)
)

def pair_split(k):
    if k in train_pair_set:
        return "TRAIN"
    if k in val_pair_set:
        return "VAL"
    if k in test_pair_set:
        return "TEST"
    return "MISSING"

pair_drugs["ASSIGNMENT"] = pair_drugs["PAIR_KEY"].map(pair_split)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Drug-level assignment pattern
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DRUG-LEVEL ASSIGNMENT PATTERN")
print("=" * 70)

drug_assignment = {}

for drug in sorted(master_drugs):

    rows = pair_drugs[
        (pair_drugs["drug_A"] == drug)
        | (pair_drugs["drug_B"] == drug)
    ]

    assignments = set(rows["ASSIGNMENT"])

    drug_assignment[drug] = assignments

drug_assignment_summary = pd.DataFrame([
    {
        "Drug": drug,
        "Assignments": ", ".join(sorted(assignments)),
        "Pair_Count": len(
            pair_drugs[
                (pair_drugs["drug_A"] == drug)
                | (pair_drugs["drug_B"] == drug)
            ]
        ),
        "Missing_Pairs": sum(
            pair_drugs.loc[
                (
                    (pair_drugs["drug_A"] == drug)
                    | (pair_drugs["drug_B"] == drug)
                ),
                "ASSIGNMENT"
            ] == "MISSING"
        )
    }
    for drug, assignments in drug_assignment.items()
])

print(
    drug_assignment_summary
    .sort_values("Missing_Pairs", ascending=False)
    .to_string(index=False)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Missing-pair structure
# ------------------------------------------------------------

missing_pairs = pair_drugs[
    pair_drugs["ASSIGNMENT"] == "MISSING"
].copy()

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MISSING PAIR STRUCTURE")
print("=" * 70)

print("Missing pairs:", len(missing_pairs))

print("\nMissing pairs by drug_A:")
print(missing_pairs["drug_A"].value_counts().head(20))

print("\nMissing pairs by drug_B:")
print(missing_pairs["drug_B"].value_counts().head(20))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Check whether every missing pair is 59 rows
# ------------------------------------------------------------

master_pair_counts = master_pairs.value_counts()

missing_pair_counts = master_pair_counts[
    master_pair_counts.index.isin(
        missing_pairs["PAIR_KEY"]
    )
]

print("\nMissing-pair row count distribution:")
print(missing_pair_counts.value_counts().sort_index())

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Check whether saved files themselves have overlap
# ------------------------------------------------------------

train_keys = set(train_pairs)
val_keys   = set(val_pairs)
test_keys  = set(test_pairs)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("SAVED SPLIT PAIR OVERLAP")
print("=" * 70)

print("TRAIN ∩ VAL :", len(train_keys & val_keys))
print("TRAIN ∩ TEST:", len(train_keys & test_keys))
print("VAL ∩ TEST  :", len(val_keys & test_keys))

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FORENSIC CHECK COMPLETE")
print("=" * 70)

print("""
NO FILES MODIFIED.
NO SPLITS CREATED.
NO MODEL RETRAINED.

The purpose of this analysis is to identify the
original COLD_DRUG assignment rule before we rebuild
anything.
""")

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=" * 75)
print("TRUSTSYN — CROSS-SPLIT ASSIGNMENT RULE DIAGNOSTIC")
print("=" * 75)

# ================================================================
# PATHS — READ ONLY
# ================================================================

BASE = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn")

MASTER_PATH = (
    BASE
    / "data/processed/almanac/almanac_final_59cell_104drug.csv"
)

    "RANDOM": BASE / "splits/random",
    "COLD_COMBINATION": BASE / "splits/cold_combination",
    "COLD_CELL": BASE / "splits/cold_cell_line",
    "COLD_DRUG": BASE / "splits/cold_drug",
}

# ================================================================
# LOAD MASTER

master = pd.read_csv(MASTER_PATH)

print("\nMASTER")

assert len(master) == 294073

# ================================================================
# LOAD FROZEN SPLITS
# ================================================================

split_data = {}

for name, path in SPLIT_DIRS.items():

    split_data[name] = {
        "train": pd.read_csv(path / "train.csv"),
        "val": pd.read_csv(path / "val.csv"),

    }

    print(
        f"{name:18s} | "
        f"Train={len(split_data[name]['train']):6d} | "
        f"Val={len(split_data[name]['val']):6d} | "
        f"Test={len(split_data[name]['test']):6d}"
    )

# ================================================================
# ROW IDENTITY
# ================================================================

KEY_COLS = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2"
]

def make_keys(df):
    return pd.MultiIndex.from_frame(
        df[KEY_COLS]
    )

master_keys = make_keys(master)

# ================================================================
# 1. COVERAGE OF EACH SPLIT
# ================================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("ROW COVERAGE")
print("=" * 75)

for name, data in split_data.items():

    train_keys = make_keys(data["train"])
    val_keys   = make_keys(data["val"])
    test_keys  = make_keys(data["test"])

    assigned = train_keys.union(val_keys).union(test_keys)

    print(
        f"{name:18s} | "
        f"Assigned={len(assigned):6d} | "
        f"Missing={len(master_keys.difference(assigned)):6d}"
    )

    assert len(train_keys.intersection(val_keys)) == 0
    assert len(train_keys.intersection(test_keys)) == 0
    assert len(val_keys.intersection(test_keys)) == 0

print("PASS — no internal row overlap")

# ================================================================
# 2. DRUG PARTITIONS FROM ORIGINAL COLD_DRUG
# ================================================================

cd = split_data["COLD_DRUG"]

train_drugs = set(
    pd.concat([
        cd["train"]["drug_A"],
        cd["train"]["drug_B"]
    ]).unique()
)

val_drugs = set(
    pd.concat([
        cd["val"]["drug_A"],
        cd["val"]["drug_B"]
    ]).unique()
)

test_drugs = set(
    pd.concat([
        cd["test"]["drug_A"],
        cd["test"]["drug_B"]
    ]).unique()
)

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("ORIGINAL COLD_DRUG DRUG PARTITIONS")
print("=" * 75)

print("TRAIN drugs:", len(train_drugs))
print("VAL drugs  :", len(val_drugs))
print("TEST drugs :", len(test_drugs))
print("TOTAL      :", len(train_drugs | val_drugs | test_drugs))

print("\nOverlaps:")
print("TRAIN ∩ VAL :", len(train_drugs & val_drugs))
print("TRAIN ∩ TEST:", len(train_drugs & test_drugs))
print("VAL ∩ TEST  :", len(val_drugs & test_drugs))

# ================================================================
# 3. CLASSIFY EVERY MASTER PAIR BY DRUG PARTITION
# ================================================================

def drug_group(drug):

    if drug in train_drugs:
        return "TRAIN"

    if drug in val_drugs:
        return "VAL"

    if drug in test_drugs:
        return "TEST"

    return "UNKNOWN"


pair_category = []

for a, b in zip(
    master["drug_A"],
    master["drug_B"]
):

    ga = drug_group(a)
    gb = drug_group(b)

    pair_category.append(
        tuple(sorted([ga, gb]))
    )

pair_category = np.array(pair_category, dtype=object)

categories = [
    ("TRAIN", "TRAIN"),
    ("TRAIN", "VAL"),
    ("TRAIN", "TEST"),
    ("VAL", "VAL"),
    ("VAL", "TEST"),
    ("TEST", "TEST"),
]

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("MASTER DRUG-PAIR CATEGORY DISTRIBUTION")
print("=" * 75)

for category in categories:

    count = np.sum(
        pair_category == category
    )

    print(
        f"{category[0]:5s}-{category[1]:5s}: "
        f"{count:7d} rows"
    )

# ================================================================
# 4. DETERMINE WHERE EACH CATEGORY CURRENTLY GOES
# ================================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("CURRENT COLD_DRUG ASSIGNMENT BY PAIR CATEGORY")
print("=" * 75)

master_with_cat = master.copy()

master_with_cat["_PAIR_CATEGORY"] = [
    f"{a}-{b}"
    for a, b in pair_category
]

# Build row keys for each current split
split_key_sets = {
    "TRAIN": set(
        make_keys(cd["train"])
    ),
    "VAL": set(
        make_keys(cd["val"])
    ),
    "TEST": set(
        make_keys(cd["test"])
    )
}

# For every category, determine current assignment counts
for category in categories:

    mask = (
        pair_category == category
    )

    category_df = master.loc[mask]

    if len(category_df) == 0:
        continue

    cat_keys = set(
        make_keys(category_df)
    )

    counts = {
        split_name: len(cat_keys & keys)
        for split_name, keys
        in split_key_sets.items()
    }

    assigned = sum(counts.values())

    print(
        f"{category[0]:5s}-{category[1]:5s} | "
        f"MASTER={len(category_df):6d} | "
        f"TRAIN={counts['TRAIN']:6d} | "
        f"VAL={counts['VAL']:6d} | "
        f"TEST={counts['TEST']:6d} | "
        f"MISSING={len(category_df)-assigned:6d}"
    )

# ================================================================
# 5. CELL PARTITION DIAGNOSTIC
# ================================================================

cc = split_data["COLD_COMBINATION"]
cell = split_data["COLD_CELL"]

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("COLD_CELL PARTITION DIAGNOSTIC")
print("=" * 75)

cell_train = set(cell["train"]["CELLNAME"].unique())
cell_val   = set(cell["val"]["CELLNAME"].unique())
cell_test  = set(cell["test"]["CELLNAME"].unique())

print("TRAIN cells:", len(cell_train))
print("VAL cells  :", len(cell_val))
print("TEST cells :", len(cell_test))

print("\nCell overlaps:")
print("TRAIN ∩ VAL :", len(cell_train & cell_val))
print("TRAIN ∩ TEST:", len(cell_train & cell_test))
print("VAL ∩ TEST  :", len(cell_val & cell_test))

# ================================================================
# 6. HOW DOES COLD_CELL ASSIGN CROSS-PARTITION ROWS?
# ================================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("COLD_CELL ROW ASSIGNMENT RULE")
print("=" * 75)

def cell_group(cell_name):

    if cell_name in cell_train:
        return "TRAIN"

    if cell_name in cell_val:
        return "VAL"

    if cell_name in cell_test:
        return "TEST"

    return "UNKNOWN"


cell_category = np.array([
    cell_group(x)
    for x in master["CELLNAME"]
])

cell_split_keys = {
    "TRAIN": set(make_keys(cell["train"])),
    "VAL": set(make_keys(cell["val"])),
    "TEST": set(make_keys(cell["test"]))
}

for group in ["TRAIN", "VAL", "TEST", "UNKNOWN"]:

    mask = cell_category == group

    if not mask.any():
        continue

    category_df = master.loc[mask]

    cat_keys = set(make_keys(category_df))

    counts = {
        split_name: len(cat_keys & keys)
        for split_name, keys in cell_split_keys.items()
    }

    assigned = sum(counts.values())

    print(
        f"{group:7s} | "
        f"MASTER={len(category_df):6d} | "
        f"TRAIN={counts['TRAIN']:6d} | "
        f"VAL={counts['VAL']:6d} | "
        f"TEST={counts['TEST']:6d} | "
        f"MISSING={len(category_df)-assigned:6d}"
    )

# ================================================================
# 7. COLD_COMBINATION PAIR DIAGNOSTIC
# ================================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("COLD_COMBINATION DIAGNOSTIC")
print("=" * 75)

def canonical_pair(a, b):
    return tuple(sorted([a, b]))

cc_train_pairs = set(
    canonical_pair(a, b)
    for a, b in zip(
        cc["train"]["drug_A"],
        cc["train"]["drug_B"]
    )
)

cc_val_pairs = set(
    canonical_pair(a, b)
    for a, b in zip(
        cc["val"]["drug_A"],
        cc["val"]["drug_B"]
    )
)

cc_test_pairs = set(
    canonical_pair(a, b)
    for a, b in zip(
        cc["test"]["drug_A"],
        cc["test"]["drug_B"]
    )
)

print("Train pairs:", len(cc_train_pairs))
print("Val pairs  :", len(cc_val_pairs))
print("Test pairs :", len(cc_test_pairs))

print("\nPair overlap:")
print("TRAIN ∩ VAL :", len(cc_train_pairs & cc_val_pairs))
print("TRAIN ∩ TEST:", len(cc_train_pairs & cc_test_pairs))
print("VAL ∩ TEST  :", len(cc_val_pairs & cc_test_pairs))

# ================================================================

# ================================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("DIAGNOSTIC COMPLETE")
print("=" * 75)

print("NO FILES MODIFIED")
print("NO SPLITS CREATED")
print("NO MODEL RETRAINED")
print()

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=" * 75)
print("TRUSTSYN — REBUILDING COLD_DRUG WITH FULL MASTER COVERAGE")
print("=" * 75)

# ============================================================
# 1. FROZEN MASTER
# ============================================================

MASTER = MASTER_MODEL.copy()

required_cols = ["drug_A", "drug_B", "CELLNAME", "combo_score"]

missing = [c for c in required_cols if c not in MASTER.columns]
if missing:
    raise ValueError(f"MASTER missing required columns: {missing}")

print(f"MASTER shape: {MASTER.shape}")

# ============================================================
# 2. EXISTING DRUG PARTITION
# ============================================================

# These must already exist from the original COLD_DRUG partition.
# We are NOT creating new drug groups.

train_drugs = set(TRAIN_DRUGS)
val_drugs   = set(VAL_DRUGS)
test_drugs  = set(TEST_DRUGS)

print("\nDRUG PARTITION")
print(f"TRAIN drugs: {len(train_drugs)}")
print(f"VAL drugs  : {len(val_drugs)}")
print(f"TEST drugs : {len(test_drugs)}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Partition integrity
# ------------------------------------------------------------

if train_drugs & val_drugs:
    raise ValueError("TRAIN/VAL drug overlap detected")

if train_drugs & test_drugs:
    raise ValueError("TRAIN/TEST drug overlap detected")

if val_drugs & test_drugs:
    raise ValueError("VAL/TEST drug overlap detected")

all_partition_drugs = train_drugs | val_drugs | test_drugs
master_drugs = set(
    pd.concat([MASTER["drug_A"], MASTER["drug_B"]]).dropna().unique()
)

if all_partition_drugs != master_drugs:
    print("\nWARNING — drug partition does not exactly match MASTER universe")

    print(
        "Drugs in MASTER but not partition:",
        sorted(master_drugs - all_partition_drugs)
    )

    print(
        "Drugs in partition but not MASTER:",
        sorted(all_partition_drugs - master_drugs)
    )

    raise ValueError("Drug partition does not cover MASTER exactly")

print("PASS — drug partition covers all 104 MASTER drugs")

# ============================================================
# 3. NORMALIZE DRUG IDS FOR SAFE MEMBERSHIP TESTING
# ============================================================

drug_A = MASTER["drug_A"]
drug_B = MASTER["drug_B"]

# ============================================================
# 4. DEFINE ROW-LEVEL COLD-DRUG RULE
# ============================================================

A_train = drug_A.isin(train_drugs)
B_train = drug_B.isin(train_drugs)

A_val = drug_A.isin(val_drugs)
B_val = drug_B.isin(val_drugs)

A_test = drug_A.isin(test_drugs)
B_test = drug_B.isin(test_drugs)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TRAIN
# Both drugs must belong to TRAIN drug universe.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

train_mask = A_train & B_train

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TEST has highest priority:
# any TEST drug makes the row TEST.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

test_mask = A_test | B_test

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# VAL:
# no TEST drug, but at least one VAL drug.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

val_mask = (~test_mask) & (A_val | B_val)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Safety:
# every row must belong to exactly one split.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assignment_count = (
    train_mask.astype(int)
    + val_mask.astype(int)
    + test_mask.astype(int)
)

if not (assignment_count == 1).all():
    bad = MASTER.loc[assignment_count != 1]
    raise ValueError(
        f"Assignment failure: {len(bad)} rows do not have exactly one split"
    )

# ============================================================
# 5. CREATE CANDIDATE SPLITS
# ============================================================

cold_drug_train_new = MASTER.loc[train_mask].copy()
cold_drug_val_new   = MASTER.loc[val_mask].copy()
cold_drug_test_new  = MASTER.loc[test_mask].copy()

print("\nCANDIDATE SPLIT SIZES")
print(f"TRAIN: {len(cold_drug_train_new):,}")
print(f"VAL  : {len(cold_drug_val_new):,}")
print(f"TEST : {len(cold_drug_test_new):,}")

# ============================================================
# 6. FULL COVERAGE
# ============================================================

total = (
    len(cold_drug_train_new)
    + len(cold_drug_val_new)
    + len(cold_drug_test_new)
)

print("\nROW COVERAGE")
print(f"MASTER: {len(MASTER):,}")
print(f"ASSIGNED: {total:,}")
print(f"MISSING: {len(MASTER) - total:,}")

if total != len(MASTER):
    raise ValueError("COLD_DRUG does not cover MASTER")

print("PASS — complete MASTER coverage")

# ============================================================
# 7. ROW IDENTITY CHECK
# ============================================================

def make_key(df):
    return (
        df["drug_A"].astype(str)
        + "||"
        + df["drug_B"].astype(str)
        + "||"
        + df["CELLNAME"].astype(str)
    )

master_keys = make_key(MASTER)

train_keys = make_key(cold_drug_train_new)
val_keys   = make_key(cold_drug_val_new)
test_keys  = make_key(cold_drug_test_new)

print("\nROW OVERLAP")

print(
    "TRAIN ∩ VAL:",
    len(set(train_keys) & set(val_keys))
)

print(
    "TRAIN ∩ TEST:",
    len(set(train_keys) & set(test_keys))
)

print(
    "VAL ∩ TEST:",
    len(set(val_keys) & set(test_keys))
)

if (
    len(set(train_keys) & set(val_keys)) != 0
    or len(set(train_keys) & set(test_keys)) != 0
    or len(set(val_keys) & set(test_keys)) != 0
):
    raise ValueError("Split overlap detected")

print("PASS — zero internal overlap")

# ============================================================
# 8. VERIFY DRUG COLDNESS
# ============================================================

train_used = set(
    pd.concat([
        cold_drug_train_new["drug_A"],
        cold_drug_train_new["drug_B"]
    ]).unique()
)

val_used = set(
    pd.concat([
        cold_drug_val_new["drug_A"],
        cold_drug_val_new["drug_B"]
    ]).unique()
)

test_used = set(
    pd.concat([
        cold_drug_test_new["drug_A"],
        cold_drug_test_new["drug_B"]
    ]).unique()
)

print("\nDRUG COLDNESS")

print(
    "TRAIN drugs used in VAL:",
    len(train_used & val_drugs)
)

print(
    "TRAIN drugs used in TEST:",
    len(train_used & test_drugs)
)

print(
    "VAL drugs used in TRAIN:",
    len(train_used & val_drugs)
)

print(
    "TEST drugs used in TRAIN:",
    len(train_used & test_drugs)
)

# ============================================================
# 9. FINAL DIAGNOSTIC
# ============================================================

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("COLD_DRUG REBUILD DIAGNOSTIC")
print("=" * 75)

print(f"MASTER rows : {len(MASTER):,}")
print(f"TRAIN rows  : {len(cold_drug_train_new):,}")
print(f"VAL rows    : {len(cold_drug_val_new):,}")
print(f"TEST rows   : {len(cold_drug_test_new):,}")

print("\nPASS — candidate COLD_DRUG has full MASTER coverage")
print("PASS — zero row overlap")
print("PASS — existing drug partition preserved")
print("PASS — NO FILES MODIFIED")
print("PASS — NO MODEL RETRAINED")

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

print("=" * 75)
print("TRUSTSYN — RECOVERING FROZEN COLD_DRUG DRUG PARTITION")
print("=" * 75)

COLD_DRUG_DIR = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug")

train_path = COLD_DRUG_DIR / "train.csv"
val_path   = COLD_DRUG_DIR / "val.csv"
test_path  = COLD_DRUG_DIR / "test.csv"

if not train_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(train_path)

if not val_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(val_path)

if not test_path.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(test_path)

# Load ONLY the existing split files
old_cd_train = pd.read_csv(train_path)
old_cd_val   = pd.read_csv(val_path)
old_cd_test  = pd.read_csv(test_path)

print("\nEXISTING FILES")
print(f"TRAIN: {old_cd_train.shape}")
print(f"VAL  : {old_cd_val.shape}")
print(f"TEST : {old_cd_test.shape}")


# ============================================================
# Recover drug universe from each existing split
# ============================================================

def get_drug_universe(df):
    return set(
        pd.concat(
            [
                df["drug_A"],
                df["drug_B"]
            ],
            ignore_index=True
        ).dropna().unique()
    )


TRAIN_DRUGS = get_drug_universe(old_cd_train)
VAL_DRUGS   = get_drug_universe(old_cd_val)
TEST_DRUGS  = get_drug_universe(old_cd_test)

print(f"TRAIN drugs: {len(TRAIN_DRUGS)}")
print(f"VAL drugs  : {len(VAL_DRUGS)}")
print(f"TEST drugs : {len(TEST_DRUGS)}")

print("\nPARTITION OVERLAPS")
print("TRAIN ∩ VAL :", len(TRAIN_DRUGS & VAL_DRUGS))
print("TRAIN ∩ TEST:", len(TRAIN_DRUGS & TEST_DRUGS))
print("VAL ∩ TEST  :", len(VAL_DRUGS & TEST_DRUGS))


# ============================================================
# IMPORTANT:
# Existing files are incomplete, but they still reveal
# the original drug partition.
# ============================================================

if TRAIN_DRUGS & VAL_DRUGS:
    raise ValueError("Existing COLD_DRUG has TRAIN/VAL drug overlap.")

if TRAIN_DRUGS & TEST_DRUGS:
    raise ValueError("Existing COLD_DRUG has TRAIN/TEST drug overlap.")

if VAL_DRUGS & TEST_DRUGS:
    raise ValueError("Existing COLD_DRUG has VAL/TEST drug overlap.")

print("\nPASS — existing drug partition is mutually exclusive")

print("\nTRAIN drugs:")
print(sorted(TRAIN_DRUGS))

print("\nVAL drugs:")
print(sorted(VAL_DRUGS))

print("\nTEST drugs:")
print(sorted(TEST_DRUGS))

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("PARTITION RECOVERY COMPLETE")
print("=" * 75)
print("No files modified.")
print("No splits created.")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=" * 75)
print("TRUSTSYN — COLD_DRUG COMPLETE COVERAGE RECONSTRUCTION")
print("=" * 75)

# ============================================================
# 1. FROZEN MASTER
# ============================================================

MASTER = MASTER_MODEL.copy()

print(f"\nMASTER: {MASTER.shape}")

# ============================================================
# 2. USE THE RECOVERED ORIGINAL PARTITION
# ============================================================

train_drugs = set(TRAIN_DRUGS)
val_drugs   = set(VAL_DRUGS)
test_drugs  = set(TEST_DRUGS)

all_drugs = train_drugs | val_drugs | test_drugs

master_drugs = set(
    pd.concat(
        [MASTER["drug_A"], MASTER["drug_B"]],
        ignore_index=True
    ).dropna().unique()
)

if all_drugs != master_drugs:
    raise ValueError(
        "Recovered drug partition does not exactly cover MASTER drug universe."
    )

print("\nDRUG PARTITION")
print(f"TRAIN: {len(train_drugs)}")
print(f"VAL  : {len(val_drugs)}")
print(f"TEST : {len(test_drugs)}")
print(f"TOTAL: {len(all_drugs)}")

# ============================================================
# 3. ROW-LEVEL MEMBERSHIP
# ============================================================

A_train = MASTER["drug_A"].isin(train_drugs)
B_train = MASTER["drug_B"].isin(train_drugs)

A_val = MASTER["drug_A"].isin(val_drugs)
B_val = MASTER["drug_B"].isin(val_drugs)

A_test = MASTER["drug_A"].isin(test_drugs)
B_test = MASTER["drug_B"].isin(test_drugs)

# ============================================================
# 4. ASSIGNMENT RULE
# ============================================================

# TRAIN:
# both drugs must be TRAIN drugs
train_mask = A_train & B_train

# TEST:
# any TEST drug makes the pair TEST
test_mask = A_test | B_test

# VAL:
# no TEST drug + at least one VAL drug
val_mask = (~test_mask) & (A_val | B_val)

# ============================================================
# 5. EXACTLY-ONE-SPLIT CHECK
# ============================================================

assignment_count = (
    train_mask.astype(int)
    + val_mask.astype(int)
    + test_mask.astype(int)
)

bad_count = (assignment_count != 1).sum()

print("\nASSIGNMENT CHECK")
print(f"Rows assigned exactly once: {(assignment_count == 1).sum():,}")
print(f"Rows with invalid assignment: {bad_count:,}")

if bad_count != 0:
    raise ValueError(
        f"{bad_count} MASTER rows were not assigned exactly once."
    )

# ============================================================
# 6. BUILD CANDIDATE SPLITS
# ============================================================

cold_drug_train_candidate = MASTER.loc[train_mask].copy()
cold_drug_val_candidate   = MASTER.loc[val_mask].copy()
cold_drug_test_candidate  = MASTER.loc[test_mask].copy()

print("\nCANDIDATE SIZES")
print(f"TRAIN: {len(cold_drug_train_candidate):,}")
print(f"VAL  : {len(cold_drug_val_candidate):,}")
print(f"TEST : {len(cold_drug_test_candidate):,}")

# ============================================================
# 7. MASTER COVERAGE
# ============================================================

total_assigned = (
    len(cold_drug_train_candidate)
    + len(cold_drug_val_candidate)
    + len(cold_drug_test_candidate)
)

print("\nROW COVERAGE")
print(f"MASTER rows   : {len(MASTER):,}")
print(f"Assigned rows : {total_assigned:,}")
print(f"Missing rows  : {len(MASTER) - total_assigned:,}")

if total_assigned != len(MASTER):
    raise ValueError("MASTER coverage failure.")

print("PASS — complete MASTER coverage")

# ============================================================
# 8. ROW IDENTITY
# ============================================================

def make_row_key(df):
    return (
        df["drug_A"].astype(str)
        + "||"
        + df["drug_B"].astype(str)
        + "||"
        + df["CELLNAME"].astype(str)
    )

master_keys = set(make_row_key(MASTER))

train_keys = set(make_row_key(cold_drug_train_candidate))
val_keys   = set(make_row_key(cold_drug_val_candidate))
test_keys  = set(make_row_key(cold_drug_test_candidate))

print("\nROW OVERLAP")
print("TRAIN ∩ VAL :", len(train_keys & val_keys))
print("TRAIN ∩ TEST:", len(train_keys & test_keys))
print("VAL ∩ TEST  :", len(val_keys & test_keys))

if train_keys & val_keys:
    raise ValueError("TRAIN/VAL overlap detected.")

if train_keys & test_keys:
    raise ValueError("TRAIN/TEST overlap detected.")

if val_keys & test_keys:
    raise ValueError("VAL/TEST overlap detected.")

print("PASS — zero internal row overlap")

# ============================================================
# 9. DRUG COLDNESS
# ============================================================

def used_drugs(df):
    return set(
        pd.concat(
            [df["drug_A"], df["drug_B"]],
            ignore_index=True
        ).dropna().unique()
    )

train_used = used_drugs(cold_drug_train_candidate)
val_used   = used_drugs(cold_drug_val_candidate)
test_used  = used_drugs(cold_drug_test_candidate)

print("\nDRUG COLDNESS")

print(
    "TRAIN rows containing VAL drugs:",
    len(train_used & val_drugs)
)

print(
    "TRAIN rows containing TEST drugs:",
    len(train_used & test_drugs)
)

print(
    "VAL rows containing TEST drugs:",
    len(val_used & test_drugs)
)

print(
    "VAL drugs present in TRAIN:",
    len(train_used & val_drugs)
)

print(
    "TEST drugs present in TRAIN:",
    len(train_used & test_drugs)
)

# TRUSTSYN — FINAL COLD_DRUG RULE VALIDATION
# READ-ONLY — NO FILES MODIFIED
