import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

print("=" * 75)
print("TRUSTSYN — FINAL COLD_DRUG RULE VALIDATION")
print("=" * 75)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. REQUIRED OBJECTS
# ------------------------------------------------

required = [
    "MASTER_MODEL",
    "train_drugs",
    "val_drugs",
    "test_drugs",
]

missing = [x for x in required if x not in globals()]

if missing:
    raise NameError(
        f"Missing required objects: {missing}\n"
        "Do not create new partitions. Recover the existing objects first."
    )

master = MASTER_MODEL.copy()

train_drugs = set(train_drugs)
val_drugs   = set(val_drugs)
test_drugs  = set(test_drugs)

print("\nMASTER:", master.shape)
print("Train drugs:", len(train_drugs))
print("Val drugs  :", len(val_drugs))
print("Test drugs :", len(test_drugs))

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. PARTITION INTEGRITY
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("DRUG PARTITION INTEGRITY")
print("=" * 75)

print("Train ∩ Val :", len(train_drugs & val_drugs))
print("Train ∩ Test:", len(train_drugs & test_drugs))
print("Val ∩ Test  :", len(val_drugs & test_drugs))

all_partition_drugs = train_drugs | val_drugs | test_drugs
master_drugs = set(
    pd.concat([
        master["drug_A"],
        master["drug_B"]
    ]).dropna().unique()
)

print("Partition drugs:", len(all_partition_drugs))
print("MASTER drugs   :", len(master_drugs))
print("Missing drugs  :", len(master_drugs - all_partition_drugs))
print("Extra drugs    :", len(all_partition_drugs - master_drugs))

assert not (train_drugs & val_drugs)
assert not (train_drugs & test_drugs)
assert not (val_drugs & test_drugs)
assert master_drugs == all_partition_drugs

print("PASS — drug partition is complete and mutually exclusive")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. CONSTRUCT CANDIDATE ASSIGNMENT
# ------------------------------------------------

A = master["drug_A"]
B = master["drug_B"]

A_train = A.isin(train_drugs)
A_val   = A.isin(val_drugs)
A_test  = A.isin(test_drugs)

B_train = B.isin(train_drugs)
B_val   = B.isin(val_drugs)
B_test  = B.isin(test_drugs)

# Hierarchical cold-drug assignment:
#
# TRAIN = both drugs are TRAIN drugs
# VAL   = no TEST drug AND at least one VAL drug
# TEST  = everything containing a TEST drug
#
# This gives complete MASTER coverage.

assign_train = A_train & B_train
assign_val   = (~A_test & ~B_test) & (A_val | B_val)
assign_test  = A_test | B_test

assignment_count = (
    assign_train.astype(int)
    + assign_val.astype(int)
    + assign_test.astype(int)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. ASSIGNMENT VALIDITY
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("ASSIGNMENT VALIDITY")
print("=" * 75)

print("Exactly one assignment:",
      (assignment_count == 1).sum())

print("Zero assignments:",
      (assignment_count == 0).sum())

print("Multiple assignments:",
      (assignment_count > 1).sum())

assert (assignment_count == 1).all()

print("PASS — every MASTER row receives exactly one split")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. RECONSTRUCTED SIZES
# ------------------------------------------------

recon_train = master.loc[assign_train].copy()
recon_val   = master.loc[assign_val].copy()
recon_test  = master.loc[assign_test].copy()

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("RECONSTRUCTED SPLIT SIZES")
print("=" * 75)

print(f"TRAIN: {len(recon_train):,}")
print(f"VAL  : {len(recon_val):,}")
print(f"TEST : {len(recon_test):,}")
print(f"TOTAL: {len(recon_train)+len(recon_val)+len(recon_test):,}")

assert (
    len(recon_train)
    + len(recon_val)
    + len(recon_test)
    == len(master)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. ROW IDENTITY / OVERLAP
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("ROW OVERLAP")
print("=" * 75)

def make_key(df):
    return (
        df["drug_A"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["drug_B"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["CELLNAME"].astype(str)
    )

train_keys = set(make_key(recon_train))
val_keys   = set(make_key(recon_val))
test_keys  = set(make_key(recon_test))

print("TRAIN ∩ VAL :", len(train_keys & val_keys))
print("TRAIN ∩ TEST:", len(train_keys & test_keys))
print("VAL ∩ TEST  :", len(val_keys & test_keys))

assert not (train_keys & val_keys)
assert not (train_keys & test_keys)
assert not (val_keys & test_keys)

print("PASS — zero row overlap")

# ------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("DRUG COLDNESS")
print("=" * 75)

# Validation-held-out drugs must never occur in TRAIN
train_used_drugs = set(
    pd.concat([
        recon_train["drug_A"],

    ]).unique()
)

val_used_drugs = set(

print("VAL drugs in TRAIN:",
      len(val_drugs & train_used_drugs))

print("TEST drugs in TRAIN:",
      len(test_drugs & train_used_drugs))

print("TEST drugs in VAL:",
      len(test_drugs & val_used_drugs))

assert not (val_drugs & train_used_drugs)
assert not (test_drugs & train_used_drugs)
assert not (test_drugs & val_used_drugs)

print("PASS — cold-drug separation preserved")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    mean_squared_error,
    mean_absolute_error,
    r2_score
)
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr

print("=" * 75)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 CORRECTED COLD_DRUG EVALUATION")
print("=" * 75)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD FROZEN MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------

MODEL_PATH = Path(
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/models/CatBoost_v2.cbm"
)

if not MODEL_PATH.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Frozen V2 model not found:\n{MODEL_PATH}"
    )

v2_model = CatBoostRegressor()
v2_model.load_model(str(MODEL_PATH))

print("PASS — frozen CatBoost V2 loaded")
print("Tree count:", v2_model.tree_count_)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. LOAD CORRECTED SPLIT
# ------------------------------------------------

SPLIT_DIR = Path(
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug_corrected"
)

train = pd.read_csv(SPLIT_DIR / "train.csv")
val   = pd.read_csv(SPLIT_DIR / "val.csv")
test  = pd.read_csv(SPLIT_DIR / "test.csv")

print("\nSPLITS")
print("Train:", train.shape)
print("Val  :", val.shape)
print("Test :", test.shape)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. USE EXACT V2 FEATURE LIST
# ------------------------------------------------

# Recover the exact feature columns from the existing
# frozen V2 feature matrix.

if "X_clean" not in globals():
    raise NameError(
        "X_clean is not available. "
        "Do not reconstruct the feature list manually."
    )

feature_cols = list(X_clean.columns)

print("\nFEATURES")
print("Number of V2 features:", len(feature_cols))

if len(feature_cols) != 62:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Expected 62 V2 features, found {len(feature_cols)}."
    )

missing_train = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in train.columns]
missing_val   = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in val.columns]
missing_test  = [c for c in feature_cols if c not in test.columns]

if missing_train or missing_val or missing_test:
    raise ValueError(
        f"Missing features:\n"
        f"Train: {missing_train}\n"
        f"Val: {missing_val}\n"
        f"Test: {missing_test}"
    )

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. TARGET
# ------------------------------------------------

TARGET = "combo_score"

for df_name, df in [
    ("TRAIN", train),
    ("VAL", val),
    ("TEST", test)
]:
    if TARGET not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError(
            f"{TARGET} missing from {df_name}"
        )

X_train = train[feature_cols]
y_train = train[TARGET]

X_val = val[feature_cols]
y_val = val[TARGET]

X_test = test[feature_cols]
y_test = test[TARGET]

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. PREDICTIONS
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("GENERATING PREDICTIONS")
print("=" * 75)

pred_val = v2_model.predict(X_val)
pred_test = v2_model.predict(X_test)

print("PASS — predictions generated")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. METRICS
# ------------------------------------------------

def calculate_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred))
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred)
    r2 = r2_score(y_true, y_pred)

    pearson = pearsonr(y_true, y_pred)[0]
    spearman = spearmanr(y_true, y_pred)[0]

    nrmse = rmse / np.std(y_true)

    return {
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "R2": r2,
        "Pearson": pearson,
        "Spearman": spearman,
        "NRMSE": nrmse
    }

val_metrics = calculate_metrics(y_val, pred_val)
test_metrics = calculate_metrics(y_test, pred_test)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. RESULTS
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("CORRECTED COLD_DRUG RESULTS")
print("=" * 75)

print("\nVALIDATION")
for k, v in val_metrics.items():
    print(f"{k:10s}: {v:.6f}")

print("\nTEST")
for k, v in test_metrics.items():
    print(f"{k:10s}: {v:.6f}")

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("FINAL")
print("=" * 75)

print("Model       : CatBoost V2")
print("Features    :", len(feature_cols))
print("Train rows  :", len(train))
print("Val rows    :", len(val))
print("Test rows   :", len(test))
print("Tree count  :", v2_model.tree_count_)

print("\nPASS — corrected COLD_DRUG evaluated")
print("PASS — no files modified")
print("PASS — no model retrained")

        df["drug_A"].astype(str)
        + "||"
        + df["drug_B"].astype(str)
        + "||"
        + df["CELLNAME"].astype(str)
    )

    "MASTER does not have unique row keys."

    extra   = all_keys - master_key_set

    print(f"Missing from MASTER: {len(missing):,}")

    assert len(vt) == 0, f"{name}: Val-Test overlap"

    "COLD_COMBINATION": (235050, 29465, 29558),
    "COLD_CELL": (234256, 30030, 29787),
    "COLD_DRUG": (185064, 48867, 60142),

import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

# ============================================================
# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 CORRECTED FOUR-SPLIT BENCHMARK
# ============================================================

MODEL_DIR = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/model_related_files")

OLD_METRICS = MODEL_DIR / "CatBoost_v2_metrics.csv"
NEW_METRICS = MODEL_DIR / "CatBoost_V2_four_split_corrected_metrics.csv"

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load existing saved V2 metrics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

df = pd.read_csv(OLD_METRICS)

print("=" * 75)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 CORRECTED FOUR-SPLIT BENCHMARK")
print("=" * 75)

print("\nOriginal saved metrics:")
print(df.to_string(index=False))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Keep only the three VALID existing evaluations
# ------------------------------------------------------------

valid_splits = [
    "RANDOM",
    "COLD_COMBINATION",
    "COLD_CELL"
]

benchmark = df[df["Split"].isin(valid_splits)].copy()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Add CORRECTED COLD_DRUG result
# ------------------------------------------------------------

corrected_cold_drug = {
    "Model": "CatBoost_V2",
    "Split": "COLD_DRUG",
    "Features": 62,

    "Train_Rows": 185064,
    "Val_Rows": 48867,
    "Test_Rows": 60142,

    # Corrected evaluation
    "RMSE": 5.075915,
    "MAE": 3.557391,
    "R2": 0.455731,
    "Pearson": 0.686683,
    "Spearman": 0.565136,

    # NOTE:
    # Do NOT copy the old NRMSE because the saved
    # NRMSE convention is inconsistent with the
    # corrected evaluation.
    "NRMSE": 0.737746,

    "Best_Iteration": 1799,
    "Tree_Count": 1800
}

benchmark = pd.concat(
    [
        benchmark,
        pd.DataFrame([corrected_cold_drug])
    ],
    ignore_index=True
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Enforce split order
# ------------------------------------------------------------

split_order = {
    "RANDOM": 0,
    "COLD_COMBINATION": 1,
    "COLD_CELL": 2,
    "COLD_DRUG": 3
}

benchmark["_order"] = benchmark["Split"].map(split_order)

benchmark = (
    benchmark
    .sort_values("_order")
    .drop(columns="_order")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Validate exactly four rows
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assert len(benchmark) == 4
assert benchmark["Split"].tolist() == [
    "RANDOM",
    "COLD_COMBINATION",
    "COLD_CELL",
    "COLD_DRUG"
]

assert benchmark["Model"].eq("CatBoost_V2").all()
assert benchmark["Features"].eq(62).all()
assert benchmark["Tree_Count"].eq(1800).all()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Validate split sizes
# ------------------------------------------------------------

expected_sizes = {
    "RANDOM": (235258, 29407, 29408),
    "COLD_COMBINATION": (235050, 29465, 29558),
    "COLD_CELL": (234256, 30030, 29787),
    "COLD_DRUG": (185064, 48867, 60142),
}

for split, (train_n, val_n, test_n) in expected_sizes.items():

    row = benchmark.loc[benchmark["Split"] == split].iloc[0]

    assert int(row["Train_Rows"]) == train_n
    assert int(row["Val_Rows"]) == val_n
    assert int(row["Test_Rows"]) == test_n

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Save NEW artifact
# ------------------------------------------------------------

benchmark.to_csv(NEW_METRICS, index=False)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Final audit
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("FINAL FOUR-SPLIT BENCHMARK")
print("=" * 75)

print(benchmark.to_string(index=False))

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("SPLIT SIZE VALIDATION")
print("=" * 75)

for split, expected in expected_sizes.items():

    row = benchmark.loc[benchmark["Split"] == split].iloc[0]

    actual = (
        int(row["Train_Rows"]),
        int(row["Val_Rows"]),
        int(row["Test_Rows"])
    )

    print(
        f"{split:<18} | "
        f"actual={actual} | "
        f"expected={expected} | "
        f"{'PASS' if actual == expected else 'FAIL'}"
    )

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("OUTPUT")
print("=" * 75)

print(f"Saved: {NEW_METRICS}")

print("\nPASS — four-split CatBoost V2 benchmark created")
print("PASS — corrected COLD_DRUG included")
print("PASS — original metrics file untouched")
print("PASS — no MASTER modified")
print("PASS — no feature files modified")
print("PASS — no split files modified")
print("PASS — no model retrained")

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import json

MODEL_DIR = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/model_related_files")

print("=" * 75)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 FEATURE DEFINITION AUDIT")
print("=" * 75)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Inspect candidate V2 feature files
# ------------------------------------------------------------

candidates = [
    MODEL_DIR / "CatBoost_v2_metrics.csv",
    MODEL_DIR / "CatBoost_V2_four_split_corrected_metrics.csv",
    MODEL_DIR / "CatBoost_V2_features.csv",
    MODEL_DIR / "CatBoost_v2_features.csv",
    MODEL_DIR / "CatBoost_v2_parameters.json",
]

print("\nAVAILABLE CANDIDATE FILES")
for p in candidates:
    print(f"{p.name:<50} | exists={p.exists()}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Look for parameter/feature-definition JSON
# ------------------------------------------------------------

json_files = list(MODEL_DIR.glob("*V2*.json")) + list(MODEL_DIR.glob("*v2*.json"))

print("\nV2 JSON FILES")
for p in json_files:
    print(" -", p.name)

for p in json_files:
    try:
        with open(p, "r") as f:
            obj = json.load(f)

        print(f"\nJSON: {p.name}")
        print("Keys:", list(obj.keys()))

        for key, value in obj.items():
            if isinstance(value, list):
                print(f"{key}: {len(value)} items")
                if len(value) <= 100:
                    print(value)

    except Exception as e:
        print("Could not read:", p.name, "|", repr(e))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Inspect feature CSVs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

feature_files = [
    p for p in MODEL_DIR.glob("*.csv")
    if "feature" in p.name.lower()
]

print("\nFEATURE CSV FILES")

for p in feature_files:
    try:
        tmp = pd.read_csv(p, nrows=5)

        print(f"\nFILE: {p.name}")
        print("Shape sample:", tmp.shape)
        print("Columns:", tmp.columns.tolist())

    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR:", p.name, repr(e))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Print obvious feature groups from MASTER/model schema
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("PROPOSED FEATURE GROUP DETECTION")
print("=" * 75)

# Use the MASTER_MODEL object if available.
if "MASTER_MODEL" in globals():

    master_cols = list(MASTER_MODEL.columns)

    # Candidate non-feature columns
    excluded = {
        "drug_A",
        "drug_B",
        "CELLNAME",
        "tissue",
        "combo_score",
        "CONC1",
        "CONC2",
        "cellminer_cellline_id",
        "nci_almanac_cellname"
    }

    candidates = [
        c for c in master_cols
        if c not in excluded
    ]

    print("\nCandidate feature columns:", len(candidates))

    print("\nALL CANDIDATE FEATURES")
    for i, c in enumerate(candidates, 1):
        print(f"{i:02d}. {c}")

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # Group detection
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    groups = {
        "STRING": [],
        "KEGG": [],
        "MOLECULAR": [],
        "TARGET": [],
        "CELLMINER": [],
        "OTHER": []
    }

    for c in candidates:

        lc = c.lower()

        if "string" in lc:
            groups["STRING"].append(c)

        elif "kegg" in lc:
            groups["KEGG"].append(c)

        elif (
            "tanimoto" in lc
            or "fingerprint" in lc
        ):
            groups["MOLECULAR"].append(c)

        elif (
            "target" in lc
            or "jaccard" in lc
            or "overlap" in lc
            or "shared_target" in lc
        ):
            groups["TARGET"].append(c)

        elif "cellminer" in lc:
            groups["CELLMINER"].append(c)

        else:
            groups["OTHER"].append(c)

    print("\nFEATURE GROUPS")

    for group, cols in groups.items():
        print(f"\n{group}: {len(cols)}")
        for c in cols:
            print("   ", c)

else:
    print("\nMASTER_MODEL is not available in this notebook.")
    print("Load the frozen MASTER_MODEL first, then rerun this cell.")

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("AUDIT COMPLETE")
print("=" * 75)
print("NO FILES MODIFIED")
print("NO SPLITS MODIFIED")
print("NO MODEL RETRAINED")

ROOT = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn")

print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 PROVENANCE AUDIT")
print("=" * 75)

# 1. ALL MODEL-RELATED FILES
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print("-" * 75)

    if p.is_file():
        print(p.relative_to(ROOT))

# 2. SEARCH FOR CATBOOST MODEL ARTIFACTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("CATBOOST MODEL ARTIFACTS")
print("=" * 75)

cbm_files = list(ROOT.rglob("*.cbm"))

if cbm_files:
    for p in sorted(cbm_files):
        print(f"{p}")
else:
    print("No .cbm files found.")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SEARCH ALL TEXT / JSON / NOTEBOOK FILES FOR V2 REFERENCES
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("V2 REFERENCES")
print("=" * 75)

extensions = {".py", ".ipynb", ".txt", ".json", ".csv"}

keywords = [
    "CatBoost_V2",
    "CatBoost v2",
    "CatBoostV2",
    "1800",
    "62",
    "feature_names",
]

matches = []

for p in ROOT.rglob("*"):
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    if p.suffix.lower() not in extensions:
        continue

    try:
        text = p.read_text(errors="ignore")
    except Exception:
        continue

    found = [k for k in keywords if k.lower() in text.lower()]

    if found:
        matches.append((p, found))

for p, found in matches:
    print(f"\nFILE: {p}")
    print("MATCHES:", found)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. SPECIFIC V2 METRIC FILE
# ------------------------------------------------------------
print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("V2 METRIC FILE")
print("=" * 75)

v2_metrics = MODEL_DIR / "CatBoost_v2_metrics.csv"

if v2_metrics.exists():
    import pandas as pd

    df_v2 = pd.read_csv(v2_metrics)

    print("Exists:", True)
    print("Shape:", df_v2.shape)
    print("\nColumns:")
    print(df_v2.columns.tolist())
    print("\nData:")
    print(df_v2.to_string(index=False))
else:
    print("V2 metric file not found.")

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("AUDIT COMPLETE")
print("=" * 75)
print("NO FILES MODIFIED")
print("NO SPLITS MODIFIED")
print("NO MODEL RETRAINED")

def objective(trial):

    params = {
        "iterations": 1800,
        "learning_rate": trial.suggest_float(
            "learning_rate", 0.01, 0.15, log=True
        ),
        "depth": trial.suggest_int(
            "depth", 4, 10
        ),
        "l2_leaf_reg": trial.suggest_float(
            "l2_leaf_reg", 1.0, 20.0, log=True
        ),
        "random_strength": trial.suggest_float(
            "random_strength", 0.0, 2.0
        ),
        "bagging_temperature": trial.suggest_float(
            "bagging_temperature", 0.0, 5.0
        ),
        "border_count": trial.suggest_int(
            "border_count", 32, 255
        ),
        "loss_function": "RMSE",
        "eval_metric": "RMSE",
        "random_seed": 42,
        "verbose": False,
        "allow_writing_files": False
    }

    model = CatBoostRegressor(**params)

    model.fit(
        X_train_opt,
        y_train_opt,
        eval_set=(X_val_opt, y_val_opt),
        early_stopping_rounds=100,
        verbose=False
    )

    pred = model.predict(X_val_opt)

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(y_val_opt, pred)
    )

    return rmse

# ================================================================
# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 OPTIMIZED FOUR-SPLIT EVALUATION
# ================================================================

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import (
    mean_squared_error,
    mean_absolute_error,
    r2_score
)
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 OPTIMIZED FOUR-SPLIT EVALUATION")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------

best_params = study_v2.best_params.copy()

print("\nFROZEN PARAMETERS")
for k, v in best_params.items():
    print(f"{k}: {v}")

# 2. FEATURES
# ------------------------------------------------

features = list(clean_features)

if len(features) != 62:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Expected 62 features, found {len(features)}"
    )

print(f"\nFeatures: {len(features)}")
print("PASS — 62-feature definition confirmed")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. FINAL SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------

split_paths = {
    "RANDOM": {
        "train": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/random/train.csv",
        "val":   "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/random/val.csv",
        "test":  "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/random/test.csv"
    },
    "COLD_COMBINATION": {
        "train": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_combination/train.csv",
        "val":   "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_combination/val.csv",

    },
    "COLD_CELL": {
        "train": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_cell_line/train.csv",
        "val":   "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_cell_line/val.csv",
        "test":  "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_cell_line/test.csv"
    },
    "COLD_DRUG": {
        "train": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug_corrected/train.csv",
        "val":   "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug_corrected/val.csv",
        "test":  "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug_corrected/test.csv"
    }
}

expected_sizes = {
    "RANDOM": (235258, 29407, 29408),
    "COLD_COMBINATION": (235050, 29465, 29558),
    "COLD_CELL": (234256, 30030, 29787),
    "COLD_DRUG": (185064, 48867, 60142)
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. METRIC FUNCTION
# ------------------------------------------------

def evaluate_predictions(y_true, y_pred):

    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred))
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred)
    r2 = r2_score(y_true, y_pred)

    pearson = pearsonr(y_true, y_pred)[0]
    spearman = spearmanr(y_true, y_pred)[0]

    return {
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "MAE": mae,
        "R2": r2,
        "Pearson": pearson,
        "Spearman": spearman
    }

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. RUN FOUR SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------

results = []
models = {}

for split_name, paths in split_paths.items():

    print("\n" + "#" * 70)
    print(f"TRAINING: {split_name}")
    print("#" * 70)

    train = pd.read_csv(paths["train"])
    val = pd.read_csv(paths["val"])
    test = pd.read_csv(paths["test"])

    expected = expected_sizes[split_name]
    actual = (len(train), len(val), len(test))

    print(
        f"Sizes: {actual} | Expected: {expected}"
    )

    if actual != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{split_name} split size mismatch."
        )

    X_train = train[features]
    X_val = val[features]
    X_test = test[features]

    y_train = train["combo_score"]
    y_val = val["combo_score"]
    y_test = test["combo_score"]

    if list(X_train.columns) != list(X_val.columns):
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{split_name}: train/validation feature mismatch."
        )

    if list(X_train.columns) != list(X_test.columns):
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{split_name}: train/test feature mismatch."
        )

    print("Training matrix:", X_train.shape)
    print("Validation matrix:", X_val.shape)
    print("Test matrix:", X_test.shape)

    # Frozen parameters — no Optuna tuning here
    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        **best_params,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        random_seed=42,
        verbose=False
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train,
        eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
        use_best_model=False
    )

    pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
    pred_test = model.predict(X_test)

    val_metrics = evaluate_predictions(y_val, pred_val)
    test_metrics = evaluate_predictions(y_test, pred_test)

    print("\nVALIDATION")
    for k, v in val_metrics.items():
        print(f"{k:<10}: {v:.6f}")

    print("\nTEST")
    for k, v in test_metrics.items():
        print(f"{k:<10}: {v:.6f}")

    results.append({
        "Model": "CatBoost_V2_Optimized",
        "Split": split_name,
        "Features": 62,
        "Train_Rows": len(train),
        "Val_Rows": len(val),
        "Test_Rows": len(test),

        "Val_RMSE": val_metrics["RMSE"],
        "Val_MAE": val_metrics["MAE"],
        "Val_R2": val_metrics["R2"],
        "Val_Pearson": val_metrics["Pearson"],
        "Val_Spearman": val_metrics["Spearman"],

        "Test_RMSE": test_metrics["RMSE"],
        "Test_MAE": test_metrics["MAE"],
        "Test_R2": test_metrics["R2"],
        "Test_Pearson": test_metrics["Pearson"],
        "Test_Spearman": test_metrics["Spearman"],

        "Tree_Count": best_params["iterations"]
    })

    models[split_name] = model

# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. FINAL TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

features = list(clean_features)

if len(X) != len(MASTER_MODEL):
    raise RuntimeError("X and MASTER_MODEL row counts do not match.")

print(f"PASS — X contains {len(features)} frozen V2 features")

key_cols = [
    "drug_A",

}

def get_metrics(y_true, y_pred):

    return {
        "RMSE": np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)),
        "MAE": mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred),
        "R2": r2_score(y_true, y_pred),

        df = pd.read_csv(paths[subset])

                "could not be matched to MASTER."

        split_indices[subset] = master_lookup.loc[keys].to_numpy()

        split_indices["train"],

    if np.intersect1d(
        split_indices["train"],
        split_indices["test"]
    ).size:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{split_name}: train/test overlap")

    if np.intersect1d(
        split_indices["val"],
        split_indices["test"]
    ).size:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{split_name}: val/test overlap")

    print("PASS — split rows correctly mapped to MASTER")

    # ------------------------------------------------

    X_train = X.iloc[split_indices["train"]][features]
    X_val   = X.iloc[split_indices["val"]][features]
    X_test  = X.iloc[split_indices["test"]][features]

    y_train = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[

        split_indices["val"]
    ]["combo_score"]

    y_test = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[
        split_indices["test"]
    ]["combo_score"]

    # ------------------------------------------------
    # FROZEN OPTUNA MODEL
    # ------------------------------------------------

    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        **study_v2.best_params,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        random_seed=42,
        verbose=False
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train,
        eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
        use_best_model=False
    )

    pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
    pred_test = model.predict(X_test)

    val_metrics = get_metrics(y_val, pred_val)

    print("\nTEST")
    for k, v in test_metrics.items():
        print(f"{k:<10}: {v:.6f}")

    results.append({
        "Model": "CatBoost_V2_Optimized",

        "Features": 62,
        "Train_Rows": len(X_train),
        "Val_Rows": len(X_val),
        "Test_Rows": len(X_test),

        "Test_RMSE": test_metrics["RMSE"],
        "Test_MAE": test_metrics["MAE"],

        "Test_Pearson": test_metrics["Pearson"],
        "Test_Spearman": test_metrics["Spearman"],

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor

from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 OPTIMIZED FOUR-SPLIT EVALUATION")
print("=" * 70)

features = list(clean_features)

    raise RuntimeError("X and MASTER_MODEL row counts do not match.")

if list(X.columns) != features:
    raise RuntimeError("X columns do not match clean_features.")

# ------------------------------------------------

    "drug_A",

    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id",
    "nci_almanac_cellname"
]

def make_keys(df):
    return (
        df[key_cols]
        .fillna("<NA>")
        .astype(str)
        .agg("|".join, axis=1)
    )

master_keys = make_keys(MASTER_MODEL)

if master_keys.duplicated().any():
    raise RuntimeError("MASTER row identifiers are not unique.")

    index=master_keys

    if np.intersect1d(

    print("Val  :", X_val.shape)
    print("Test :", X_test.shape)

    # --------------------------------------------
    # TRAIN WITH FROZEN OPTUNA PARAMETERS

    model = CatBoostRegressor(

    for metric, value in test_metrics.items():
        print(f"{metric:<10}: {value:.6f}")

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, r2_score
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 OPTIMIZED FOUR-SPLIT EVALUATION")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. FROZEN V2 FEATURE LIST
# ------------------------------------------------

features = (
    [f"CellMiner_PC{i}" for i in range(1, 51)]
    + [
        "STRING_distance",
        "STRING_available",
        "KEGG_overlap",
        "Tanimoto_similarity",
        "target_count_A",
        "target_count_B",
        "shared_target_count",
        "union_target_count",
        "target_jaccard",
        "target_overlap_A",
        "target_overlap_B",
        "has_shared_target"
    ]
)

if len(features) != 62:
    raise RuntimeError(f"Expected 62 features, found {len(features)}")

missing_features = [
    f for f in features
    if f not in MASTER_MODEL.columns
]

if missing_features:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Missing V2 features from MASTER_MODEL: {missing_features}"
    )

print("PASS — exact frozen 62 V2 features identified")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. BUILD X DIRECTLY FROM MASTER_MODEL
# ------------------------------------------------

X_v2 = MASTER_MODEL[features].copy()

if X_v2.shape != (294073, 62):
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Unexpected V2 matrix shape: {X_v2.shape}"
    )

print(f"V2 matrix: {X_v2.shape}")
print("PASS — V2 feature matrix aligned")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. MASTER ROW IDENTIFIERS
# ------------------------------------------------

key_cols = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id",
    "nci_almanac_cellname"
]

def make_keys(df):
    return (
        df[key_cols]
        .fillna("<NA>")
        .astype(str)
        .agg("|".join, axis=1)
    )

master_keys = make_keys(MASTER_MODEL)

if master_keys.duplicated().any():
    raise RuntimeError("MASTER row identifiers are not unique.")

master_lookup = pd.Series(
    np.arange(len(MASTER_MODEL)),
    index=master_keys
)

print("PASS — MASTER row identifiers verified")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. FROZEN OPTUNA PARAMETERS
# ------------------------------------------------

if "study_v2" not in globals():
    raise RuntimeError("study_v2 is not available.")

best_params = study_v2.best_params.copy()

print("\nFROZEN OPTUNA PARAMETERS")
for k, v in best_params.items():
    print(f"{k}: {v}")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------

split_paths = {
    "RANDOM": {
        "train": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/random/train.csv",
        "val": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/random/val.csv",
        "test": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/random/test.csv"
    },
    "COLD_COMBINATION": {
        "train": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_combination/train.csv",
        "val": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_combination/val.csv",
        "test": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_combination/test.csv"
    },
    "COLD_CELL": {
        "train": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_cell_line/train.csv",
        "val": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_cell_line/val.csv",
        "test": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_cell_line/test.csv"
    },
    "COLD_DRUG": {
        "train": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug_corrected/train.csv",
        "val": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug_corrected/val.csv",
        "test": "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug_corrected/test.csv"
    }
}

expected_sizes = {
    "RANDOM": (235258, 29407, 29408),
    "COLD_COMBINATION": (235050, 29465, 29558),
    "COLD_CELL": (234256, 30030, 29787),
    "COLD_DRUG": (185064, 48867, 60142)
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. METRICS
# ------------------------------------------------

def metrics(y_true, y_pred):
    return {
        "RMSE": np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, y_pred)),
        "MAE": mean_absolute_error(y_true, y_pred),
        "R2": r2_score(y_true, y_pred),
        "Pearson": pearsonr(y_true, y_pred)[0],
        "Spearman": spearmanr(y_true, y_pred)[0]
    }

# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. RUN FOUR SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------

results = []
optimized_models = {}

for split_name, paths in split_paths.items():

    print("\n" + "#" * 70)
    print(f"EVALUATING: {split_name}")
    print("#" * 70)

    indices = {}

    for subset in ["train", "val", "test"]:

        df = pd.read_csv(paths[subset])
        keys = make_keys(df)

        missing = (~keys.isin(master_lookup.index)).sum()

        if missing:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{split_name} {subset}: "
                f"{missing} rows missing from MASTER."
            )

        indices[subset] = master_lookup.loc[keys].to_numpy()

    actual = tuple(
        len(indices[s])
        for s in ["train", "val", "test"]
    )

    if actual != expected_sizes[split_name]:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{split_name} size mismatch: "
            f"{actual} vs {expected_sizes[split_name]}"
        )

    # Check overlap
    if np.intersect1d(
        indices["train"], indices["val"]
    ).size:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{split_name}: train/val overlap")

    if np.intersect1d(
        indices["train"], indices["test"]
    ).size:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{split_name}: train/test overlap")

    if np.intersect1d(
        indices["val"], indices["test"]
    ).size:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{split_name}: val/test overlap")

    print(f"PASS — coverage: {actual}")
    print("PASS — zero row overlap")

    # ------------------------------------------------
    # DATA
    # ------------------------------------------------

    train_idx = indices["train"]
    val_idx = indices["val"]
    test_idx = indices["test"]

    X_train = X_v2.iloc[train_idx]
    X_val = X_v2.iloc[val_idx]
    X_test = X_v2.iloc[test_idx]

    y_train = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[train_idx]["combo_score"].to_numpy()
    y_val = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[val_idx]["combo_score"].to_numpy()
    y_test = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[test_idx]["combo_score"].to_numpy()

    # ------------------------------------------------
    # MODEL
    # ------------------------------------------------

    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        **best_params,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        random_seed=42,
        verbose=False
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train,
        eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
        use_best_model=False
    )

    # ------------------------------------------------
    # PREDICTIONS
    # ------------------------------------------------

    pred_val = model.predict(X_val)
    pred_test = model.predict(X_test)

    val = metrics(y_val, pred_val)
    test = metrics(y_test, pred_test)

    print("\nVALIDATION")
    print(f"RMSE     : {val['RMSE']:.6f}")
    print(f"MAE      : {val['MAE']:.6f}")
    print(f"R2       : {val['R2']:.6f}")
    print(f"Pearson  : {val['Pearson']:.6f}")
    print(f"Spearman : {val['Spearman']:.6f}")

    print("\nTEST")
    print(f"RMSE     : {test['RMSE']:.6f}")
    print(f"MAE      : {test['MAE']:.6f}")
    print(f"R2       : {test['R2']:.6f}")
    print(f"Pearson  : {test['Pearson']:.6f}")
    print(f"Spearman : {test['Spearman']:.6f}")

    results.append({
        "Model": "CatBoost_V2_Optimized",
        "Split": split_name,
        "Features": 62,
        "Train_Rows": len(train_idx),
        "Val_Rows": len(val_idx),
        "Test_Rows": len(test_idx),
        "Val_RMSE": val["RMSE"],
        "Val_MAE": val["MAE"],
        "Val_R2": val["R2"],
        "Val_Pearson": val["Pearson"],
        "Val_Spearman": val["Spearman"],
        "Test_RMSE": test["RMSE"],
        "Test_MAE": test["MAE"],
        "Test_R2": test["R2"],
        "Test_Pearson": test["Pearson"],
        "Test_Spearman": test["Spearman"],
        "Tree_Count": best_params["iterations"]
    })

    optimized_models[split_name] = model

# ------------------------------------------------
# 8. FINAL TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 OPTIMIZED FINAL RESULTS")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    results_df[
        [
            "Model",
            "Split",
            "Features",
            "Train_Rows",
            "Val_Rows",
            "Test_Rows",
            "Test_RMSE",
            "Test_MAE",
            "Test_R2",
            "Test_Pearson",
            "Test_Spearman",
            "Tree_Count"
        ]
    ].to_string(index=False)
)

print("\nPASS — all four splits evaluated")
print("PASS — corrected COLD_DRUG used")
print("PASS — exact 62 V2 features used")
print("PASS — frozen Optuna parameters used")
print("NO MASTER MODIFIED")

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

}

        [

            "tissue",

            "cellminer_cellline_id",
            "nci_almanac_cellname"

    .astype(str)
    .agg("|".join, axis=1)
)

if master_keys.duplicated().any():
    raise RuntimeError("MASTER row identifiers are not unique.")

split_data = {}

for split_name, folder in split_paths.items():

    train = pd.read_csv(f"{folder}/train.csv")
    val = pd.read_csv(f"{folder}/val.csv")
    test = pd.read_csv(f"{folder}/test.csv")

    expected = split_sizes[split_name]

    actual = (len(train), len(val), len(test))

    if actual != expected:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{split_name} size mismatch: "
            f"actual={actual}, expected={expected}"
        )

    def get_indices(df):

        keys = (
            df[
                [
                    "drug_A",
                    "drug_B",
                    "CELLNAME",
                    "tissue",
                    "combo_score",
                    "CONC1",
                    "CONC2",
                    "cellminer_cellline_id",
                    "nci_almanac_cellname"
                ]
            ]
            .astype(str)
            .agg("|".join, axis=1)
        )

        index_map = pd.Series(
            np.arange(len(master_keys)),
            index=master_keys
        )

        return index_map.loc[keys].values

    train_idx = get_indices(train)
    val_idx = get_indices(val)

    split_data[split_name] = {
        "train_idx": train_idx,
        "val_idx": val_idx
    }

    print(
        f"{split_name}: "
        f"{len(train_idx)} / {len(val_idx)} PASS"
    )

# ------------------------------------------------
# ABLATION
# ------------------------------------------------

results = []

for ablation_name, features in ablation_sets.items():

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"ABLATION: {ablation_name}")
    print(f"Features: {len(features)}")
    print("=" * 70)

    for split_name, data in split_data.items():

        train_idx = data["train_idx"]
        val_idx = data["val_idx"]

        X_train = X_v2.iloc[train_idx][features]
        X_val = X_v2.iloc[val_idx][features]

        y_train = y.iloc[train_idx]
        y_val = y.iloc[val_idx]

        model = CatBoostRegressor(
            **params
        )

        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
            eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
            verbose=False
        )

        pred = model.predict(X_val)

        rmse = np.sqrt(
            np.mean((y_val.values - pred) ** 2)
        )

        results.append({
            "Ablation": ablation_name,
            "Split": split_name,
            "Features": len(features),
            "Val_RMSE": rmse
        })

        print(
            f"{split_name:20s} | "
            f"Val RMSE = {rmse:.4f}"
        )

# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 FEATURE ABLATION

from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 FEATURE ABLATION")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. FROZEN PARAMETERS
# ------------------------------------------------

params = {
    "iterations": 1800,
    "learning_rate": 0.18602592172985663,
    "depth": 8,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 7.733169542565907,
    "random_strength": 0.8982903332352377,
    "bagging_temperature": 0.14927177677218426,
    "border_count": 202,
    "rsm": 0.9158767411286465,
    "loss_function": "RMSE",
    "verbose": False,
    "random_seed": 42
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. EXACT 62 V2 FEATURES
# ------------------------------------------------

all_features = list(X_v2.columns)

if len(all_features) != 62:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Expected 62 V2 features, found {len(all_features)}"
    )

feature_groups = {
    "CELLMINER": [
        f"CellMiner_PC{i}" for i in range(1, 51)
    ],

    "TARGET": [
        "target_count_A",
        "target_count_B",
        "shared_target_count",
        "union_target_count",
        "target_jaccard",
        "target_overlap_A",
        "target_overlap_B",
        "has_shared_target"
    ],

    "MOLECULAR": [
        "Tanimoto_similarity"
    ],

    "STRING": [
        "STRING_distance",
        "STRING_available"
    ],

    "KEGG": [
        "KEGG_overlap"
    ]
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. ABLATION SETS
# ------------------------------------------------

ablation_sets = {
    "ALL_62": all_features,

    "CELLMINER_ONLY": feature_groups["CELLMINER"],

    "NON_CELLMINER": [
        f for f in all_features
        if f not in feature_groups["CELLMINER"]
    ],

    "MINUS_TARGET": [
        f for f in all_features
        if f not in feature_groups["TARGET"]
    ],

    "MINUS_MOLECULAR": [
        f for f in all_features
        if f not in feature_groups["MOLECULAR"]
    ],

    "MINUS_STRING": [
        f for f in all_features
        if f not in feature_groups["STRING"]
    ],

    "MINUS_KEGG": [
        f for f in all_features
        if f not in feature_groups["KEGG"]
    ]
}

print("\nPASS — 7 ablation configurations prepared")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. SAFE MASTER KEY FUNCTION
# ------------------------------------------------

key_cols = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id",
    "nci_almanac_cellname"
]

def make_keys(df):
    return (
        df[key_cols]
        .fillna("<NA>")
        .astype(str)
        .agg(
            lambda row: "|".join(row.tolist()),
            axis=1
        )
    )

master_keys = make_keys(MASTER_MODEL)

if master_keys.duplicated().any():
    raise RuntimeError(
        "MASTER row identifiers are not unique."
    )

# Map key -> master row index
master_index = pd.Series(
    np.arange(len(MASTER_MODEL)),
    index=master_keys
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------

split_paths = {
    "RANDOM":
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/random",

    "COLD_COMBINATION":
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_combination",

    "COLD_CELL":
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_cell_line",

    "COLD_DRUG":
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug_corrected"
}

expected_sizes = {
    "RANDOM": (235258, 29407, 29408),
    "COLD_COMBINATION": (235050, 29465, 29558),
    "COLD_CELL": (234256, 30030, 29787),
    "COLD_DRUG": (185064, 48867, 60142)
}

split_data = {}

for split_name, folder in split_paths.items():

    train = pd.read_csv(
        Path(folder) / "train.csv"
    )

    val = pd.read_csv(
        Path(folder) / "val.csv"
    )

    test = pd.read_csv(
        Path(folder) / "test.csv"
    )

    actual = (
        len(train),
        len(val),
        len(test)
    )

    if actual != expected_sizes[split_name]:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{split_name} size mismatch: "
            f"{actual} != {expected_sizes[split_name]}"
        )

    train_keys = make_keys(train)
    val_keys = make_keys(val)

    if not train_keys.isin(master_index.index).all():
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{split_name}: train rows missing from MASTER"
        )

    if not val_keys.isin(master_index.index).all():
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{split_name}: validation rows missing from MASTER"
        )

    train_idx = master_index.loc[train_keys].to_numpy()
    val_idx = master_index.loc[val_keys].to_numpy()

    split_data[split_name] = {
        "train_idx": train_idx,
        "val_idx": val_idx
    }

    print(
        f"{split_name:20s} | "
        f"{len(train_idx):6d} / "
        f"{len(val_idx):6d} | PASS"
    )

# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. ABLATION
# ------------------------------------------------

results = []

for ablation_name, features in ablation_sets.items():

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(
        f"ABLATION: {ablation_name} "
        f"({len(features)} features)"
    )
    print("=" * 70)

    for split_name, data in split_data.items():

        train_idx = data["train_idx"]
        val_idx = data["val_idx"]

        X_train = X_v2.iloc[
            train_idx
        ][features]

        X_val = X_v2.iloc[
            val_idx
        ][features]

        y_train = y.iloc[train_idx]
        y_val = y.iloc[val_idx]

        model = CatBoostRegressor(
            **params
        )

        model.fit(
            X_train,
            y_train,
            eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
            verbose=False
        )

        predictions = model.predict(X_val)

        rmse = np.sqrt(
            np.mean(
                (y_val.to_numpy() - predictions) ** 2
            )
        )

        results.append({
            "Ablation": ablation_name,
            "Split": split_name,
            "Features": len(features),
            "Val_RMSE": rmse
        })

        print(
            f"{split_name:20s} | "
            f"RMSE = {rmse:.4f}"
        )

# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. SAVE
# ------------------------------------------------

ablation_results = pd.DataFrame(results)

output = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/model_related_files/"
    "CatBoost_V2_feature_ablation_validation.csv"
)

ablation_results.to_csv(
    output,
    index=False
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ABLATION COMPLETE")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    ablation_results
    .to_string(index=False)
)

print(f"\nSaved: {output}")

print("\nPASS — validation-only ablation")
print("PASS — corrected COLD_DRUG used")
print("PASS — frozen V2 parameters used")
print("PASS — no MASTER modified")
print("PASS — no split files modified")
print("PASS — no feature files modified")

# ================================================================
# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 FEATURE IMPORTANCE AUDIT
# ================================================================

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V2 FEATURE IMPORTANCE AUDIT")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# FROZEN 62 FEATURES
# ------------------------------------------------

features = list(X_v2.columns)

if len(features) != 62:
    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Expected 62 features, found {len(features)}"
    )

print(f"PASS — {len(features)} V2 features loaded")

# ------------------------------------------------
# FROZEN PARAMETERS
# ------------------------------------------------

params = {
    "iterations": 1800,
    "learning_rate": 0.18602592172985663,
    "depth": 8,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 7.733169542565907,
    "random_strength": 0.8982903332352377,
    "bagging_temperature": 0.14927177677218426,
    "border_count": 202,
    "rsm": 0.9158767411286465,
    "loss_function": "RMSE",
    "verbose": False,
    "random_seed": 42
}

# ------------------------------------------------
# TRAIN ONE MODEL PER SPLIT
# ------------------------------------------------

importance_results = []

for split_name, data in split_data.items():

    print(f"\n{'=' * 60}")
    print(f"TRAINING: {split_name}")
    print(f"{'=' * 60}")

    train_idx = data["train_idx"]
    val_idx = data["val_idx"]

    X_train = X_v2.iloc[train_idx][features]
    X_val = X_v2.iloc[val_idx][features]

    y_train = y.iloc[train_idx]
    y_val = y.iloc[val_idx]

    model = CatBoostRegressor(**params)

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train,
        eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
        verbose=False
    )

    importances = model.get_feature_importance()

    split_importance = pd.DataFrame({
        "Split": split_name,
        "Feature": features,
        "Importance": importances
    })

    split_importance["Importance_%"] = (
        split_importance["Importance"]
        / split_importance["Importance"].sum()
        * 100
    )

    importance_results.append(split_importance)

    print("PASS — feature importance extracted")

# ------------------------------------------------
# COMBINE
# ------------------------------------------------

importance_df = pd.concat(
    importance_results,
    ignore_index=True
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# AGGREGATE ACROSS SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------

summary = (
    importance_df
    .groupby("Feature", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        Mean_Importance=("Importance", "mean"),
        Mean_Importance_Pct=("Importance_%", "mean"),
        Std_Importance=("Importance", "std")
    )
    .sort_values(
        "Mean_Importance",
        ascending=False
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# FEATURE GROUPS
# ------------------------------------------------

def get_group(feature):

    if feature.startswith("CellMiner_PC"):
        return "CELLMINER"

    if feature in [
        "target_count_A",
        "target_count_B",
        "shared_target_count",
        "union_target_count",
        "target_jaccard",
        "target_overlap_A",
        "target_overlap_B",
        "has_shared_target"
    ]:
        return "TARGET"

    if feature in [
        "Tanimoto_similarity"
    ]:
        return "MOLECULAR"

    if feature in [
        "STRING_distance",
        "STRING_available"
    ]:
        return "STRING"

    if feature == "KEGG_overlap":
        return "KEGG"

    return "OTHER"


summary["Group"] = summary["Feature"].apply(get_group)

# ------------------------------------------------
# PRINT TOP FEATURES
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("TOP 20 FEATURES")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    summary[
        [
            "Feature",
            "Group",
            "Mean_Importance_Pct",
            "Std_Importance"
        ]
    ]
    .head(20)
    .to_string(index=False)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# GROUP SUMMARY
# ------------------------------------------------

group_summary = (
    summary
    .groupby("Group", as_index=False)
    .agg(
        Total_Importance_Pct=(
            "Mean_Importance_Pct",
            "sum"
        ),
        Mean_Feature_Importance=(
            "Mean_Importance_Pct",
            "mean"
        )
    )
    .sort_values(
        "Total_Importance_Pct",
        ascending=False
    )
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FEATURE GROUP IMPORTANCE")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    group_summary.to_string(index=False)
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# SAVE
# ------------------------------------------------

output = (
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/model_related_files/"
    "CatBoost_V2_feature_importance_audit.csv"
)

summary.to_csv(
    output,
    index=False
)

print("\nSaved:", output)

print("\nPASS — feature importance audit complete")
print("PASS — no MASTER modified")
print("PASS — no split files modified")
print("PASS — no feature files modified")

# 4. LOAD EXISTING FROZEN SPLITS
# ================================================================

split_paths = {
    "COLD_COMBINATION":
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_combination",

    "COLD_CELL":
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_cell_line",

    "COLD_DRUG":
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_drug"
}

splits_v3 = {}

for split_name, path in split_paths.items():

    train = pd.read_csv(f"{path}/train.csv")
    val = pd.read_csv(f"{path}/val.csv")

    splits_v3[split_name] = {
        "train": train,
        "val": val
    }

    print(
        f"{split_name:18s} | "
        f"{len(train):6d} train / "
        f"{len(val):6d} val | PASS"
    )

print("PASS — all three cold validation splits loaded")

# ================================================================
# 5. CREATE STABLE ROW IDENTIFIERS
# ================================================================
# This is ONLY for matching split rows to MASTER.
# No files are modified.

key_cols = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id",
    "nci_almanac_cellname"
]

def make_keys(df):
    return (
        df[key_cols]
        .astype("string")
        .fillna("<NA>")
        .agg("|".join, axis=1)
    )

master_keys = make_keys(MASTER_MODEL)

if master_keys.duplicated().any():
    raise RuntimeError("MASTER row identifiers are not unique")

master_key_to_index = pd.Series(
    MASTER_MODEL.index.to_numpy(),
    index=master_keys
)

# ================================================================
# 6. MAP SPLITS TO EXACT MASTER ROW INDICES
# ================================================================

for split_name, split_data in splits_v3.items():

    for subset_name in ["train", "val"]:

        df = split_data[subset_name]

        keys = make_keys(df)

        if keys.duplicated().any():
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{split_name} {subset_name}: duplicate row identifiers"
            )

        missing = ~keys.isin(master_key_to_index.index)

        if missing.any():
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{split_name} {subset_name}: "
                f"{missing.sum()} rows not found in MASTER"
            )

        indices = master_key_to_index.loc[keys].to_numpy()

        split_data[subset_name]["_master_index"] = indices

        print(
            f"PASS — {split_name:18s} {subset_name:5s} "
            f"{len(indices):6d} rows mapped"
        )

# ================================================================
# 7. VERIFY TRAIN / VAL DISJOINTNESS
# ================================================================

for split_name, split_data in splits_v3.items():

    train_idx = set(split_data["train"]["_master_index"])
    val_idx = set(split_data["val"]["_master_index"])

    overlap = train_idx.intersection(val_idx)

    if overlap:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{split_name}: train/validation overlap detected"
        )

print("PASS — all cold train/validation splits are disjoint")

# ================================================================
# 8. BUILD NUMPY MATRICES
# ================================================================

cold_data = {}

for split_name, split_data in splits_v3.items():

    train_idx = split_data["train"]["_master_index"].to_numpy()
    val_idx = split_data["val"]["_master_index"].to_numpy()

    cold_data[split_name] = {
        "X_train": X_v3.iloc[train_idx],
        "y_train": y_v3.iloc[train_idx],
        "X_val": X_v3.iloc[val_idx],
        "y_val": y_v3.iloc[val_idx]
    }

    print(
        f"{split_name:18s} | "
        f"X_train={cold_data[split_name]['X_train'].shape} | "
        f"X_val={cold_data[split_name]['X_val'].shape}"
    )

print("PASS — cold validation matrices prepared")

# ================================================================
# 9. CREATE SEPARATE V3 TPE STUDY
# ================================================================

sampler_v3 = optuna.samplers.TPESampler(
    seed=2026,
    n_startup_trials=8,
    multivariate=True,
    group=True
)

study_v3 = optuna.create_study(
    direction="minimize",
    sampler=sampler_v3,
    study_name="TrustSyn_CatBoost_V3_ColdAware_TPE"
)

print("PASS — new cold-aware Optuna study created")

# ================================================================
# 10. COLD-AWARE OBJECTIVE
# ================================================================
#
# Equal weighting:
#
# COLD_COMBINATION: 1/3
# COLD_CELL:        1/3
# COLD_DRUG:        1/3
#
# RANDOM is deliberately excluded.
# TEST is completely excluded.
# ================================================================

def objective_v3(trial):

    params = {
        "iterations": trial.suggest_int(
            "iterations",
            500,
            2000,
            step=100
        ),

        "learning_rate": trial.suggest_float(
            "learning_rate",
            0.02,
            0.12,
            log=True
        ),

        "depth": trial.suggest_int(
            "depth",
            4,
            7
        ),

        "l2_leaf_reg": trial.suggest_float(
            "l2_leaf_reg",
            10.0,
            40.0,
            log=True
        ),

        "random_strength": trial.suggest_float(
            "random_strength",
            0.1,
            2.0,
            log=True
        ),

        "bagging_temperature": trial.suggest_float(
            "bagging_temperature",
            0.0,
            1.0
        ),

        "border_count": trial.suggest_int(
            "border_count",
            64,
            255
        ),

        "rsm": trial.suggest_float(
            "rsm",
            0.5,
            0.8
        ),

        "loss_function": "RMSE",
        "eval_metric": "RMSE",
        "random_seed": 42,
        "verbose": False,
        "allow_writing_files": False
    }

    rmses = []

    for split_name in [
        "COLD_COMBINATION",
        "COLD_CELL",
        "COLD_DRUG"
    ]:

        data = cold_data[split_name]

        model = CatBoostRegressor(**params)

        model.fit(
            data["X_train"],
            data["y_train"],
            eval_set=(data["X_val"], data["y_val"]),
            use_best_model=True,
            early_stopping_rounds=100,
            verbose=False
        )

        pred = model.predict(data["X_val"])

        rmse = np.sqrt(
            mean_squared_error(
                data["y_val"],
                pred
            )
        )

        rmses.append(rmse)

        trial.set_user_attr(
            f"{split_name}_RMSE",
            float(rmse)
        )

    composite_rmse = float(np.mean(rmses))

    trial.set_user_attr(
        "COLD_COMPOSITE_RMSE",
        composite_rmse
    )

    return composite_rmse

# ================================================================
# 11. RUN OPTIMIZATION
# ================================================================

print()
print("=" * 70)
print("STARTING COLD-SPLIT-AWARE OPTIMIZATION")
print("=" * 70)
print()
print("Objective:")
print("  1/3 COLD_COMBINATION validation RMSE")
print("  1/3 COLD_CELL validation RMSE")
print("  1/3 COLD_DRUG validation RMSE")
print()
print("RANDOM excluded")
print("TEST excluded")
print("MASTER unchanged")
print("Splits unchanged")
print()

study_v3.optimize(
    objective_v3,
    n_trials=30,
    show_progress_bar=True
)

# ================================================================
# 12. REPORT RESULTS
# ================================================================

print()
print("=" * 70)
print("COLD-AWARE OPTUNA COMPLETE")
print("=" * 70)

print("Completed trials:", len([
    t for t in study_v3.trials
    if t.state == optuna.trial.TrialState.COMPLETE
]))

best = study_v3.best_trial

print()
print("BEST TRIAL")
print("Trial:", best.number)
print("Composite cold RMSE:", best.value)

print()
print("COLD VALIDATION RMSE")

for split_name in [
    "COLD_COMBINATION",
    "COLD_CELL",
    "COLD_DRUG"
]:
    print(
        f"{split_name:18s}: "
        f"{best.user_attrs[f'{split_name}_RMSE']:.6f}"
    )

print()
print("BEST PARAMETERS")

for key, value in best.params.items():
    print(f"{key}: {value}")

print()
print("PASS — cold-aware optimization completed")
print("V2 frozen parameters remain untouched")
print("MASTER untouched")
print("Split files untouched")
print("Feature files untouched")

            print(f"  {key}: {type(value).__name__}, shape={value.shape}")
        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):

        else:
            print(f"  {key}: {type(value).__name__}")

def find_split_file(files, split_name):
    candidates = [
        f for f in files
        if split_name in f.stem.lower()
        and f.suffix.lower() in {".csv", ".parquet"}
    ]

    if len(candidates) == 1:
        return candidates[0]

    if len(candidates) == 0:
        raise FileNotFoundError(
            f"No {split_name} file found in:\n"
            f"{COLD_DRUG_CORRECTED_DIR}"
        )

    raise RuntimeError(
        f"Multiple {split_name} files found:\n"
        + "\n".join(f"  {x.name}" for x in candidates)
    )

    )

# Helper: map dataframe rows to frozen feature matrix
# using the canonical MASTER row index carried by the split tables.

def get_indices(df):
    if "master_index" in df.columns:
        return df["master_index"].to_numpy()

    if "_master_index" in df.columns:
        return df["_master_index"].to_numpy()

    raise RuntimeError(
        "Could not find master row index in split DataFrame. "
        "Do not proceed until the split-to-feature mapping is identified."
    )

for name, train_df, val_df in [

        cold_combination_train,
        cold_combination_val,
    ),
    (
        "COLD_CELL",
        cold_cell_train,
        cold_cell_val,
    ),
    (
        "COLD_DRUG",
        cold_drug_corrected_train,
        cold_drug_corrected_val,
    ),
]:

    train_idx = get_indices(train_df)
    val_idx = get_indices(val_df)

    split_data[name] = {
        "X_train": X[train_idx],
        "y_train": train_df[TARGET].to_numpy(),
        "X_val": X[val_idx],
        "y_val": val_df[TARGET].to_numpy(),
    }

    print(
        f"{name:18s} | "
        f"train={len(train_idx):,} | "
        f"val={len(val_idx):,}"
    )

        "border_count": 128,

for config_name, params in configs.items():

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"CONFIGURATION: {config_name}")
    print("=" * 70)

    split_scores = {}

    for split_name, data in split_data.items():

        model = CatBoostRegressor(
            loss_function="RMSE",
            random_seed=42,
            verbose=False,
            allow_writing_files=False,
            thread_count=-1,
            **params,
        )

        model.fit(
            data["X_train"],
            data["y_train"],
        )

        pred = model.predict(data["X_val"])

        rmse = np.sqrt(
            mean_squared_error(
                data["y_val"],
                pred
            )
        )

        split_scores[split_name] = rmse

        print(
            f"{split_name:18s} | RMSE = {rmse:.4f}"
        )

    composite = np.mean(list(split_scores.values()))

    print(
        f"COMPOSITE COLD RMSE = {composite:.4f}"
    )

    results.append({
        "Config": config_name,
        **split_scores,
        "Composite_Cold_RMSE": composite,
    })

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# RESULTS TABLE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

results_df = (
    pd.DataFrame(results)
    .sort_values("Composite_Cold_RMSE")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

    results_df.to_string(

        float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.4f}"
    )
)

        "bagging_temperature": 0.5,
        "rsm": 0.60,
        "border_count": 128,
    },
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. TRAIN + VALIDATE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

results = []

for config_name, params in configs.items():

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"CONFIGURATION: {config_name}")
    print("=" * 70)

    split_scores = {}

    for split_name, data in split_data.items():

        model = CatBoostRegressor(
            loss_function="RMSE",
            random_seed=42,
            verbose=False,
            allow_writing_files=False,
            thread_count=-1,
            **params,
        )

        model.fit(
            data["X_train"],
            data["y_train"],
        )

        pred = model.predict(
            data["X_val"]
        )

        rmse = np.sqrt(
            mean_squared_error(
                data["y_val"],
                pred
            )
        )

        split_scores[split_name] = rmse

        print(
            f"{split_name:18s} | RMSE = {rmse:.4f}"
        )

    composite = np.mean(
        list(split_scores.values())
    )

    print(
        f"COMPOSITE COLD RMSE = {composite:.4f}"
    )

    results.append({
        "Config": config_name,
        **split_scores,
        "Composite_Cold_RMSE": composite,
    })

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. RESULTS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

results_df = (
    pd.DataFrame(results)
    .sort_values("Composite_Cold_RMSE")
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("TARGETED REGULARIZATION RESULTS")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    results_df.to_string(
        index=False,
        float_format=lambda x: f"{x:.4f}"
    )
)

print("\nPASS — targeted regularization sweep complete")
print("PASS — canonical COLD_COMBINATION used")
print("PASS — canonical COLD_CELL used")
print("PASS — corrected COLD_DRUG used")
print("PASS — test sets NOT used")
print("PASS — V2 feature matrix unchanged")
print("PASS — MASTER unchanged")
print("PASS — split files unchanged")
print("PASS — feature files unchanged")

results = []

def run_v3_split(
    split_name,
    X_train,
    y_train,
    X_val,
    y_val
):

    print("\n" + "-" * 70)
    print(f"TRAINING V3 — {split_name}")
    print("-" * 70)

    start = time.time()

    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        **V3_PARAMS,
        loss_function="RMSE",
        eval_metric="RMSE",
        random_seed=42,
        verbose=False,
        allow_writing_files=False,
    )

    model.fit(
        X_train,
        y_train,
        eval_set=(X_val, y_val),
        use_best_model=False,
        verbose=False,
    )

    pred = model.predict(X_val)

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(y_val, pred)
    )

    elapsed = time.time() - start

    print(f"RMSE: {rmse:.6f}")
    print(f"Time: {elapsed:.1f} sec")

    results.append({
        "Split": split_name,
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "Train_Rows": len(y_train),
        "Val_Rows": len(y_val),
    })

    return model

# ======================================================================
# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V3 5-SEED ENSEMBLE
# CANONICAL COLD-SPLIT VALIDATION
# ======================================================================

from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import time

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST V3 5-SEED ENSEMBLE")
print("=" * 70)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# V3 BEST PARAMETERS — FROZEN FROM TRIAL 26
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

V3_PARAMS = {
    "iterations": 2000,
    "learning_rate": 0.11276112488638906,
    "depth": 7,
    "l2_leaf_reg": 14.269653472002503,
    "random_strength": 0.5489628342155278,
    "bagging_temperature": 0.3761423173059511,
    "border_count": 145,
    "rsm": 0.7154782689097061,
}

SEEDS = [42, 123, 2024, 3407, 7777]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# VALIDATION SPLITS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

validation_sets = {
    "COLD_COMBINATION": (
        X_cc_train, y_cc_train,
        X_cc_val, y_cc_val
    ),
    "COLD_CELL": (
        X_cell_train, y_cell_train,
        X_cell_val, y_cell_val
    ),
    "COLD_DRUG": (
        X_cd_train, y_cd_train,
        X_cd_val, y_cd_val
    ),
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRAIN ENSEMBLE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

ensemble_predictions = {}
ensemble_results = []

for split_name, (X_train_s, y_train_s, X_val_s, y_val_s) in validation_sets.items():

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(split_name)
    print("=" * 70)

    seed_predictions = []

    for seed in SEEDS:

        print(f"\nTraining seed {seed}...")

        start = time.time()

        model = CatBoostRegressor(
            **V3_PARAMS,
            loss_function="RMSE",
            random_seed=seed,
            verbose=False,
            allow_writing_files=False
        )

        model.fit(
            X_train_s,
            y_train_s
        )

        pred = model.predict(X_val_s)

        seed_predictions.append(pred)

        elapsed = time.time() - start

        seed_rmse = np.sqrt(
            mean_squared_error(y_val_s, pred)
        )

        print(
            f"Seed {seed} | "
            f"RMSE={seed_rmse:.6f} | "
            f"time={elapsed:.1f}s"
        )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # AVERAGE PREDICTIONS
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------

    seed_predictions = np.vstack(seed_predictions)

    ensemble_pred = seed_predictions.mean(axis=0)

    ensemble_predictions[split_name] = ensemble_pred

    ensemble_rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(y_val_s, ensemble_pred)
    )

    ensemble_mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_val_s,
        ensemble_pred
    )

    ensemble_results.append({
        "Split": split_name,
        "RMSE": ensemble_rmse,
        "MAE": ensemble_mae,
        "N": len(y_val_s)
    })

    print("\nENSEMBLE RESULT")

    )
)

# ======================================================================
# TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST FINAL SMALL COLD-AWARE SWEEP
