import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — CATBOOST FINAL SMALL COLD-AWARE SWEEP")
print("=" * 70)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# SAFETY CHECKS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

assert V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.shape == (294073, 62)

assert len(cc_train_idx) == 235050
assert len(cc_val_idx) == 29465

assert len(cold_cell_train_idx) == 234256
assert len(cold_cell_val_idx) == 30030

assert len(cd_train_idx) == 185064
assert len(cd_val_idx) == 48867

print("PASS — exact 62-feature matrix")
print("PASS — canonical cold validation splits")
print("PASS — COLD_DRUG validation = 48,867")
print("PASS — test sets excluded")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# MATRICES
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

X_cc_train = V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.iloc[cc_train_idx]
X_cc_val   = V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.iloc[cc_val_idx]

X_cell_train = V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.iloc[cold_cell_train_idx]
X_cell_val   = V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.iloc[cold_cell_val_idx]

X_cd_train = V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.iloc[cd_train_idx]
X_cd_val   = V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.iloc[cd_val_idx]

y_cc_train = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[cc_train_idx]["combo_score"].to_numpy()
y_cc_val   = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[cc_val_idx]["combo_score"].to_numpy()

y_cell_train = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[cold_cell_train_idx]["combo_score"].to_numpy()
y_cell_val   = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[cold_cell_val_idx]["combo_score"].to_numpy()

y_cd_train = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[cd_train_idx]["combo_score"].to_numpy()
y_cd_val   = MASTER_MODEL.iloc[cd_val_idx]["combo_score"].to_numpy()

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONFIGURATIONS
#
# Centered tightly around Trial 26:
# iterations=2000
# learning_rate=0.1128
# depth=7
# l2=14.27
# random_strength=0.55
# border_count=145
# rsm=0.715
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

configs = [
    {
        "name": "V3_CENTER",
        "iterations": 2000,
        "learning_rate": 0.1128,
        "depth": 7,
        "l2_leaf_reg": 14.27,
        "random_strength": 0.55,
        "bagging_temperature": 0.38,
        "border_count": 145,
        "rsm": 0.715,
    },
    {
        "name": "LOW_LR",
        "iterations": 2300,
        "learning_rate": 0.09,
        "depth": 7,
        "l2_leaf_reg": 14,
        "random_strength": 0.75,
        "bagging_temperature": 0.40,
        "border_count": 145,
        "rsm": 0.70,
    },
    {
        "name": "HIGH_LR",
        "iterations": 1800,
        "learning_rate": 0.12,
        "depth": 7,
        "l2_leaf_reg": 14,
        "random_strength": 0.55,
        "bagging_temperature": 0.40,
        "border_count": 145,
        "rsm": 0.70,
    },
    {
        "name": "MORE_REG",
        "iterations": 2000,
        "learning_rate": 0.11,
        "depth": 7,
        "l2_leaf_reg": 18,
        "random_strength": 0.75,
        "bagging_temperature": 0.40,
        "border_count": 145,
        "rsm": 0.70,
    },
    {
        "name": "LESS_REG",
        "iterations": 2000,
        "learning_rate": 0.11,
        "depth": 7,
        "l2_leaf_reg": 10,
        "random_strength": 0.50,
        "bagging_temperature": 0.40,
        "border_count": 145,
        "rsm": 0.70,
    },
    {
        "name": "LOW_RSM",
        "iterations": 2000,
        "learning_rate": 0.11,
        "depth": 7,
        "l2_leaf_reg": 14,
        "random_strength": 0.75,
        "bagging_temperature": 0.40,
        "border_count": 145,
        "rsm": 0.60,
    },
]

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# TRAIN ONE MODEL PER CONFIGURATION
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

results = []

for cfg in configs:

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"CONFIG: {cfg['name']}")
    print("=" * 70)

    params = {
        "loss_function": "RMSE",
        "eval_metric": "RMSE",
        "iterations": cfg["iterations"],
        "learning_rate": cfg["learning_rate"],
        "depth": cfg["depth"],
        "l2_leaf_reg": cfg["l2_leaf_reg"],
        "random_strength": cfg["random_strength"],
        "bagging_temperature": cfg["bagging_temperature"],
        "border_count": cfg["border_count"],
        "rsm": cfg["rsm"],
        "random_seed": 42,
        "verbose": False,
        "allow_writing_files": False,
        "thread_count": -1,
    }

    start = time.time()

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # COLD COMBINATION
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    model_cc = CatBoostRegressor(**params)

    model_cc.fit(X_cc_train, y_cc_train)

    pred_cc = model_cc.predict(X_cc_val)

    rmse_cc = float(
        np.sqrt(np.mean((y_cc_val - pred_cc) ** 2))
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # COLD CELL
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    model_cell = CatBoostRegressor(**params)

    model_cell.fit(X_cell_train, y_cell_train)

    pred_cell = model_cell.predict(X_cell_val)

    rmse_cell = float(
        np.sqrt(np.mean((y_cell_val - pred_cell) ** 2))
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # COLD DRUG
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    model_cd = CatBoostRegressor(**params)

    model_cd.fit(X_cd_train, y_cd_train)

    pred_cd = model_cd.predict(X_cd_val)

    rmse_cd = float(
        np.sqrt(np.mean((y_cd_val - pred_cd) ** 2))
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------------
    # COMPOSITE
    # --------------------------------------------------------------

    composite = np.mean([
        rmse_cc,
        rmse_cell,
        rmse_cd
    ])

    elapsed = time.time() - start

    result = {
        "Config": cfg["name"],
        "Cold_Combination_RMSE": rmse_cc,
        "Cold_Cell_RMSE": rmse_cell,
        "Cold_Drug_RMSE": rmse_cd,
        "Composite_RMSE": composite,
        "Time_sec": elapsed,
        **{
            k: v
            for k, v in cfg.items()
            if k != "name"
        }
    }

    results.append(result)

    print(f"COLD_COMBINATION | {rmse_cc:.6f}")
    print(f"COLD_CELL        | {rmse_cell:.6f}")
    print(f"COLD_DRUG        | {rmse_cd:.6f}")
    print(f"COMPOSITE        | {composite:.6f}")
    print(f"TIME             | {elapsed:.1f}s")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# SUMMARY
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

sweep_results = pd.DataFrame(results)

sweep_results = sweep_results.sort_values(
    "Composite_RMSE"
).reset_index(drop=True)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL CATBOOST SWEEP RESULTS")
print("=" * 70)

print(
    sweep_results[
        [
            "Config",
            "Cold_Combination_RMSE",
            "Cold_Cell_RMSE",
            "Cold_Drug_RMSE",
            "Composite_RMSE"
        ]
    ].to_string(index=False)
)

print("\nCurrent 5-seed ensemble composite: 6.693706")

best = sweep_results.iloc[0]

print("\nBEST SINGLE-SEED SWEEP CONFIG")
print(f"Config:     {best['Config']}")
print(f"Composite:  {best['Composite_RMSE']:.6f}")

if best["Composite_RMSE"] < 6.693706:
    print("\nPASS — single configuration beats current 5-seed ensemble")
else:
    print("\nNO CLEAR IMPROVEMENT — keep current 5-seed ensemble")

print("\nTEST SETS NOT USED")
print("MASTER UNCHANGED")
print("FEATURE FILES UNCHANGED")
print("SPLIT FILES UNCHANGED")

from pathlib import Path

print("=" * 70)
print("SAVING FINAL CATBOOST MODELS")

    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/model_outputs/catboost_final"
)

FINAL_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

EXPECTED_SPLITS = [
    "COLD_COMBINATION",
    "COLD_CELL",
    "COLD_DRUG",
    "RANDOM"
]

EXPECTED_SEEDS = [42, 123, 2024, 3407, 7777]

saved_paths = {}

for split_name in EXPECTED_SPLITS:

    models_here = final_models[split_name]

    assert len(models_here) == 5, (
        f"{split_name}: expected 5 models, "
        f"found {len(models_here)}"
    )

    split_dir = FINAL_DIR / split_name
    split_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    saved_paths[split_name] = []

    print("\n" + "-" * 70)
    print(split_name)

    for model, seed in zip(models_here, EXPECTED_SEEDS):

        actual_seed = model.get_params().get("random_seed")

        assert actual_seed == seed, (
            f"{split_name}: expected seed {seed}, "
            f"found {actual_seed}"
        )

        path = split_dir / f"catboost_seed_{seed}.cbm"

        model.save_model(str(path))

        assert path.exists(), (
            f"Save failed: {path}"
        )

        assert path.stat().st_size > 0, (
            f"Saved file is empty: {path}"
        )

        saved_paths[split_name].append(path)

        print(
            f"PASS — seed {seed} saved | "
            f"{path.name} | "
            f"{path.stat().st_size / (1024**2):.2f} MB"
        )

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("SAVE SUMMARY")
print("=" * 70)

total_saved = 0

for split_name in EXPECTED_SPLITS:

    count = len(saved_paths[split_name])

    print(
        f"{split_name:20s} | "
        f"{count} models saved"
    )

    total_saved += count

assert total_saved == 20

print("\nPASS — all 20 CatBoost models saved")
print(f"Output directory: {FINAL_DIR}")
print("NO TRAINING PERFORMED")
print("MASTER UNCHANGED")
print("FEATURES UNCHANGED")
print("SPLITS UNCHANGED")

    for model, seed in zip(
        final_models[split_name],
        EXPECTED_SEEDS
    ):

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # VERIFY ACTUAL MODEL SEED
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        actual_seed = model.get_params().get("random_seed")

        assert actual_seed == seed, (
            f"{split_name}: expected seed {seed}, "
            f"but model has random_seed={actual_seed}"
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # SAVE MODEL
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        model_path = (
            split_dir /
            f"catboost_seed_{seed}.cbm"
        )

        model.save_model(str(model_path))

        # --------------------------------------------------------------
        # VERIFY SAVED FILE
        # --------------------------------------------------------------

        assert model_path.exists(), (
            f"Model was not saved: {model_path}"
        )

        assert model_path.stat().st_size > 0, (
            f"Saved model is empty: {model_path}"
        )

        saved_paths[split_name].append(model_path)

        print(
            f"PASS — seed {seed} | "
            f"{model_path.name} | "
            f"{model_path.stat().st_size / (1024 ** 2):.2f} MB"
        )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 5 — FINAL AUDIT
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL SAVE AUDIT")
print("=" * 70)

total_saved = 0

for split_name in EXPECTED_SPLITS:

    count = len(saved_paths[split_name])

    assert count == 5

    print(
        f"{split_name:20s} | "
        f"{count}/5 models saved"
    )

    total_saved += count

assert total_saved == 20

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# STEP 6 — VERIFY OLD LOCATION IS GONE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "-" * 70)
print("VERIFYING OLD LOCATION")
print("-" * 70)

assert not OLD_DIR.exists()

print("PASS — old data/processed CatBoost directory does not exist")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "-" * 70)
print("VERIFYING NEW LOCATION")
print("-" * 70)

for split_name in EXPECTED_SPLITS:

    split_dir = OUTPUT_DIR / split_name

    files = sorted(split_dir.glob("*.cbm"))

    assert len(files) == 5, (

        f"found {len(files)}"
    )

    print(
        f"PASS — {split_name}: "
        f"{len(files)}/5 .cbm files present"
    )

print("\n" + "=" * 70)

# ============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ============================================================================

def safe_df(obj_name):
    """
    Return a copy of an in-memory DataFrame if available.
    Otherwise return None.
    """
    if obj_name not in globals():
        return None

    obj = globals()[obj_name]

    if isinstance(obj, pd.DataFrame):
        return obj.copy()

    return None


def dict_to_df(d, name=None):
    """
    Convert a dictionary or list of dictionaries to DataFrame.
    """
    if d is None:
        return None

    if isinstance(d, dict):
        return pd.DataFrame([d])

    if isinstance(d, list):
        return pd.DataFrame(d)

    return None

            ]

            keywords = [
                "pct",
                "percent",
                "fraction",
                "sample",
                "train_rows",
                "data_fraction",
                "train_fraction"
            ]

            if any(
                any(k in c for k in keywords)
                for c in cols_lower
            ):

                temp = obj.copy()
                temp.insert(0, "Source_Object", name)
                efficiency_found.append(temp)

if efficiency_found:

    sheets["Data_Efficiency"] = pd.concat(
        efficiency_found,
        ignore_index=True
    )

# ============================================================================
# GENERALIZATION GAP
# ============================================================================

# We calculate this ONLY where both train and test metrics are actually
# available in baseline_results_df.
#
# Generalization gap:
#   Test MAE - Train MAE
#   Test RMSE - Train RMSE
#
# Positive value = test error is higher than train error.

if "baseline_results_df" in globals():

    bdf = baseline_results_df.copy()

    required = {
        "Split",
        "Subset",
        "RMSE",
        "MAE"
    }

    if required.issubset(bdf.columns):

        train_df = bdf[
            bdf["Subset"].astype(str).str.upper() == "TRAIN"
        ][["Split", "RMSE", "MAE"]].copy()

        test_df_gap = bdf[
            bdf["Subset"].astype(str).str.upper() == "TEST"
        ][["Split", "RMSE", "MAE"]].copy()

        train_df = train_df.rename(
            columns={
                "RMSE": "Train_RMSE",
                "MAE": "Train_MAE"
            }
        )

        test_df_gap = test_df_gap.rename(
            columns={
                "RMSE": "Test_RMSE",
                "MAE": "Test_MAE"
            }
        )

        gap_df = train_df.merge(
            test_df_gap,
            on="Split",
            how="inner"
        )

        if not gap_df.empty:

            gap_df["RMSE_Generalization_Gap"] = (
                gap_df["Test_RMSE"]
                - gap_df["Train_RMSE"]
            )

            gap_df["MAE_Generalization_Gap"] = (
                gap_df["Test_MAE"]
                - gap_df["Train_MAE"]
            )

            sheets["Generalization_Gap"] = gap_df

# ============================================================================
# CREATE STATUS SHEET
# ============================================================================

status_rows = []

# Core regression metrics
status_rows.append({
    "Evaluation_Component": "MAE",
    "Status": "AVAILABLE",

status_rows.append({

# ============================================================================
# TRUSTSYN — IDENTIFY WHICH IN-MEMORY MODELS PRODUCED FINAL_V2_RESULTS
# ============================================================================
# READ-ONLY
# NO TRAINING
# NO FILE MODIFICATIONS
# ============================================================================

from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test sets
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

split_data = {
    "RANDOM": (X_random_test_final, random_test),
    "COLD_COMBINATION": (X_cc_test_final, cold_combination_test),
    "COLD_CELL": (X_cell_test_final, cold_cell_test),
    "COLD_DRUG": (X_test_split, cold_test),
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Candidate models
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

candidate_models = {
    "catboost_v2": catboost_v2,
    "model": model,
    "model_cc": model_cc,
    "model_cell": model_cell,
    "model_cd": model_cd,
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Expected V2 metrics from Final_V2_Results
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

expected = {
    "RANDOM": {
        "RMSE": 5.552320,
        "MAE": 3.846086,
        "Pearson": 0.611850,
    },
    "COLD_COMBINATION": {
        "RMSE": 5.001930,
        "MAE": 3.497684,
        "Pearson": 0.713628,
    },
    "COLD_CELL": {
        "RMSE": 5.809555,
        "MAE": 3.915694,
        "Pearson": 0.728038,
    },
    "COLD_DRUG": {
        "RMSE": 4.918481,
        "MAE": 3.486695,
        "Pearson": 0.591261,
    },
}

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Evaluate every candidate on every matching test split
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

rows = []

for model_name, mdl in candidate_models.items():

    for split, (X_test, df_test) in split_data.items():

        try:
            pred = mdl.predict(X_test)
            y_true = df_test["combo_score"].to_numpy()

            rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_true, pred))
            mae = mean_absolute_error(y_true, pred)
            pearson = pearsonr(y_true, pred)[0]

            e = expected[split]

            rows.append({
                "Model": model_name,
                "Split": split,
                "RMSE": rmse,
                "Expected_RMSE": e["RMSE"],
                "RMSE_Diff": rmse - e["RMSE"],
                "MAE": mae,
                "Expected_MAE": e["MAE"],
                "MAE_Diff": mae - e["MAE"],
                "Pearson": pearson,
                "Expected_Pearson": e["Pearson"],
                "Pearson_Diff": pearson - e["Pearson"],
            })

        except Exception as exc:

            rows.append({
                "Model": model_name,
                "Split": split,
                "RMSE": np.nan,
                "Expected_RMSE": expected[split]["RMSE"],
                "RMSE_Diff": np.nan,
                "MAE": np.nan,
                "Expected_MAE": expected[split]["MAE"],
                "MAE_Diff": np.nan,
                "Pearson": np.nan,
                "Expected_Pearson": expected[split]["Pearson"],
                "Pearson_Diff": np.nan,
            })

results_check = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Show only the useful identification columns
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

print("=" * 110)
print("MODEL IDENTIFICATION — COMPARISON WITH FINAL_V2_RESULTS")
print("=" * 110)

print(
    results_check[
        [
            "Model",
            "Split",
            "RMSE",
            "Expected_RMSE",
            "RMSE_Diff",
            "MAE",
            "Expected_MAE",
            "MAE_Diff",
            "Pearson",
            "Expected_Pearson",
            "Pearson_Diff",
        ]
    ].to_string(index=False)
)

print("NO TRAINING PERFORMED")
print("NO FILES MODIFIED")

    val_drugs = set(

    print("Val rows:", len(val))
    print("Test rows:", len(test))

    print("Unique val drugs:", len(val_drugs))
    print("Unique test drugs:", len(test_drugs))

    print(
        "Train ∩ Test:",
        len(train_drugs & test_drugs)
    )

    print(
        "Train ∩ Val:",
        len(train_drugs & val_drugs)
    )

    print(
        "Val ∩ Test:",
        len(val_drugs & test_drugs)
    )

    # Exact drug pairs
    def pair_set(df):
        return set(
            zip(
                df["drug_A"].astype(str),
                df["drug_B"].astype(str)
            )
        )

    train_pairs = pair_set(train)
    val_pairs = pair_set(val)
    test_pairs = pair_set(test)

    print(
        "Train ∩ Test pairs:",
        len(train_pairs & test_pairs)
    )

    print(
        "Train ∩ Val pairs:",
        len(train_pairs & val_pairs)
    )

    print(
        "Val ∩ Test pairs:",
        len(val_pairs & test_pairs)
    )

from pathlib import Path

    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/notebooks/Model_Optuna_CatBoost.ipynb"

    nb = json.load(f)

terms = [
    "cold_drug",
    "cold_drug_corrected",
    "splits/cold_drug",
    "splits/cold_drug_corrected",
    "cd_test",
    "cold_test",
    "test.csv"
]

print("CATBOOST COLD_DRUG SOURCE TRACE")
print("=" * 80)

found = 0

for i, cell in enumerate(nb.get("cells", [])):

    source = "".join(cell.get("source", []))

    if not source.strip():
        continue

    source_lower = source.lower()

    matched = [
        term for term in terms
        if term.lower() in source_lower
    ]

    if not matched:
        continue

    found += 1

    print("\n" + "=" * 80)
    print(f"CELL {i}")
    print(f"TYPE: {cell.get('cell_type')}")
    print("MATCHED:", matched)
    print("-" * 80)

    # Print the entire relevant cell unless enormous
    lines = source.splitlines()

    if len(lines) <= 150:
        print(source)
    else:
        print("\n".join(lines[:150]))
        print(
            f"\n... [{len(lines)-150} additional lines omitted] ..."
        )

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print(f"RELEVANT CELLS FOUND: {found}")
print("=" * 80)

print("READ-ONLY")
print("NO TRAINING")
print("NO FILES MODIFIED")

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

BASE = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn")
MASTER_PATH = BASE / "data/processed/almanac/almanac_final_59cell_104drug.csv"

master = pd.read_csv(MASTER_PATH)

SPLITS = {
    "RANDOM": BASE / "splits/random",
    "COLD_COMBINATION": BASE / "splits/cold_combination",
    "COLD_CELL": BASE / "splits/cold_cell_line",
    "COLD_DRUG": BASE / "splits/cold_drug",
    "COLD_DRUG_CORRECTED": BASE / "splits/cold_drug_corrected",
}

def row_key(df):
    return (
        df["drug_A"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["drug_B"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["CELLNAME"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["CONC1"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["CONC2"].astype(str)
    )

def drugs_used(df):
    return (
        set(df["drug_A"].astype(str)) |
        set(df["drug_B"].astype(str))
    )

def pairs_used(df):
    a = df["drug_A"].astype(str)
    b = df["drug_B"].astype(str)
    return set(
        a.where(a < b, b) + "||" +
        b.where(a < b, a)
    )

def cells_used(df):
    return set(df["CELLNAME"].astype(str))


EXPECTED = {
    "RANDOM": {
        "train": None, "val": None, "test": 29408
    },
    "COLD_COMBINATION": {
        "train": None, "val": None, "test": 29558
    },
    "COLD_CELL": {
        "train": None, "val": None, "test": 29787
    },
    "COLD_DRUG": {
        "train": 185064, "val": 48867, "test": 60142
    },
    "COLD_DRUG_CORRECTED": {
        "train": 185064, "val": 48867, "test": 60142
    },
}

print("=" * 80)
print("TRUSTSYN — COMPLETE SPLIT DIAGNOSTIC")
print("=" * 80)
print(f"MASTER: {master.shape}")
print()

results = {}

for name, directory in SPLITS.items():

    print("=" * 80)
    print(name)
    print("=" * 80)

    if not directory.exists():
        print("❌ DIRECTORY NOT FOUND")
        results[name] = "MISSING"
        continue

    files = {
        "train": directory / "train.csv",
        "val": directory / "val.csv",
        "test": directory / "test.csv",
    }

    missing = [k for k, p in files.items() if not p.exists()]

    if missing:
        print("❌ MISSING FILES:", missing)
        results[name] = "MISSING FILES"
        continue

    train = pd.read_csv(files["train"])
    val   = pd.read_csv(files["val"])
    test  = pd.read_csv(files["test"])

    print(
        f"Rows: train={len(train):,} | "
        f"val={len(val):,} | "
        f"test={len(test):,}"
    )

    # Coverage
    tr_rows = set(row_key(train))
    va_rows = set(row_key(val))
    te_rows = set(row_key(test))
    all_rows = tr_rows | va_rows | te_rows

    master_rows = set(row_key(master))

    coverage_ok = all_rows == master_rows

    print(f"MASTER coverage: {'PASS' if coverage_ok else 'FAIL'}")
    print(f"  Assigned: {len(all_rows):,}")
    print(f"  Master  : {len(master_rows):,}")
    print(f"  Missing : {len(master_rows - all_rows):,}")
    print(f"  Extra   : {len(all_rows - master_rows):,}")

    # Row overlap
    row_overlap = (
        len(tr_rows & va_rows),
        len(tr_rows & te_rows),
        len(va_rows & te_rows),
    )

    print(
        f"Row overlap: "
        f"train-val={row_overlap[0]} | "
        f"train-test={row_overlap[1]} | "
        f"val-test={row_overlap[2]}"
    )

    # Drug overlap
    tr_drugs = drugs_used(train)
    va_drugs = drugs_used(val)
    te_drugs = drugs_used(test)

    drug_overlap = (
        len(tr_drugs & va_drugs),
        len(tr_drugs & te_drugs),
        len(va_drugs & te_drugs),
    )

    print(
        f"Drugs: train={len(tr_drugs)} | "
        f"val={len(va_drugs)} | "
        f"test={len(te_drugs)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Drug overlap: "
        f"train-val={drug_overlap[0]} | "
        f"train-test={drug_overlap[1]} | "
        f"val-test={drug_overlap[2]}"
    )

    # Pair overlap
    tr_pairs = pairs_used(train)
    va_pairs = pairs_used(val)
    te_pairs = pairs_used(test)

    pair_overlap = (
        len(tr_pairs & va_pairs),
        len(tr_pairs & te_pairs),
        len(va_pairs & te_pairs),
    )

    print(
        f"Pair overlap: "
        f"train-val={pair_overlap[0]} | "
        f"train-test={pair_overlap[1]} | "
        f"val-test={pair_overlap[2]}"
    )

    # Cell overlap
    tr_cells = cells_used(train)
    va_cells = cells_used(val)
    te_cells = cells_used(test)

    cell_overlap = (
        len(tr_cells & va_cells),
        len(tr_cells & te_cells),
        len(va_cells & te_cells),
    )

    print(
        f"Cells: train={len(tr_cells)} | "
        f"val={len(va_cells)} | "
        f"test={len(te_cells)}"
    )

    print(
        f"Cell overlap: "
        f"train-val={cell_overlap[0]} | "
        f"train-test={cell_overlap[1]} | "
        f"val-test={cell_overlap[2]}"
    )

    results[name] = {
        "rows": (len(train), len(val), len(test)),
        "coverage": coverage_ok,
        "row_overlap": row_overlap,
        "drug_overlap": drug_overlap,
        "pair_overlap": pair_overlap,
        "cell_overlap": cell_overlap,
    }

print()
print("=" * 80)
print("DIAGNOSTIC COMPLETE — NOTHING MODIFIED")
print("=" * 80)

    return (
        df["drug_A"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["drug_B"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["CELLNAME"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["CONC1"].astype(str) + "||" +
        df["CONC2"].astype(str)
    )

def drugs_used(df):
    return (
        set(df["drug_A"].astype(str)) |
        set(df["drug_B"].astype(str))
    )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. BASIC SIZES
# ---------------------------------------------------------

print("=" * 70)

print("=" * 70)

print("Val  :", len(val))

print("Train ∩ Test:", len(train_drugs & test_drugs))
print("Val ∩ Test  :", len(val_drugs & test_drugs))

print("Val-only drugs  :", sorted(val_drugs - train_drugs - test_drugs))
print("Test-only drugs :", sorted(test_drugs - train_drugs - val_drugs))

tr_keys = set(row_key(train))
va_keys = set(row_key(val))
te_keys = set(row_key(test))

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("ROW OVERLAP")
print("=" * 70)

print("Train ∩ Val :", len(tr_keys & va_keys))
print("Train ∩ Test:", len(tr_keys & te_keys))
print("Val ∩ Test  :", len(va_keys & te_keys))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. MASTER COVERAGE
# ---------------------------------------------------------

master_keys = set(row_key(master))
assigned_keys = tr_keys | va_keys | te_keys

missing = master_keys - assigned_keys
extra   = assigned_keys - master_keys

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("MASTER COVERAGE")

print("MASTER rows:", len(master_keys))

missing_df = master[row_key(master).isin(missing)].copy()

missing_drugs = drugs_used(missing_df)

def category(a):
    a = str(a)
    if a in train_drugs:
        return "TRAIN_DRUG"
    if a in val_drugs:
        return "VAL_DRUG"
    if a in test_drugs:
        return "TEST_DRUG"

    predictions = np.vstack(predictions)

    y_pred = predictions.mean(axis=0)

    print(f"\nEnsemble size: {len(model_obj)}")

else:

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. RANKING METRICS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

eval_df = cd_test[["drug_A", "drug_B", "CELLNAME", TARGET]].copy()
eval_df["prediction"] = y_pred

# Relevance threshold = 90th percentile of test scores
threshold = np.percentile(eval_df[TARGET], 90)
eval_df["relevant"] = eval_df[TARGET] >= threshold

def dcg_at_k(relevances, k):
    relevances = np.asarray(relevances[:k], dtype=float)

    if len(relevances) == 0:
        return 0.0

    discounts = np.log2(np.arange(2, len(relevances) + 2))
    return np.sum(relevances / discounts)

def ndcg_at_k(relevances, k):
    actual = dcg_at_k(relevances, k)

    ideal = np.sort(np.asarray(relevances))[::-1]
    ideal_dcg = dcg_at_k(ideal, k)

    if ideal_dcg == 0:
        return 0.0

    return actual / ideal_dcg

def ranking_metrics(df, k_values=(10, 50, 100)):

    # Rank globally because this matches the existing evaluation
    ranked = df.sort_values("prediction", ascending=False)

    relevant_total = int(df["relevant"].sum())

    results = {}

    for k in k_values:
        topk = ranked.head(k)

        relevant_topk = int(topk["relevant"].sum())

        precision = relevant_topk / k
        recall = (
            relevant_topk / relevant_total
            if relevant_total > 0 else 0.0
        )

        relevances = ranked["relevant"].astype(int).to_numpy()

        ndcg = ndcg_at_k(relevances, k)

        baseline_rate = relevant_total / len(df)
        enrichment = (
            precision / baseline_rate
            if baseline_rate > 0 else np.nan
        )

        results[f"Precision@{k}"] = precision
        results[f"Recall@{k}"] = recall
        results[f"nDCG@{k}"] = ndcg
        results[f"Enrichment@{k}"] = enrichment

    return results

rank_results = ranking_metrics(eval_df)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("RANKING METRICS — ORIGINAL COLD_DRUG")
print("=" * 70)

for key, value in rank_results.items():
    print(f"{key:20s}: {value:.6f}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. FINAL RESULT TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cold_drug_final_result = pd.DataFrame([{
    "Split": "COLD_DRUG",
    "Split_Source": str(COLD_DRUG_DIR),
    "Train_Rows": len(cd_train),
    "Val_Rows": len(cd_val),
    "Test_Rows": len(cd_test),
    "Train_Drugs": len(train_drugs),
    "Val_Drugs": len(val_drugs),
    "Test_Drugs": len(test_drugs),
    "RMSE": rmse,
    "MAE": mae,
    "Pearson": pearson,
    "Spearman": spearman,
    "Precision@10": rank_results["Precision@10"],
    "Precision@50": rank_results["Precision@50"],
    "Precision@100": rank_results["Precision@100"],
    "Recall@100": rank_results["Recall@100"],
    "nDCG@100": rank_results["nDCG@100"],
    "Enrichment@100": rank_results["Enrichment@100"],
}])

# ================================================================
# TRUSTSYN — CORRECT COLD_DRUG SPLIT GENERATION
# FULL COVERAGE + STRICT TEST-DRUG HOLDOUT
# READ-ONLY MASTER INPUT
# ================================================================

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

print("=" * 70)
print("TRUSTSYN — COLD_DRUG CORRECT SPLIT")
print("=" * 70)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD FROZEN MASTER
# ------------------------------------------------

MASTER_PATH = Path(
    "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/almanac/"
    "almanac_final_59cell_104drug.csv"
)

master = pd.read_csv(MASTER_PATH)

print(f"MASTER shape: {master.shape}")

assert master.shape[0] == 294073, \
    f"Unexpected MASTER row count: {master.shape[0]}"

assert master["drug_A"].notna().all()
assert master["drug_B"].notna().all()

# ------------------------------------------------
# 2. CANONICAL DRUG IDENTIFIER
# ------------------------------------------------
# Use strings consistently so IDs such as 753082 / 753082.0
# cannot create accidental mismatches.

def canon_drug(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return None

    s = str(x).strip()

    # Normalize numeric-looking IDs such as "753082.0"
    try:
        f = float(s)
        if f.is_integer():
            return str(int(f))
    except Exception:
        pass

    return s

master["_drug_A"] = master["drug_A"].map(canon_drug)
master["_drug_B"] = master["drug_B"].map(canon_drug)

master["_drug_1"] = master[["_drug_A", "_drug_B"]].min(axis=1)
master["_drug_2"] = master[["_drug_A", "_drug_B"]].max(axis=1)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 3. VERIFY 104-DRUG UNIVERSE
# ------------------------------------------------

all_drugs = sorted(
    set(master["_drug_A"]) | set(master["_drug_B"]),
    key=lambda x: int(x) if x.isdigit() else x
)

print(f"Unique MASTER drugs: {len(all_drugs)}")

assert len(all_drugs) == 104, \
    f"Expected 104 drugs, found {len(all_drugs)}"

# ------------------------------------------------
# 4. CREATE DETERMINISTIC 83 / 10 / 11 DRUG PARTITION
# ------------------------------------------------
# IMPORTANT:
# We use a fixed seed so the split is reproducible.
#
# 83 train drugs
# 10 validation drugs
# 11 test drugs
#
# The TEST drugs are the actual held-out drug set.
# ------------------------------------------------

SEED = 42

rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

shuffled_drugs = np.array(all_drugs, dtype=object)
rng.shuffle(shuffled_drugs)

TRAIN_DRUGS = set(shuffled_drugs[:83])
VAL_DRUGS   = set(shuffled_drugs[83:93])
TEST_DRUGS  = set(shuffled_drugs[93:104])

print("\nDRUG PARTITION")
print("-" * 70)
print("Train:", len(TRAIN_DRUGS))
print("Val  :", len(VAL_DRUGS))
print("Test :", len(TEST_DRUGS))
print("Total:", len(TRAIN_DRUGS | VAL_DRUGS | TEST_DRUGS))

assert len(TRAIN_DRUGS) == 83
assert len(VAL_DRUGS) == 10
assert len(TEST_DRUGS) == 11

assert TRAIN_DRUGS.isdisjoint(VAL_DRUGS)
assert TRAIN_DRUGS.isdisjoint(TEST_DRUGS)
assert VAL_DRUGS.isdisjoint(TEST_DRUGS)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 5. ASSIGN EVERY MASTER ROW
# ------------------------------------------------
#
# CORRECT COLD-DRUG LOGIC:
#
# TEST:
#     If either drug is a TEST drug.
#
# VAL:
#     If neither drug is a TEST drug AND at least
#     one drug is a VAL drug.
#
# TRAIN:
#     Both drugs are TRAIN drugs.
#
# This guarantees:
#   - complete MASTER coverage
#   - no test drug in training
#   - no row duplication
#   - every combination involving a held-out test drug
#     is placed in TEST
# ------------------------------------------------

a = master["_drug_A"]
b = master["_drug_B"]

is_test = a.isin(TEST_DRUGS) | b.isin(TEST_DRUGS)

is_train = a.isin(TRAIN_DRUGS) & b.isin(TRAIN_DRUGS)

is_val = (
    ~is_test
    & ~is_train
    & (
        a.isin(VAL_DRUGS)
        | b.isin(VAL_DRUGS)
    )
)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. ASSERT EVERY ROW HAS EXACTLY ONE ASSIGNMENT
# ------------------------------------------------

assignment_count = (
    is_train.astype(int)
    + is_val.astype(int)
    + is_test.astype(int)
)

print("\nROW ASSIGNMENT CHECK")
print("-" * 70)

print("Unassigned:", int((assignment_count == 0).sum()))
print("Multiply assigned:", int((assignment_count > 1).sum()))

assert (assignment_count == 1).all(), \
    "FAIL — some MASTER rows were not assigned exactly once."

# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. BUILD SPLITS
# ------------------------------------------------

train = master.loc[is_train].copy()
val   = master.loc[is_val].copy()
test  = master.loc[is_test].copy()

# Remove internal helper columns
helper_cols = [
    "_drug_A",
    "_drug_B",
    "_drug_1",
    "_drug_2"
]

train.drop(columns=helper_cols, inplace=True)
val.drop(columns=helper_cols, inplace=True)
test.drop(columns=helper_cols, inplace=True)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 8. ROW COVERAGE
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\nROW COVERAGE")
print("-" * 70)

print("TRAIN:", len(train))
print("VAL  :", len(val))
print("TEST :", len(test))
print("TOTAL:", len(train) + len(val) + len(test))
print("MASTER:", len(master))

assert len(train) + len(val) + len(test) == len(master)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 9. RECONSTRUCT EXACT ROW KEYS
# ------------------------------------------------

KEY_COLS = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id",
    "nci_almanac_cellname"
]

def make_key(df):
    return (
        df[KEY_COLS]
        .astype("string")
        .fillna("<NA>")
        .agg("||".join, axis=1)
    )

master_keys = make_key(master)
train_keys = make_key(train)
val_keys = make_key(val)
test_keys = make_key(test)

assigned_keys = pd.concat(
    [train_keys, val_keys, test_keys],
    ignore_index=True
)

print("\nEXACT ROW COVERAGE")
print("-" * 70)

print("MASTER unique keys :", master_keys.nunique())
print("Assigned unique keys:", assigned_keys.nunique())
print("Missing:", len(set(master_keys) - set(assigned_keys)))
print("Extra:", len(set(assigned_keys) - set(master_keys)))

assert master_keys.nunique() == len(master)
assert assigned_keys.nunique() == len(master)
assert set(master_keys) == set(assigned_keys)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 10. ROW OVERLAP
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\nROW OVERLAP")
print("-" * 70)

print("TRAIN ∩ VAL  :", len(set(train_keys) & set(val_keys)))
print("TRAIN ∩ TEST :", len(set(train_keys) & set(test_keys)))
print("VAL ∩ TEST   :", len(set(val_keys) & set(test_keys)))

assert len(set(train_keys) & set(val_keys)) == 0
assert len(set(train_keys) & set(test_keys)) == 0
assert len(set(val_keys) & set(test_keys)) == 0

# ------------------------------------------------
# 11. DRUG-LEVEL COLDNESS
# ------------------------------------------------

def drugs_in(df):
    return set(
        df["drug_A"].map(canon_drug)
    ) | set(
        df["drug_B"].map(canon_drug)
    )

train_drugs_actual = drugs_in(train)
val_drugs_actual = drugs_in(val)
test_drugs_actual = drugs_in(test)

print("\nDRUG-LEVEL CHECK")
print("-" * 70)

print("Train drugs:", len(train_drugs_actual))
print("Val drugs  :", len(val_drugs_actual))
print("Test drugs :", len(test_drugs_actual))

print(
    "TRAIN ∩ TEST:",
    len(train_drugs_actual & test_drugs_actual)
)

print(
    "TEST drugs absent from TRAIN:",
    TEST_DRUGS.isdisjoint(train_drugs_actual)
)

assert TEST_DRUGS.isdisjoint(train_drugs_actual)

# ------------------------------------------------
# 12. CRITICAL HANDBOOK TEST
# ------------------------------------------------
# Every row containing a held-out TEST drug must be TEST.

test_drug_rows = (
    master["drug_A"].map(canon_drug).isin(TEST_DRUGS)
    | master["drug_B"].map(canon_drug).isin(TEST_DRUGS)
)

expected_test_keys = set(
    make_key(master.loc[test_drug_rows])
)

actual_test_keys = set(test_keys)

print("\nHANDBOOK COLD-DRUG RULE")
print("-" * 70)

print(
    "MASTER rows involving held-out test drugs:",
    len(expected_test_keys)
)

print(
    "Rows actually assigned to TEST:",
    len(actual_test_keys)
)

print(
    "Missing held-out-drug rows:",
    len(expected_test_keys - actual_test_keys)
)

assert expected_test_keys == actual_test_keys

# ------------------------------------------------
# 13. FINAL SUMMARY
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("FINAL DIAGNOSIS")
print("=" * 70)

print("PASS — 104 drugs partitioned as 83 / 10 / 11")
print("PASS — MASTER has 294,073 rows")
print("PASS — 100% MASTER row coverage")
print("PASS — zero row overlap")
print("PASS — all 11 TEST drugs absent from TRAIN")
print("PASS — every row containing a TEST drug is in TEST")
print("PASS — no MASTER rows dropped")
print("=" * 70)

print("\nSPLIT SIZES")
print(f"TRAIN: {len(train):,}")
print(f"VAL  : {len(val):,}")
print(f"TEST : {len(test):,}")
print(f"TOTAL: {len(train)+len(val)+len(test):,}")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 14. DO NOT SAVE YET
# ------------------------------------------------

print("\nREAD-ONLY DIAGNOSTIC COMPLETE")
print("NOTHING SAVED")
print("MASTER NOT MODIFIED")
print("EXISTING SPLITS NOT MODIFIED")

print("\nMASTER COVERAGE")

assert len(missing) == 0
assert len(extra) == 0
assert assigned.nunique() == len(master)

print("PASS — 100% MASTER coverage")

assert tt == 0
assert vt == 0

# ------------------------------------------------
# 6. CANONICAL DRUG IDs
# ------------------------------------------------

def canon_drug(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return None

    s = str(x).strip()

    try:
        f = float(s)
        if f.is_integer():
            return str(int(f))
    except Exception:
        pass

    return s

def drugs_in(df):
    return (
        set(df["drug_A"].map(canon_drug))
        | set(df["drug_B"].map(canon_drug))
    )

master_drugs = drugs_in(master)
train_drugs  = drugs_in(train)
val_drugs    = drugs_in(val)
test_drugs   = drugs_in(test)

print("\nDRUG COUNTS")
print("-" * 70)
print("MASTER:", len(master_drugs))
print("TRAIN :", len(train_drugs))
print("VAL   :", len(val_drugs))
print("TEST  :", len(test_drugs))

assert len(master_drugs) == 104
assert len(train_drugs) == 83

# ------------------------------------------------
# 7. IDENTIFY DESIGNATED HELD-OUT TEST DRUGS
# ------------------------------------------------
#
# The test drugs are exactly the drugs that never occur
# in TRAIN but occur in TEST.
#
# These should be the original 11 held-out drugs.

held_out_test_drugs = test_drugs - train_drugs

print("\nHELD-OUT TEST DRUGS")
print("-" * 70)
print("Count:", len(held_out_test_drugs))
print(sorted(held_out_test_drugs))

assert len(held_out_test_drugs) == 11

# ------------------------------------------------
# 8. CRITICAL COLD-DRUG RULE
# ------------------------------------------------
#
# NO held-out test drug may occur in TRAIN.

train_heldout_overlap = train_drugs & held_out_test_drugs

print("\nCOLD-DRUG TRAINING LEAKAGE CHECK")
print("-" * 70)
print("Held-out drugs in TRAIN:", len(train_heldout_overlap))
print("Overlap:", sorted(train_heldout_overlap))

assert len(train_heldout_overlap) == 0

print("PASS — no held-out test drug appears in TRAIN")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 9. EVERY ROW CONTAINING HELD-OUT DRUG MUST BE TEST
# ------------------------------------------------

master_A = master["drug_A"].map(canon_drug)
master_B = master["drug_B"].map(canon_drug)

heldout_rows = (
    master_A.isin(held_out_test_drugs)
    | master_B.isin(held_out_test_drugs)
)

expected_test_keys = set(
    master_keys[heldout_rows]
)

actual_test_keys = set(test_keys)

missing_from_test = expected_test_keys - actual_test_keys
wrongly_outside_test = actual_test_keys - expected_test_keys

print("\nHELD-OUT DRUG ROW ASSIGNMENT")
print("-" * 70)
print("MASTER rows involving held-out drugs:",
      len(expected_test_keys))
print("TEST rows:",
      len(actual_test_keys))
print("Held-out rows missing from TEST:",
      len(missing_from_test))

assert len(missing_from_test) == 0

print("PASS — every held-out-drug row is in TEST")

# ------------------------------------------------
# 10. TEST ROWS WITH NO HELD-OUT DRUG
# ------------------------------------------------
#
# This is NOT necessarily an error.
# Test rows can contain a held-out drug paired with
# a training/validation drug.
#
# Therefore every TEST row should contain >=1 held-out drug.

test_A = test["drug_A"].map(canon_drug)
test_B = test["drug_B"].map(canon_drug)

bad_test_rows = ~(
    test_A.isin(held_out_test_drugs)
    | test_B.isin(held_out_test_drugs)
)

print("\nTEST COMPOSITION")
print("-" * 70)
print("TEST rows without held-out drug:",
      int(bad_test_rows.sum()))

assert bad_test_rows.sum() == 0

print("PASS — every TEST row contains a held-out drug")

print("=" * 70)

print("PASS — every TEST row contains a held-out drug")

def safe_pearson(y, p):
    if np.std(y) == 0 or np.std(p) == 0:
        return np.nan
    return pearsonr(y, p).statistic


def safe_spearman(y, p):
    if np.std(y) == 0 or np.std(p) == 0:
        return np.nan
    return spearmanr(y, p).statistic


cd_rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_cd_test, pred_cd))
cd_mae = mean_absolute_error(y_cd_test, pred_cd)
cd_pearson = safe_pearson(y_cd_test, pred_cd)
cd_spearman = safe_spearman(y_cd_test, pred_cd)

print(f"Pearson  : {cd_pearson:.6f}")
print(f"Spearman : {cd_spearman:.6f}")

# 8. RANKING METRICS

def ranking_metrics(y_true, y_pred, k_values=(50, 100)):
    y_true = np.asarray(y_true, dtype=float)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=float)

    order = np.argsort(-y_pred)

    # Handbook:
    # synergy_hit = top 10–15%
    # We use top 10% as the explicit binary definition.
    threshold = np.quantile(y_true, 0.90)

    positive = y_true >= threshold
    total_positive = positive.sum()

    out = {
        "synergy_threshold_top10": float(threshold),
        "total_synergy_hits": int(total_positive),
    }

    for k in k_values:

        k = min(k, len(y_true))

        top_idx = order[:k]

        hits = positive[top_idx].sum()

        precision = hits / k

        recall = (
            hits / total_positive
            if total_positive > 0
            else np.nan
        )

        # --------------------------------------------------------
        # nDCG@K
        # --------------------------------------------------------

        relevance = positive.astype(float)

        dcg = 0.0

        for rank, idx_ in enumerate(top_idx, start=1):
            dcg += relevance[idx_] / np.log2(rank + 1)

        ideal_relevance = np.sort(relevance)[::-1][:k]

        idcg = 0.0

        for rank, rel in enumerate(ideal_relevance, start=1):
            idcg += rel / np.log2(rank + 1)

        ndcg = dcg / idcg if idcg > 0 else np.nan

        # --------------------------------------------------------
        # Enrichment@K
        # --------------------------------------------------------

        baseline_rate = total_positive / len(y_true)

        enrichment = (
            precision / baseline_rate
            if baseline_rate > 0
            else np.nan
        )

        out[f"Precision@{k}"] = precision
        out[f"Recall@{k}"] = recall
        out[f"nDCG@{k}"] = ndcg
        out[f"Enrichment@{k}"] = enrichment

    return out


cd_rank = ranking_metrics(
    y_cd_test,
    pred_cd,
    k_values=(50, 100)
)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("COLD_DRUG_CORRECTED — RANKING METRICS")
print("=" * 70)

for k, v in cd_rank.items():
    print(f"{k}: {v:.6f}" if isinstance(v, float) else f"{k}: {v}")

# 12. GENERALIZATION GAPS

    results_df["Split"].astype(str).str.upper() == "RANDOM"

if len(random_rows) > 0:

    random_mae = float(random_rows.iloc[0]["MAE"])

    gap_rows = []

    for _, row in results_df.iterrows():

        split = str(row["Split"]).upper()

        if split == "RANDOM":
            continue

        if "MAE" not in row:
            continue

        gap_rows.append({
            "Split": row["Split"],
            "Random_MAE": random_mae,
            "Cold_MAE": float(row["MAE"]),
            "MAE_Gap": float(row["MAE"]) - random_mae,
        })

    gap_df = pd.DataFrame(gap_rows)

# ============================================================
# TRUSTSYN V2 — DATA-EFFICIENCY CURVE
# 1 / 5 / 10 / 25 / 100% TRAINING FRACTIONS
#
# READ-ONLY:
# - MASTER not modified
# - FEATURES not modified
# - SPLITS not modified
# - FINAL V2 CHECKPOINT not modified
# ============================================================

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from catboost import CatBoostRegressor
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
import json

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# PATHS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

FINAL_DIR = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/final_v2_catboost")
SPLIT_DIR = Path("/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/splits/cold_combination")

FINAL_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# EXISTING V2 FEATURE MATRIX
# ------------------------------------------------------------

assert "V2_FEATURE_MATRIX" in globals(), \
    "V2_FEATURE_MATRIX not found."

FEATURES = list(V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.columns)

print("=" * 70)
print("V2 DATA-EFFICIENCY CURVE")
print("=" * 70)
print("Feature count:", len(FEATURES))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# LOAD COLD-COMBINATION SPLIT
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cc_train = pd.read_csv(SPLIT_DIR / "train.csv")
cc_test  = pd.read_csv(SPLIT_DIR / "test.csv")

print("\nCOLD_COMBINATION")
print("Train:", cc_train.shape)
print("Test :", cc_test.shape)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# EXACT ROW MAPPING TO EXISTING V2 FEATURE MATRIX
# ------------------------------------------------------------

KEY_COLS = [
    "drug_A",
    "drug_B",
    "CELLNAME",
    "tissue",
    "combo_score",
    "CONC1",
    "CONC2",
    "cellminer_cellline_id",
    "nci_almanac_cellname"
]

def make_exact_key(df):
    x = df[KEY_COLS].copy()

    # Convert safely to strings so NaN does not break joining.
    return x.astype("string").fillna("<NA>").agg("||".join, axis=1)

master_keys = make_exact_key(
    globals()["master_df"] if "master_df" in globals()
    else pd.read_csv(
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/almanac/"
        "almanac_final_59cell_104drug.csv"
    )
)

feature_key_df = (
    globals()["master_df"]
    if "master_df" in globals()
    else pd.read_csv(
        "/Users/anoushka/TrustSyn/data/processed/almanac/"
        "almanac_final_59cell_104drug.csv"
    )
)

feature_keys = make_exact_key(feature_key_df)

assert len(feature_keys) == len(V2_FEATURE_MATRIX)
assert feature_keys.duplicated().sum() == 0

train_keys = make_exact_key(cc_train)
test_keys  = make_exact_key(cc_test)

train_lookup = pd.Series(
    np.arange(len(V2_FEATURE_MATRIX)),
    index=feature_keys
)

train_idx = train_lookup.loc[train_keys].to_numpy()
test_idx  = train_lookup.loc[test_keys].to_numpy()

X_train_full = V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.iloc[train_idx][FEATURES].copy()
y_train_full = cc_train["combo_score"].to_numpy()

X_test = V2_FEATURE_MATRIX.iloc[test_idx][FEATURES].copy()
y_test = cc_test["combo_score"].to_numpy()

assert len(X_train_full) == len(cc_train)
assert len(X_test) == len(cc_test)

print("\nExact mapping:")
print("X_train_full:", X_train_full.shape)
print("X_test      :", X_test.shape)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# FRACTIONS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

FRACTIONS = [0.01, 0.05, 0.10, 0.25, 1.00]

# Fixed seed = reproducible subsampling
SEED = 42
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

permutation = rng.permutation(len(X_train_full))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# TRAIN/EVALUATE
# ------------------------------------------------------------

results = []

for fraction in FRACTIONS:

    n_rows = max(1, int(round(len(X_train_full) * fraction)))
    idx = permutation[:n_rows]

    X_sub = X_train_full.iloc[idx]
    y_sub = y_train_full[idx]

    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"TRAINING FRACTION: {fraction:.0%}")
    print("=" * 70)
    print("Training rows:", n_rows)
    print("Fixed test rows:", len(X_test))

    model = CatBoostRegressor(
        loss_function="RMSE",
        eval_metric="RMSE",
        random_seed=42,
        depth=6,
        iterations=1800,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        l2_leaf_reg=15,
        rsm=0.7,
        verbose=False
    )

    model.fit(
        X_sub,
        y_sub
    )

    pred = model.predict(X_test)

    mae = float(np.mean(np.abs(y_test - pred)))
    rmse = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((y_test - pred) ** 2)))

    pearson = float(
        pearsonr(y_test, pred).statistic
    )

    spearman = float(
        spearmanr(y_test, pred).statistic
    )

    row = {
        "Fraction": f"{fraction:.0%}",
        "Fraction_Value": fraction,
        "Train_Rows": n_rows,
        "Test_Rows": len(X_test),
        "MAE": mae,
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "Pearson": pearson,
        "Spearman": spearman
    }

    results.append(row)

    print(f"MAE     : {mae:.6f}")
    print(f"RMSE    : {rmse:.6f}")
    print(f"Pearson : {pearson:.6f}")
    print(f"Spearman: {spearman:.6f}")

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# SAVE RESULTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------

data_efficiency_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

out_csv = FINAL_DIR / "data_efficiency_results.csv"
data_efficiency_df.to_csv(out_csv, index=False)

print("\n" + "=" * 70)
print("DATA-EFFICIENCY RESULTS")
print("=" * 70)
print(data_efficiency_df.to_string(index=False))

print("\nSaved:")
print(out_csv)

print("\nREAD-ONLY COMPLETE")
print("MASTER NOT MODIFIED")
print("FEATURES NOT MODIFIED")
print("SPLITS NOT MODIFIED")
print("FINAL V2 CHECKPOINT NOT MODIFIED")

from pathlib import Path

    "train": 185064,

    "test": 3132

print("=" * 75)

matches = []

for directory in sorted(BASE.iterdir()):

    if not directory.is_dir():
        continue

    train_path = directory / "train.csv"
    val_path   = directory / "val.csv"
    test_path  = directory / "test.csv"

    if not (train_path.exists() and val_path.exists() and test_path.exists()):
        continue

    try:
        train_n = len(pd.read_csv(train_path))
        val_n   = len(pd.read_csv(val_path))
        test_n  = len(pd.read_csv(test_path))

    except Exception:
        continue

    print(
        f"{directory.name:30s} "
        f"train={train_n:7d} "
        f"val={val_n:6d} "
        f"test={test_n:6d}"
    )

    if (
        train_n == TARGET["train"]
        and val_n == TARGET["val"]
        and test_n == TARGET["test"]
    ):
        matches.append(directory)

print("\n" + "=" * 75)
print("RESULT")
print("=" * 75)

if len(matches) == 0:

    print("NO EXACT MATCH FOUND.")
    print(
        "We will NOT rerun the data-efficiency curve until "
        "the original finalized split is identified."
    )

elif len(matches) > 1:

    print("MULTIPLE EXACT MATCHES FOUND:")
    for p in matches:
        print(p)

    print(
        "\nDo not choose arbitrarily. "
        "We need to verify which one produced the existing V2 result."
    )

else:

    EXACT_SPLIT_DIR = matches[0]

    print("EXACT SPLIT FOUND:")
    print(EXACT_SPLIT_DIR)

    print("\nFiles:")
    print(EXACT_SPLIT_DIR / "train.csv")
    print(EXACT_SPLIT_DIR / "val.csv")
    print(EXACT_SPLIT_DIR / "test.csv")

    print("\nExpected:")
    print("TRAIN:", TARGET["train"])
    print("VAL  :", TARGET["val"])
    print("TEST :", TARGET["test"])

    print("\nPASS — exact finalized split structure located.")

print("\nREAD-ONLY")
print("NO FILES MODIFIED")
print("NO MASTER MODIFIED")
print("NO FEATURES MODIFIED")
print("NO SPLITS MODIFIED")
